jobs.title: Partner AI Architect
jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


The Genesys Partner AI Architect is a is a senior presales AI specialist who operates across four core motions:

1. Driving strategic Genesys Cloud CX and Genesys AI opportunities with Genesys Strategic Technology Partners, Global Systems Integrators (GSI), and Genesys sales teams showcasing the Genesys differentiated Genesys AI experience.
2. Scaling the Genesys partner ecosystem through creation of reusable assets, reference architectures, Pre-Sales technical enablement for Genesys partner’s Pre-Sales teams, and coaching. This role is pivotal in building assets that leverage the strengths of both Genesys and Genesys partners, allowing them to demonstrate the value of their solutions in combination with Genesys Cloud CX and Genesys AI capabilities.
3. Ensuring that partners understand the Genesys AI business and technical value proposition and are able to independently generate pipeline, articulating value, and delivering AI led outcomes. This is anchored in structured Pre-Sales enablement, repeatable frameworks, and targeted engagement models.
4. Shaping product and go-to-market direction through real-world partner and customer feedback

This role requires a blend of deep AI technical acumen, exceptional sales & communication skills, and the ability to translate complex capabilities into clear, actionable business value.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design end-to-end AI systems for customer experience use cases. Architect reliable, production-ready AI solutions that go beyond prompt design, combining LLMs, deterministic workflows, tools, and orchestration layers. Define how AI interacts across the full journey (self-service, agent copilot, journey management, and back-office automation), including fallback strategies, human handoff, and failure handling.

  • Optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge architectures to extend Genesys solutions where required. Design scalable knowledge and retrieval strategies that ground AI responses in enterprise data. Develop approaches for content structuring, chunking, embedding, and ranking to ensure accuracy, relevance, and freshness. Partner with customers to align AI outputs with trusted knowledge sources while balancing performance, latency, and governance requirements.

  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks and quality measurement strategies - Define how success is measured for AI-driven experiences, including accuracy, containment, customer satisfaction, and business impact. Create test sets, evaluation methodologies, and feedback loops to continuously improve performance. Translate technical quality metrics into business-relevant outcomes to support customer decision-making and adoption.

  • Engineer contextual AI experiences that leverage real-time data and conversation state - Design how AI systems incorporate dynamic context such as customer data, interaction history, and external signals. Optimize context management and prompt structure to maximize relevance while managing token limits and response quality. Ensure AI interactions remain coherent, personalized, and aligned across channels and touchpoints.

  • Design for scalability, latency, and cost efficiency in enterprise environments - Evaluate and optimize AI solutions for real-world constraints, including response time (especially for voice), throughput, and cost at scale. Make informed tradeoffs across model selection, caching strategies, and architecture patterns to deliver performant and economically viable solutions. Ensure designs meet enterprise expectations for reliability and responsiveness.

  • Support Partner Development Lab Co-created Configurations: Work with Genesys Strategic Technology partners and GSI partners to build, refine, and optimize their Genesys Cloud development lab environments with a focus on AI. These labs will serve as the foundation for joint innovation, ensuring that both Genesys and partner teams can continuously iterate on solutions and use cases. This includes leading and facilitating remote and in person workshops educating and empowering Partners on the Genesys unique value proposition, roadmaps to help generate pipeline, help them to be more self-sufficient and drive Genesys Cloud and AI adoption.

  • Technical Escalation: Serve as a technical escalation point for difficult or complex integration issues that arise during partner Pre-Sales cycles. Provide advanced troubleshooting and solution development to resolve roadblocks effectively.

  • Mentor Genesys Partner’s Solution Consultant teams and act as a technical escalation point for complex technical issues.

  • Technical Field Readiness Assistance: Work with GSI and Genesys Strategic Technology partners, Genesys Product Management, Genesys Product Marketing, and Genesys Enablement teams to assist with technical field readiness. This may involve building assets, shared demo environments, videos, and assisting with RFx’s.

  • Support Strategic Pre-Sales Engagements: Co-sell with partners and Genesys Account Teams (when requested) in high impact opportunities by leading technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, workshops, and value articulation.

  • Establish best practice frameworks: Create and maintain structured knowledge-sharing model across partners and internal teams including demos, success stories, and reusable assets.

  • Leverage expert-level knowledge of Genesys AI capabilities — including predictive AI and Agentic Virtual Agents —to articulate and demonstrate product value to customers and prospects.

  • Design and deploy AI prototypes in sandbox and/or partner and customer development environments to validate use cases, integrations, latency, and success criteria, and to highlight the differentiated value of Genesys AI.

  • Support partners, Genesys account teams, and professional services to transition successful prototypes into production pilots supporting technical handoff, hardening, KPI alignment, and business outcome validation through hands-on configuration and building of the production pilots.

  • Build integrations to third-party systems via RESTful APIs and emerging interoperability patterns such as MCP and A2A showcasing the art of the possible with Genesys Cloud AI solutions.

  • Develop reusable technical assets and enable Solution Consultants, partners, and account teams through workshops, deep-dive demonstrations, coaching, and scalable technical content.

  • Provide technical feedback and strategic insights to Product Management and Engineering on AI product design, implementation considerations, and customer-driven enhancements.

  • Support partners in influencing CIO/CTO-level stakeholders and position Genesys as integral to an organization’s broader IT and transformation strategy.

Requirements:

  • AI Architecture & Technical Judgment: Hands-on experience designing modern AI solutions for customer experience orchestration and contact center use cases using the right mix of classic ML, NLU/NLP, retrieval-based systems, LLMs, orchestration patterns, prompt engineering best practices, tool use and agentic approaches. Ability to make and defend architecture tradeoffs across latency, cost, explainability, governance, multilingual requirements, and business risk.

  • Enterprise Integration & Real-Time Design: Expertise integrating AI solutions with enterprise platforms, knowledge sources, RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, identity systems, and broader cloud ecosystems. Able to design for real-world constraints including voice latency, fallback paths, throughput, reliability, and secure data access.

  • Evaluation, Governance & Observability: Ability to define AI evaluation strategies, success metrics, and monitoring approaches across offline and online testing, retrieval quality, tool-call accuracy, safety, drift, auditability, and cost control.

  • Executive Communication & Hands-On Partner Pre-Sales Enablement: Strong ability to translate complex AI architectures into clear business value for technical and executive stakeholders, while also creating reusable assets, workshops, and enablement content that scale field capability across partner organizations.

  • Prompt Design & AI Workflow Optimization: Practical experience designing prompts, context strategies, and orchestration flows as part of a broader system architecture, rather than as a standalone discipline.

  • Technical Demonstration Prowess: Proven ability to create, deliver, and adapt compelling technical demonstrations and presentations that clearly articulate AI integration points and business impact.

  • Sales Acumen: Demonstrated success partnering with sales teams to understand customer challenges and provide AI-focused technical solutioning.

  • Business Value Orientation: Ability to identify opportunities for process optimization and recommend AI-driven solutions that enhance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.

  • Executive Presence: Proven ability to influence CIO/CTO decision-makers.

  • Strong understanding of the Genesys Cloud platform and Genesys AI preferred.

  • Hands on experience working with AWS, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Meta, and/or Guidewire.

  • Prior experience working with GSI’s is preferred.

#Li-Remote

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$111,700.00 - $196,300.00

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.

  • Telehealth coverage

  • Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities

Working at Genesys

  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.

jobs.description:
Sr/Principal Statistician (Sponsor-dedicated) Many possible locations (EMEA) - Early Phase

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provides support across all assigned statistical tasks during the lifecycle of the project, from protocol to CSR.
  • Prepares Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), including development of well-presented mock-up displays for tables, listings, and figures. Collaborate with the sponsor, if required.
  • May be responsible for the statistical aspects of the protocol, generation of randomization schedule, publications and input to the clinical study report.
  • Coordinates the activities of other biostatistics and statistical programming personnel on assigned projects to ensure timely completion of high quality work. Provides independent review of project work produced by other biostatisticians in the department.
  • Creates or reviews programming specifications for analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures.
  • Reviews SAS annotated case report forms (CRFs), database design, and other study documentation to ensure protocol criteria are met and all data is captured as required to support a high quality database and the planned analysis.
  • Conducts and participates in verification and quality control of project deliverables, ensuring that output meets expectations and is consistent with analysis described in SAP and specifications.
  • Implements company objectives, and create alternative solutions to address business and operational challenges.
  • Serves as biostatistics representative on project teams, interfacing as necessary with other departmental project team representatives. This would include preparing in advance for internal meetings, contributing ideas, and demonstrating respect for opinions of others.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects, sets goals based on priorities from management, adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload, and proactively communicates to biostatistics management any difficulties with meeting these timelines.
  • Monitors progress on study activities against agreed upon milestones and ensures the study timelines for project deliverables are met. Identifies out of scope tasks and escalate to management.
  • Provides statistical programming support as needed.
  • May participate in Data Safety Monitoring Board and/or Data Monitoring Committee activities, including charter development and serving as an independent non-voting biostatistician.
  • May lead projects involving integrated analyses, attend regulatory agency meetings or respond to questions, as needed, to support the statistical analysis results of clinical trials on behalf of the sponsor.
  • Follows applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, and verification/quality control documents and programs; ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Displays willingness to work with others and assists with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business.
  • Supports business development activities by contributing to proposals, budgets, and attending sponsor bid defense meetings.
  • Coaches and mentors other Biostatistics staff.
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

jobs.description:
About the Role

**Role Location: While we are open to fully remote candidates within the continental United States, we have a strong preference for candidates based in Mountain and Pacific timezones.

Our Manager, Legal Operations & Compliance will be the backbone behind how Nearmap's legal function runs, day in and day out. You'll lead the legal operations team and own our legal tech stack, including Jira, Conga/CPQ/CLM, Checkbox, Agiloft, DocuSign and Salesforce, making sure intake, contracting and compliance work moves fast and scales as we grow. You'll be the primary approver on quotes requiring legal review, and the first port of call when it comes to contract-generation tooling. Beyond that, you'll take ownership of entity management, contracting management, and our insurance program, and help drive the Company's broader compliance agenda. Working closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and Finance across every region we operate in, you'll be continually levelling up our Legals Ops and Compliance functions to ensure Legal keeps pace with our fast-moving business.

  • Lead and develop the legal operations team by strategically allocating work, cross-training across teams/verticals, and managing leave/coverage plans to avoid single points of failure.
  • Oversee the RFQ/RFP process, working closely with the Contracts and Proposal Manager and cross-functionally to build a scalable process ensuring timely and efficient submission of proposals and completed questionnaires
  • Own and triage the Legal Jira intake queue, ensuring requests are correctly routed, assigned, and progressed per the intake workflow. Explore ways to optimize.
  • Serve as primary approver on Salesforce quotes requiring legal review, applying the quote approval process and escalating to delegates as needed.
  • Support Sales and account teams on legal matters, including training on contract risk, handling customer-facing legal enquiries, and managing recurring requests (NDAs, sole source letters, imagery permissions, COIs).
  • Review and negotiate NDAs and similar agreements, balancing risk identification with Nearmap's business needs, and collaborate on global legal projects led by regional Counsel.
  • Own the legal technology strategy and stack, including Conga/CPQ, Checkbox, Agiloft, DocuSign, and the Salesforce Legal Queue, driving adoption, configuration, and vendor management.
  • Maintain the contract management system, global contracts register, template/clause library, and document retention practices.
  • Define and maintain legal operations KPIs and dashboards (ticket volume, turnaround time, contract cycle time, outside counsel spend), using data to guide resourcing and process improvements.
  • Manage Nearmap's quoting and contracting process, including Schedule 1 terms and Order Level Materials.
  • Support entity governance across all jurisdictions, including registrations, annual renewals, registered agents, filings, and license renewals.
  • Own the annual insurance renewal process with Nearmap's broker and manage certificate of insurance requests from customers and vendors.
  • Support the Company's data privacy program and maintain the Legal Ops-owned policy library, ensuring version control, brand compliance, and regular review.
  • Own compliance operations, regulatory statement delivery, and stand up an outside counsel management program covering engagement guidelines, spend, and business reviews.

What You'll Bring

  • Paralegal studies or diploma in law and 4+ years' experience in a legal operations role, ideally by way of implementing a legal operations function at a major law firm or in-house.
  • Substantive experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts and correspondence, with broad commercial and corporate law knowledge, particularly IP, licensing, SaaS, revenue recognition, and privacy in a technology context.
  • Proven ability to manage complex problems and business needs in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk against quality with minimal supervision.
  • People management experience, including performance management, workload allocation, and building team capability and capacity.
  • Experience administering contract lifecycle management and legal workflow platforms (e.g., Conga/CPQ, Checkbox, Agiloft, DocuSign), with a strong systems and process orientation.
  • Data-driven approach, using analytics and reporting to unlock team capacity and inform decision-making.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills. High attention to detail and proficiency in MS Office.
  • Nice-to-haves
  • Experience with entity management, corporate governance, and administering compliance programs preferred.
  • Exposure to RFP management and government contracting (federal and local), including GSA Schedule contracts, preferred.
  • Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce preferred.

About You

  • You're a clear communicator. You connect and communicate effectively with people at every level, translating complex legal and commercial concepts into language anyone can act on.
  • You're commercially minded. You don't just flag risk, you help find the path through it, giving advice that's grounded in what actually moves the business forward.
  • You're a natural collaborator. You build strong partnerships across functions, and people seek you out because you make cross-team work feel easy.
  • You're adaptable. A fast-moving product roadmap doesn't faze you. You flex your approach as the business evolves and find the right fit for what's needed next.
  • You're a people developer. You know how to build team capability and coverage, growing the people around you while keeping the operation resilient no matter what comes your way.
  • You're tech-curious. APIs, integrations, and the tools behind aerial imagery genuinely interest you, and you're always looking to understand how the technology connects to the business.

Why you'll love working at Nearmap:

We move fast and work smart; often wearing multiple hats. We’re proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, and maintain a safe environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging and can be themselves.

Learn More About The Work We Do

YouTube Page

LinkedIn Page

Thanks, but we got this! Nearmap does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and search firms. Please do not email or send unsolicited resumes to any Nearmap employee, location or address. Nearmap is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About Nearmap

Property intelligence is reshaping how the world understands the built environment, and Nearmap is driving that. We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it.

We move fast, we care about craft, and we're proud of what we're building. If you're energized by turning hard problems into real-world impact, we'd love to meet you.

Job Title: Team Manager - Implementation Services

We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

Join Veeva as we modernize Regulatory by building the cloud for Life Sciences and deliver Veeva RIM. Veeva Systems drives innovation for our customers.     • Support and coach your team. Find and create billable work to drive productivity and hold your team accountable
    • Manage escalations and support sales and other teams in the pre-sales process

    • 3+ years in people management

    • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader

jobs.excerpt: Why North Memorial Health? At North Memorial Health, you’re part of an inclusive health team that is rooted in our values: Advocate Courageously, Rally Together, Respect Uniqueness and Create Impact.
jobs.description:
Why North Memorial Health?

At North Memorial Health, you’re part of an inclusive health team that is rooted in our values: Advocate Courageously, Rally Together, Respect Uniqueness and Create Impact. Empathy and care are at the heart of North’s culture which is designed to actively support each team member’s wellbeing and growth. Our strength lies in our diversity, and we embrace the unique contributions and experiences of each person. Together, we empower patients to achieve their best health.

Our health system encompasses two hospital locations in Robbinsdale and Maple Grove as well as a network of 23 clinics which includes 13 primary clinics, 6 specialty clinics, 4 urgent care/urgency centers and emergency care offerings covering five counties. Our Robbinsdale Hospital, established in 1954, is a 385-bed facility recognized as the top Level 1 Trauma center for 25 years, as well as serving as a Level II pediatric trauma center. Our Maple Grove Hospital was established in 2009, is a 134-bed facility recognized as a top hospital in the state for Women and Children Care, with a Level III NICU, and is the largest Family Birth Center in the state (~5,000 deliveries per year and over 60,000 babies delivered). Both have been named to the 2022 Fortune/Merative 100 Top Hospitals® list, 2023 Women’s Choice Award Best Hospitals list.

Benefits the North Way!

As North Memorial Health is a non-profit organization you are eligible for the Public Student Loan Forgiveness program. Most part-time and all full-time positions are eligible for benefits.

  • Health & Welfare Benefit Packages
  • 401k Retirement Match or Pension Plan, based on workgroup eligibility
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) Plans
  • Adoption Reimbursement up to $3000 per child
  • Child Care Discount Program with New Horizon 10% off weekly childcare tuition
  • Education/Tuition Reimbursement
  • 24/7 Fitness Center Access for all benefit eligible team members

Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At North Memorial Health we recognize that the strength of our team lies in our diversity and make every effort to embrace the unique contributions and experiences of each person on our team. We strive to ensure that everyone feels like they are a valuable part of our community, with initiatives that reinforce our belief in diversity, equity, and inclusivity, to promote a workforce that enables authenticity, as we want to be our best when providing effective services to our patients. We acknowledge and celebrate the unique traditions, backgrounds, languages, beliefs, and customs of our community, and want everyone to feel welcome. Through our DE&I initiatives we hope to dispel myths, assumptions, and acts of implicit bias.

About this position

The Care Access Nurse Line Nurse uses the nursing process in coordinating all aspects of care for patients. The Nurse applies telephonic communication with and/or regarding an established patient or non-North Memorial established patient in which the Nurse utilzes medically approved nursing protocols to determine urgency of the customer's needs, and appropriate level of care; clinical judgement; and clinical care coordination.The Nurse works towards providing clinical support and coordination to all North Memorial Health Programs. The Nurse maximizes the customer's health outcomes by utilizing standard protocols in triaging, coordinating, and communicating patient care needs. The Nurse executes the Standards of Nursing Practice including: assessment; nursing diagnosis; outcome identification; planning, implementation; and evaluation.The Nurse will provide education, advice, and facilitate communication between patients and North Memorial Health providers, clinics, and departments. At all times, the Nurse helps to foster a team-based, supportive, and collaborative care and work environment, including documenting within the electronic medical record. The scope of practice includes the care of neonates, infants, pediatrics young adults, and older adults throughout the life cycle.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Зараз ми шукаємо автора/ку, який/яка допоможе C-level керівникам перейти від хаотичних AI-ініціатив до системної AI-стратегії: з чітким розумінням ROI, roadmap, організаційних змін і ризиків.

Що ми бачимо перед собою, коли уявляємо ідеального/ну автора/ку курсу “AI для C-level: стратегія та трансформація бізнесу”

Дізнатися більше про кураторство в Projector Institute — клац.

Якщо все вище тобі відгукується і ти бачиш AI не як тренд, а як стратегічний інструмент бізнесу — давай разом навчимо цьому інших керівників.

jobs.title: AI Evaluation Engineer (Python, QA or Security)
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $30/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.description:
Lead Software Engineer in Test

CD Baby — Platform Team

About Us

CD Baby is a globally recognized leader in the music industry and the first platform to offer artists direct distribution to their fans. Our technology organization has a deep history and a strong foundation, built by long-tenured, dedicated professionals. As we navigate the next era of music technology, we are committed to modernizing our core systems, fostering an agile culture, and leveraging cutting-edge platforms to better serve our artists, partners, and fans worldwide.

The Role

We are seeking a Lead Software Engineer in Test to be the senior-most quality voice on CD Baby’s flagship customer-facing software: the members application our artists use to distribute their music, get paid, and understand their audiences, and the .com marketing site that brings new artists into the platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with broad technical authority over how we test — the engineer who treats quality as a software engineering discipline and builds the practice to prove it.

In the near term, you will help carry our customer-facing platform across the finish line for a brand relaunch worthy of CD Baby — standing up the automated coverage, the test data, and the CI/CD gates that let us ship with confidence. Beyond launch, your defining mandate is to architect our testing practice from the ground up: choose the frameworks, build the suites, integrate them into our delivery pipeline, and make automated, AI-augmented testing a first-class capability of the team as our customer-facing stack evolves from a .NET monolith into a modular, API-driven, service-based architecture.

This is a role for an engineer who is energized by both the discipline of writing the code that proves our software works every day, and the craft of designing a testing program that scales with the platform underneath it.

What You’ll Own

Testing Strategy & Practice

  • Define and drive the multi-year evolution of CD Baby’s automated testing practice — from a nascent Playwright-based program today to a comprehensive, AI-augmented testing capability that scales as our architecture moves from monolith to services.
  • Choose the right tools for each layer of the test pyramid: UI/end-to-end (currently Playwright), API and contract testing, integration testing across our third-party API seams (FUGA, Zendesk, Trolley, and others integral to our operations), and performance and load testing. Bring a clear point of view on what to use, why, and how it fits together.
  • Design and own the CI/CD test integration. Our pipeline runs on ArgoCD; you will define how tests gate every release, what runs where, how fast feedback loops are kept fast, and how the suite earns trust over time.
  • Establish test data strategy, environment management, and the engineering patterns that keep tests reliable as the surface area grows.

Building the Test Suite

  • Own the test suite for the entire flagship application. The primary job here is writing the code — the tests, the fixtures, the helpers, the harnesses — that proves the member application and the .com marketing site work as our customers expect, release after release.
  • Cover the .NET monolith we operate today, the Next.js front end, and the new services as they emerge. Build coverage that travels with the architecture rather than fighting it.
  • Treat usability and stability as first-class quality concerns alongside functional correctness. Our interfaces must be intuitive, accessible, and dependable; your tests should help us prove all three.
  • Use AI aggressively as a force multiplier. Drive AI-assisted test authoring, suite generation, and maintenance so that one senior engineer can credibly cover the full surface area of a complex product. We expect the toolchain you build to look meaningfully different from a traditional QA program because of how you apply AI.

Cross-Functional Team Craft

  • Embed on a cross-functional Platform team alongside front end engineers, back end engineers, a data engineer, a designer, and a product manager. We share ownership over outcomes for our users — quality is the team’s job, and your job is to make sure the team is equipped to do it well.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies as the customer and quality voice in the room. Bring a QA lens to story refinement: what could break, what the edge cases are, what “done” really means. Then implement the automated tests that ship with each story.
  • Be the catcher on the field — the engineer who sees the whole game, anticipates what’s coming, and quietly guides the team toward better outcomes. Mentor by example: through the quality of your tests, the clarity of your reviews, and your willingness to sit shoulder-to-shoulder with another engineer when something is hard.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience with Playwright (or comparable modern end-to-end frameworks such as Cypress or Selenium) and a clear point of view on when and how to use them.
  • Deep experience with API testing and contract testing, including testing the seams between your application and critical third-party APIs. You know how to mock, stub, and record/replay responsibly, and when each is appropriate.
  • Experience designing and running performance and load testing programs, with the judgment to choose the right tooling for the workload (k6, JMeter, Gatling, Locust, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to testing workflows — AI-assisted test authoring, suite generation, self-healing tests, AI-driven coverage analysis, or comparable approaches. You are fluent with modern AI coding tools and treat them as core to your craft.
  • Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with ArgoCD, Kubernetes, and containerized test environments is a plus; the ability to learn our specific stack quickly is required.
  • Working knowledge of the .NET and Next.js ecosystems sufficient to read and reason about the code you are testing. You don’t need to be a .NET expert; you do need to be comfortable in the codebase.
  • A clear point of view on accessibility (WCAG) and usability testing, and the experience to back it up.
  • Excellent communication. You can explain a coverage gap, a flaky test, or a release risk to engineers, product partners, and executives with equal precision.

Skills & Competencies

  • Quality as Engineering: You treat testing as a software engineering discipline. Everything is code, everything is reviewable, everything belongs in the pipeline.
  • AI Fluency: You use AI as a force multiplier across your work and have strong opinions about where it adds real leverage and where it doesn’t.
  • Architectural Thinking: You design test architectures that match the systems they cover — simple where the system is simple, layered where it is layered, evolvable where it must evolve.
  • Pragmatic Bar-Raising: You raise the quality bar without becoming a bottleneck. You know when to write the test, when to teach the engineer to write it, and when to let it ship.
  • Mentorship by Example: You raise the people around you through the quality of your work, the clarity of your reviews, and your willingness to dig into a hard bug alongside the engineer who wrote the code.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You partner naturally with engineering, product, design, data, and DevSecOps, and you treat those partnerships as core to the work rather than adjacent to it.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Relentless focus on the artist experience. You think about usability, accessibility, and stability the way the customer would — because in the end, that’s what your tests are protecting.
  • Clear Communication: You can articulate risk, coverage, and trade-offs to engineers, product partners, and executives with equal precision — in writing, in reviews, and in person.

Location

Remote within the United States. This role works on Pacific Time hours to maintain strong overlap with the Platform team.

Reporting Structure

This role reports to the Director of Engineering.

You will lead the university's security architecture and engineering strategy, modernizing platforms, practices, and operating models to deliver scalable, resilient, and effective security capabilities. Description

AgencyBloc is a leading provider of agency management solutions built specifically for life and health insurance agencies. Our platform helps agencies streamline operations, strengthen client relationships, and drive growth through powerful CRM, commission processing, and marketing automation tools. We value innovation, collaboration, and making a meaningful impact in the industries we serve and we take pride in fostering a culture that genuinely cares about our customers, our work, and each other.

Requirements

Summary:

AgencyBloc is looking for a UX Designer to bring deep customer understanding to life through intuitive, well-crafted product experiences. This role is critical to ensuring that what we build is not only functionally right — but simple, coherent, and easy to use for health and benefits agencies.

This person will own and execute the design layers that make products truly work — rolling up their sleeves to do the hands-on design work that takes a product from concept to something Technology can build with confidence. The role goes well beyond visual polish to shape how customers think about, feel, and move through the product. Working closely with our UX Strategist & Researcher, Product Management team, and Technology team, you’ll actively shape the problem, direction, and solution, then translate customer understanding and product strategy into designs that resolve ambiguity, ensure those delight customers, answer engineering's questions before they're asked, and set a consistent standard for what great UX looks like at AgencyBloc.

Ultimately, this role ensures that AgencyBloc products are deeply usable, visually cohesive, and grounded in a genuine understanding of how our customers work.

Responsibilities:

UX Design

  • Lead and execute end-to-end design across the full UX spectrum — doing the hands-on work across conceptual models, information architecture, and interaction design — going well beyond how something looks to define how it works.
  • Define how users navigate, interact with, and mentally model the product — applying deep interaction design principles to create experiences that feel natural and effortless
  • Take vision and definition from Product and UX and make it buildable and coherent — resolving ambiguity, surfacing gaps, and producing designs that answer most of Technology's questions before they're asked
  • Define what "good UX and UI" looks like at AgencyBloc — establishing design patterns and interaction guidelines that keep the product feeling consistent and unified as it grows
  • Serve as the design conscience for the organization — the person Product Managers and engineers turn to when they need to know if something is right
  • Bring a thoughtful, structured approach to design work — moving intentionally from customer understanding through concept, iteration, and validation — and use AI tools deliberately to accelerate the process without losing sight of what customers actually need

Customer Driven

  • Develop and maintain a genuine, ongoing understanding of how AgencyBloc customers think, work, and experience the product — bringing that understanding early and often into the design process to guide every design decision from concept through delivery
  • Partner with the UX Strategist & Researcher to engage customers at every fidelity level — from rough concepts and sketches through high-fidelity prototypes — and stay connected to findings, customer interviews, and usability insights
  • Build low to high fidelity prototypes that test real understanding and interaction, not just communicate ideas to stakeholders
  • Incorporate customer learnings continuously — treating feedback as an ongoing input to design, not a final review step

Collaborative by Design

  • Work in close partnership with Product Managers, the UX Strategist & Researcher, Technology, and cross-functional partners — treating design as a team sport where the best outcomes come from working together early and often
  • With Product Management, engage deeply in product discovery and definition to understand not just what is being built, but why and to design accordingly
  • With Technology, help inform shared components and what the front-end design standard should be — without necessarily owning the CSS/HTML themselves
  • Participate actively in Discovery, Planning, and Development phases — not just as a design resource, but as a full contributor to product decisions, with the authority to raise concerns, challenge direction, and advocate for the customer experience when the design isn't right
  • Communicate design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, building alignment and confidence across the team
  • Serve as the UX design decision-maker for readiness — determining whether an experience is ready for development and validating that what ships matches the intended experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Customer-Centered Designer: Genuine curiosity about how users think and work. Designs from a deep understanding of the customer's world — not just the screen — and exercises exceptional judgement turning that understanding into design decisions that are customer-centered and practical. Comfortable engaging directly with customers to test and learn.
  • Conceptual & Interaction Design Depth: Strong command of the UX design spectrum from mental models and conceptual design through conceptual design, information architecture, and interaction design. Knows the difference between how something looks and how it works and is relentless about clarity, simplicity, and ease of use—especially for small businesses.
  • AI-Experience Designer: Comfortable designing product experiences that incorporate AI-enabled features and understanding the unique UX challenges AI presents. Approaches AI features with the same customer-centered rigor as any other part of the product.
  • Systems Thinker: Understands how individual design decisions compound across a product. Cares about consistency, scalability, and the long-term integrity of the design system. Can think at the component level and the product level simultaneously.
  • Cross-Functional Collaborator: Builds strong working relationships across Product, UX, Technology, and Client Experience. Skilled at influencing without authority through facilitation, storytelling, and clarity. An active contributor to shaping the problem and solution direction — partnering with Product and UX to define what needs to be solved, not just how to solve it.
  • Technology Collaborator: Comfortable working closely with architects and engineers. Understands enough about front-end implementation to have meaningful conversations about feasibility, component design, and design system maintenance — without owning the code.
  • Deliberate AI User: Uses AI tools intentionally as part of a structured design process — to accelerate concept generation, prototype iteration, and design exploration — while keeping customer understanding at the center of every decision.
  • Cultural Fit: Thrives in a collaborative, people-centered, fast-moving remote environment. Comfortable with ambiguity and change. Brings curiosity, humility, and a learning mindset to the work.

Skills/Education/Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in UX or product design in a SaaS or technology-driven environment
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating depth across conceptual design, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design
  • Excellent working knowledge of user experience design principles and modern product development practices.
  • Proficiency in Figma or equivalent design tooling
  • Experience contributing to or owning a design system
  • Comfort working with engineers on front-end design standards and component decisions
  • Experience working in agile or iterative product development environments.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; relevant experience considered in lieu of degree
  • Some travel may be required for in-field customer research.

jobs.description:
Join One of the Fastest-Growing Online Education Companies in the World

At ELVTR, we're transforming online education by connecting ambitious professionals with industry leaders from companies like Nike, Netflix, Google, Amazon, and more.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown into a global learning community with over 300 expert instructors, delivering more than 200 live online courses across 12 industries. To date, we've helped 22,000+ graduates worldwide gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed to advance their careers.

Now we're looking for an experienced Lead Retention Specialist to help us build lasting relationships with our learners while maximizing customer satisfaction and long-term revenue. If you're passionate about customer experience, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy finding solutions that create value for both customers and the business, we'd love to meet you.

This is a full-time, remote role with a working schedule for this role will be 9AM-6 PM EST.

Why This Role Is Different

At ELVTR, customer relationships don't end after enrollment—they're just beginning. As our Lead Retention Specialist, you'll play a critical role in protecting the customer experience while driving sustainable business growth.

You'll take ownership of our retention strategy, helping customers find the best possible solutions while reducing refunds, recovering revenue, and improving long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Billing, and Operations, you'll use data, empathy, and strategic thinking to continuously improve our retention processes and outcomes.

You'll Love This Role If You:

  • Enjoy solving complex customer challenges with creative solutions
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, KPI-driven environment
  • Are an exceptional negotiator who can create win-win outcomes
  • Love using data to improve processes and business performance
  • Enjoy coaching others and sharing best practices
  • Are highly organized and take ownership of your work
  • Communicate confidently with customers and cross-functional teams
  • Believe outstanding customer experiences drive long-term business success

What You'll Do

  • Own the customer retention process, managing refund requests while maximizing retained revenue and delivering a positive customer experience
  • Negotiate alternatives to refunds, including account credits, payment plans, partial refunds, course transfers, and other retention solutions
  • Recover overdue installment payments by proactively engaging customers and resolving billing-related issues
  • Partner closely with the Billing team to reduce payment defaults, chargebacks, and outstanding balances
  • Analyze the root causes behind refund requests and payment failures, providing actionable insights to Sales, Product, and Operations teams
  • Develop and continuously improve retention strategies, workflows, communication scripts, and internal processes
  • Track and report key retention metrics, including refund rates, retention rates, recovered revenue, installment recovery, and chargeback prevention
  • Handle escalated customer cases, making thoughtful, data-driven decisions that balance customer satisfaction with business objectives
  • Coach and support the retention team by sharing best practices, reviewing customer interactions, and maintaining high communication standards
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Operations to ensure a seamless customer experience
  • Identify opportunities to automate retention processes and improve operational efficiency
  • Take ownership of retention KPIs while testing and implementing initiatives that improve revenue recovery and reduce financial losses

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales Retention, Customer Retention, Customer Success, or a related field, preferably in a senior or lead role
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Proven experience supporting customers in the US market
  • Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills with a track record of reducing refunds and recovering revenue
  • Experience managing refund requests, payment recovery, billing issues, and installment collections
  • Ability to navigate difficult customer conversations with empathy while protecting company interests
  • A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze retention metrics and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Strong ownership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Experience collaborating with Sales, Billing, Finance, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams
  • Previous leadership, mentoring, or process improvement experience is a strong plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the online education or EdTech industry
  • Experience in high-ticket B2C sales environments
  • Previous experience leading or mentoring a retention team
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems
  • Experience working with subscription or installment payment models
  • Knowledge of billing operations, chargebacks, and payment recovery processes
  • Experience analyzing customer retention metrics to drive business improvements
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
  • Experience collaborating across Sales, Finance, Product, and Customer Success teams
  • Familiarity with AI-powered customer support or sales tools, including conversation intelligence platforms

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation:Competitive salary,Performance-based bonuses,Opportunities for career advancement as ELVTR continues to grow globally
  • Learn and Grow:Free access to ELVTR courses,Ongoing professional development opportunities,Career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from wherever you're most productive, Flexible and supportive work environment,Collaborative international team
  • Health & Wellbeing:Gym membership reimbursement,Mental health support, Generous paid vacation allowance

Why Join ELVTR?

  • Make an Impact:Every course you help create empowers professionals to build new skills, advance their careers, and unlock opportunities they never thought possible.
  • Grow Your Career:We're committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education.
  • Join a Winning Team:Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world.

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

If you're looking for more than just another customer retention role—if you want to build meaningful customer relationships, solve complex challenges, and make a measurable impact on both learners and business growth—we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of ELVTR's next chapter of growth.

What We Can Achieve Together:

The Global Director of Indigenous and Community Leadership in Conservation (ICLC) is abold, strategic, and visionary leaderresponsible for advancing one of TNC’s most critical global priorities.

Reporting to the Global Managing Director, Equitable Conservation, this position will lead aglobalteam andis responsible foradvancing Indigenous and Community Leadership in Conservationas a cross-cutting transformative practiceacross TNC. The Directorsupervises a small, specialized global unit andworks through a complex matrix of regional, country, and global teams, providing strategic leadership, influence, and coordination to advance shared conservation outcomes with and for Indigenous Peoples, Tribal Nations, and local communities.

This role will:

  • Drive aglobal strategy that advances Indigenous and community leadership across TNC’s conservation work

  • Shape how TNCdelivers onits 2030goalsand beyond throughequitable, durable, and community-led outcomes

  • Influence systems, financing, partnerships, and governance to align withself-determined stewardship and rights-based approaches

  • Partner with Equitable Conservation teammates on avision of biocultural restorationfor the planet

The Global Director, ICLC operates at the most senior levels of the organization, leading across boundaries to catalyze change at scale and position TNC as a global leader in shifting power to communities.

We’re Looking for You:

The Global Director,ICLCleads the design and execution of a global transformative practice that crosscutsall ofTNC’s work.

The Director leads a global team of ~6 staff, works across regions and functions, and engages senior internal and external stakeholders to accelerate a shift toward conservation models rooted in equity, rights, and local leadership. They lead the global strategy of Indigenous and Community Leadership in Conservation, partnering closely with regional and global teams as well as local communities, rightsholders and stakeholders to deliver conservation outcomes that respect and advance Indigenous rights and sovereignty.They will manage a team toward a vision of self-determination.

They provide strategic direction, organizational influence, and management oversight to ensure that Indigenous and community leadership is embedded in conservation outcomes, partnerships, and systems.They also have theability to understand enabling conditions as they shift, and adjust strategy and team accordingly, while grounded in global community reality and expectations.

They serve as the primary spokesperson for TNC to internal and external audiences (including staff, volunteers, Board of Trustees, public and private donors, government agencies and officials, communityleadersand other partners) and cultivates these audiences to support andpromote TNC’s mission and vision.

This role is remote and can be based in any country where TNC has an entity and room for additional employees.

This role may include travel up to 25% oftotaltime.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

Global Strategy & Transformation

  • Lead and evolve TNC’s global ICLC strategy, ensuring alignment with team and organizational priorities as well as external movements

  • Translate vision intoactionable frameworks, priorities, partnerships and investments, including evaluation and adaptive management

  • Drive integration of ICLC across conservation, climate and policy programs and influence high-level decision-making

Systems Change & Organizational Influence

  • Embed Indigenous and community leadership into core programmatic strategies

  • Advance strategies for governance and decision-making, funding allocation and finance mechanisms, and external partnerships

  • Position ICLC as a central driver of conservation impact and organizational transformation, influencing global and regional conservation strategies and outcomes

  • Strengthen organizational capacity to partner effectively with Indigenous Peoples and local communities

Team Leadership & Capacity Building

  • Lead and manage a global, multi-disciplinary and geographically dispersed team

  • Build a high-performing, inclusive culture aligned with TNC’s values

  • Serve on Conservation Leadership Team and Equitable Conservation Leadership Team as anexpert onIndigenous-led approaches

  • Serve as a global thought leader and spokesperson for Indigenous and community-led conservation

  • Build and sustain partnerships with Indigenous leaders and community organizations, as well as global NGOs, multilaterals and funders

  • Represent TNC in global forums and influence the broader conservation and climate fields

Resource Mobilization & Delivery

  • Advance and support global fundraising and donor engagement strategies

  • Align resources and investments with ICLCglobalpriorities

  • Ensure effective delivery of programs and measurable conservation outcomes

Cross-Organizational Leadership

  • High energy, forward thinking, creative individual with high ethical standards. Outstanding leadership and visionary qualities and able to work effectively with and through others in a decentralized and geographically dispersed organization

  • Proven technical skills, analytical ability, good judgment, and strong operational focus. Demonstrated operational, implementation and detail-oriented perspective

This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is Canada. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate’s location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

We calm the confusion of IT by guiding the connection between people and technology. It’s what makes Connection unique—what drives us to innovate and create technology solutions that stand apart from the crowd. We’d love for you to be a part of that fabric, to share your ideas and experiences with a team that thrives on fresh thinking, creativity, and helping others.

You’ll find supportive teammates and a rewarding career at Connection—plus great benefits. We take pride in supporting employees with a total rewards package that provides financial, emotional, and physical resources for you and your family. Our compensation, 401k plans, medical insurance, and other benefits are progressive and competitive. We value the importance of our employees’ emotional wellbeing. The Onboarding Inside Account Manager (OBIAM) is more than a sales training role—it's the launchpad for a successful career in enterprise technology sales. As an OIAM, you'll combine customer relationship management, consultative selling, and operational excellence while learning from experienced Enterprise Account Executives (EAEs).

In this hybrid role, you'll serve as both an Inside Account Manager (IAM) and Client Experience Specialist, helping new customers experience the best of Connection from day one. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives, manufacturers, distribution partners, and internal support teams to onboard customers, uncover new business opportunities, drive revenue growth, and deliver exceptional service throughout the customer lifecycle.

Create Exceptional First Impressions

  • Deliver a personalized, "white glove" onboarding experience for new enterprise clients.
  • Introduce customers to their dedicated Connection team and available resources.

  • Configure customer portals, standards, and purchasing workflows to align with business needs.

  • Register opportunities and manage deal registrations with manufacturer partners.
  • Follow up on active proposals and sales opportunities.
  • Identify cross-sell, upsell, and whitespace opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct spend analysis and proactively recommend new technology solutions.

Build Strong Customer Relationships

  • Maintain ongoing communication with customers, manufacturers, distributors, and internal teams.
  • Build relationships across multiple customer departments and decision-makers.
  • Help customers maximize the value of their technology investments.
  • Partner with customers on pricing strategies, standards management, and procurement optimization.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and proactive account recommendations.

Lead Operational Excellence

You'll coordinate the resources needed to deliver a seamless customer experience from quote through fulfillment.

  • Oversee daily account activity to ensure timely order processing and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Inside Sales Support to maintain order accuracy and meet shipment expectations.
  • Assist with pricing reviews, order escalations, and complex open-order management.
  • Support return merchandise authorization (RMA) escalations.
  • Ensure Salesforce opportunities remain accurate and current.
  • Analyze customer activity and prepare meaningful business reports.

Collaborate and Lead

As your knowledge grows, you'll become a key resource for both customers and teammates.

  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and manufacturer partners.
  • Mentor and guide Inside Sales Support Representatives on customer priorities.
  • Share best practices and contribute to team success.
  • Support new Enterprise Account Executives during onboarding by introducing company resources, sales processes, and operational tools.

  • Identify and develop new revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Meet or exceed sales, gross profit, and customer satisfaction goals.

You'll receive hands-on training, mentorship, and opportunities to build meaningful customer relationships, develop consultative selling skills, and grow into increasingly strategic sales roles.

Experience beyond general hospital supply chain is required.

You'll own a portfolio of 4–6 fashion and apparel accounts. These clients move fast — seasonal drops, trend-driven creative, influencer campaigns that need to be in market in days, not weeks.

The growth constraints in fashion are usually one of three things: the brand is winning on product but losing on customer acquisition efficiency; they're acquiring customers but not retaining them; or their creative is outpacing their targeting strategy (or vice versa).
