• An enrolled college or university student in the Class of 2027, 2028, 2029, or 2030 for the fall 2026 semester.
• Must be from a rural area, small town, or a farm in Wisconsin. You can look up your home address in this tool: We are prioritizing students from the following categories: Rural-Remote, Rural-Distant, Rural-Fringe, Town-Remote, and Town-Distant.
• Be in good academic and conduct standing for the 2026 summer, fall, and 2027 spring semesters.
• Maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.6 or higher and a semester GPA of 2.6 or higher during semesters employed. If you are a freshman, you won't have a GPA yet and that's fine, there will just be an expectation to meet the requirements at the end of your first semester. Applicants who have under a 2.6 cumulative GPA may still apply; however, we will want to have a conversation to ensure you're able to balance being a student and being employed.
• Most events are in-person in rural and small-town communities across the state. Specific dates aren’t available at this time, but we will provide dates as early as possible. The director will work with the team to determine availability. You are not expected to attend all events; however, the goal is to have at least two advisors at each event.

This position can be located anywhere in Wisconsin. Team meetings and most work can be done remotely.

Travel is required for in-person programs and events. Advisors are not required to have access to a car as transportation will be provided if needed.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Interest in changing the lives of rural high school students!
    • Excellent interpersonal communication skills.
    • Strong time management and organizational skills.
    • Able to travel (transportation can be provided) to off-campus locations. (Most events are in-person in rural and small-town communities across the state. Specific dates aren’t available at this time, but we will provide dates as early as possible. You are not expected to attend all events; however, the goal is to have at least two advisors at each event.)

    College for Rural Wisconsin is looking for students who are interested in mentoring, supporting, and educating rural students, families, school staff, and communities about the college-going process. The Rural Peer Advisor position is primarily remote work, with some travel to in-person events (around Wisconsin).

Position Summary/Job Duties:

The Rural Peer Advisor position has two main responsibilities:

Peer Educator

Advisors create, teach, and support educational sessions and various college-access and career programs to support rural and small-town middle and high school students and their families.

Advisors are integral in assisting the director with planning, logistics, and content development of these programs. Advisors take the lead in teaching and presenting these programs to share information and their own college-going and career experiences.

Most of these sessions and events will be in-person at high schools and other locations across Wisconsin. Some events will be on college campuses. There are opportunities to be a part of activities and events reaching a national rural audience through CRW’s involvement in the STARS Network.

Peer Mentor

Advisors serve as peer mentors to individuals and groups of rural, small-town, and farm middle and high school students to provide support and information around the college-going process and career advising. Advisors will utilize their unique strengths and backgrounds to share their experiences and knowledge about college by answering questions, advising high school students, and through outreach programming.

Mentoring is done virtually and in-person through visits to high schools and other locations across Wisconsin, as well as through specific programming that we offer.

Mentoring also includes supporting current rural college students at your campus through planning and hosting events, discussing opportunities to meet rural students needs, etc.

Duties:
• Advise, answer questions, and provide resources to middle and high school students on college-going from considering higher education to planning to attend to applying to belonging in college.
• Advise, answer questions, and provide resources to middle and high school students on career options, connecting college to career, and the different pathways to a career.
• Design, develop, and teach educational sessions using own college-going experience, research, and accurate resources and information.
• Inform and contribute to the development of rural-focused college-going resources based on own experience as a rural college student and the questions and concerns received through peer-to-peer mentoring.
• Develop on-campus (your campus) programming to support rural and small-town college students with the goal of community-building, creating a sense of belonging, and student retention.
• Conduct research around rural and small-town students’ college-going needs.
• Assist the director with donor and media relations.
• Attend work-related trainings.
• Attend a short, weekly virtual team meeting with the College for Rural Wisconsin Program Director and other Rural Peer Advisors.
• Attend 1x a semester in-person team meeting (with food!) with the College for Rural Wisconsin Program Director and other Rural Peer Advisors.

The CRW Program Director works with the advisor team to highlight individual strengths and interests to align the position with the advisor’s personal and professional development goals.

The duties listed above are work that Rural Peer Advisors do; however, every Rural Peer Advisor takes a different approach to what they get involved with depending on their interests, skills, and level of time commitment. There is an expectation for you to contribute and be engaged, but you have a say in what that looks like.

A successful candidate is a strong cross-channel marketer and communicator who can confidently translate data into insights, guide internal teams, and build trust with clients. This is a critical role in ensuring accounts are not only running efficiently, but driving meaningful business impact.

As an Associate Account Director (AAD), you will act as the day-to-day strategic lead for Fashion clients, ensuring marketing efforts are aligned to revenue growth driven by creative performance, customer acquisition efficiency, and retention—not just channel outputs. You will work closely with client teams across marketing, merchandising, and creative, helping balance creative velocity, paid media performance, and seasonal campaign planning. This role requires comfort discussing audience strategy, creative testing, influencer programs, and lifecycle performance. You’ll partner with Project Managers to ensure execution stays on track, while collaborating with the Account Director to refine quarterly strategy and long-term growth plans.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

  • Support retention strategy: repeat purchase rate, LTV by acquisition cohort, and loyalty mechanics
  • Keep pace with the seasonal calendar; flag when campaign timing or creative velocity is creating execution risk
  • Support the AD on quarterly strategy, renewal prep, and service expansion conversations
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships; contribute to ≥90% retention across your accounts
  • Work in Iris and nova daily; use performance data to surface issues before clients raise them; maintain Pulse cadence at 100%

Role Requirements:

  • 4–7 years in fashion, apparel, or DTC marketing, with experience managing client relationships day-to-day
  • Understands how creative strategy and media strategy interact — has a working point of view on which constrains the other in different scenarios
  • Familiar with the influencer and UGC ecosystem: knows how campaigns are briefed, evaluated, and scaled
  • Comfortable with DTC economics: CAC, LTV, repeat rate, and what cohort behavior tells you about acquisition quality
  • Understands Meta-heavy media mixes and the measurement challenges that come with them — creative fatigue, audience saturation, incrementality
  • Has worked in seasonal marketing environments and knows how to stay strategic when execution volume is highest
  • Strong written and verbal communication; can translate performance data into a clear client narrative under time pressure

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Most Important Things (MITs)

jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

Location: Remote, USA

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Security Engineer to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and trustworthy products spanning AI, data, and cloud-native systems.
You’ll work closely with engineering, data science, and infrastructure teams to embed security by design throughout the product lifecycle.

This role sits at the intersection of AI/ML security, secure product development, and container/cloud-native protection, helping define the architecture, automation, and frameworks that enable secure, intelligent products at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Embed robust security practices throughout the software and AI development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Lead secure design reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments for AI-driven products, APIs, and backend services.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to ensure security, privacy, and compliance by design.
  • Build and maintain security automation and governance frameworks that integrate seamlessly into development workflows.
  • Architect and enforce security controls for AI/ML systems, including model training, data pipelines, and inference environments.
  • Identify and mitigate AI-specific attack vectors such as data poisoning, model inversion, prompt injection, and model theft.
  • Collaborate with governance and compliance teams to align with ethical AI principles and frameworks like NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act.
  • Implement model provenance, integrity, and auditability controls to ensure responsible and secure AI operations.
  • Partner with DevOps and SRE teams to secure service meshes, container networking, and secrets management.
  • Drive software supply chain security, including artifact integrity, dependency management, and vulnerability reduction.
  • Build internal frameworks for continuous assurance and real-time vulnerability management.
  • Define and maintain reference security architectures for microservices, APIs, and AI-powered systems deployed in the cloud.
  • Mentor teams on secure coding, containerization best practices, and AI risk management.
  • Promote a security-first culture through advocacy, documentation, and training.
  • Represent product security in cross-functional initiatives and leadership discussions.

What We Are Looking For:

Required:

  • 7+ years of experience in product or application security engineering.
  • Deep understanding of secure SDLC, threat modeling, and secure architecture design.
  • Proven expertise with AWS cloud security concepts and best practices.
  • Strong experience with container security, orchestration, and runtime protection.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, and/or JavaScript for security automation, code review, and tooling.
  • Experience securing AI/ML pipelines, data workflows, or model-serving infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps and continuous integration/deployment environments.
  • Familiarity with encryption fundamentals, including symmetric and asymmetric cryptography, TLS/mTLS, key management, and secrets handling best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional security initiatives, partnering with engineering, product, and legal teams to embed security requirements into roadmaps, influence architectural decisions, and align stakeholders across organizational boundaries.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with GCP or Azure cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI and LLM security.
  • Experience with software supply chain security and artifact integrity verification.
  • Familiarity with compliance and governance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, NIST AI RMF).
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization patterns in modern applications, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, RBAC, and ABAC.
  • Certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), CISSP, CSSLP, or AI/ML-focused security credentials.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge security challenges in a fast-growing company.
  • Opportunity to shape and drive product security strategy.
  • Collaborative and security-minded engineering culture.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.

In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range
$134,000—$184,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Senior Program Review Specialist

Aptive is seeking a Senior Program Review Specialist to support a federal health program involving structured review of applications, submissions, or case documentation. The role will evaluate materials for eligibility, policy alignment, completeness, consistency, and evidentiary support and will develop clear, well-documented recommendations for government consideration.

The Senior Program Review Specialist will also help establish reviewer guidance, promote consistent application of program criteria, support resolution of complex cases, and improve review quality through calibration and continuous feedback.

The ideal candidate brings strong policy interpretation, analytical judgment, and documentation-review experience and can translate complex requirements into practical, repeatable review criteria.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end reviews of applications, submissions, or case files using approved policies, procedures, templates, and evaluation criteria.
  • Assess eligibility, program alignment, documentation completeness, internal consistency, and the credibility of supporting evidence.
  • Prepare clear review records documenting evidence considered, findings, unresolved issues, and the basis for recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain standardized review checklists, decision trees, evidence matrices and reviewer job aids.
  • Identify missing, unclear or inconsistent information and coordinate targeted clarification requests through the applicant communications function.
  • Ensure review conclusions are traceable to the governing requirement and distinguish factual findings from professional judgment or recommendation.
  • Conduct secondary reviews of complex, sensitive, or borderline cases and elevate interpretive questions through established channels.
  • Lead reviewer calibration sessions to improve consistency, reduce rework, and document relevant guidance or precedents.
  • Analyze recurring deficiencies and recommend updates to intake instructions, templates, SOPs and quality controls.
  • Protect applicant information and maintain accurate records in the designated document repository and tracking system.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in public policy, healthcare administration, business administration, social sciences, law, compliance or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience performing technical, eligibility, compliance, policy or documentation reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret statutes, regulations, policies or program requirements and apply them consistently to individual cases.
  • Experience assessing evidence, documenting findings and developing defensible written recommendations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies and unsupported claims in submitted materials.
  • Strong writing skills and ability to communicate review findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage a steady volume of assignments while meeting turnaround and quality expectations.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting VA, another federal health agency, Veterans’ programs, healthcare navigation, public benefits, or community-partnership initiatives.
  • Experience reviewing nonprofit, volunteer, community-based, healthcare, or public-service organizations.
  • Experience with credentialing, certification, eligibility, licensing, grants, claims, or other formal application-review processes.
  • Experience developing review rubrics, checklists, standard work or knowledge-management resources.
  • Familiarity with Lean methods, reviewer calibration and root-cause analysis.

  • Hands-on AI / LLM integration experience in production;

  • Strong React product UI skills;

  • Experience with data pipelines and structured data;

  • Strong English; ability to self-manage as an independent contributor;

  • Daily use of AI tooling (Claude, Cursor) in your workflow;

  • US healthcare / claims / RCM domain experience;

  • HIPAA / PHI handling experience.

  • Work in a small, focused founding team with a modern, AI-native development practice;

  • Flexible fractional engagement — outcome-driven, no fixed hours, fully remote;

  • Milestone-based cadence with room to grow into a larger ongoing commitment;

jobs.description:
💫Про RIA.com
Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.com, яка розвиває відомі маркетплейси AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com. Нашими продуктами користуються мільйони українців, тож команда фахівців наполегливо працює над покращеннями та пошуками інноваційних рішень.

👥 Про команду
AUTO.RIA допомагає мільйонам українців безпечно купувати та продавати авто з перевіреною історією. Маркетплейс збирає понад 9 мільйонів користувачів щомісяця, а застосунок завантажили вже понад 29 мільйонів разів.
Ми шукаємо Менеджера клієнтського успіху— спеціаліста, який/яка допомагає автодилерам швидше продавати авто та ефективно використовувати сервіси AUTO.RIA для зростання їхнього бізнесу.

🔷 Твої основні завдання
  • Будувати довгострокові партнерські відносини з автодилерами на AUTO.RIA, допомагати їм досягати результатів, а також залучати нових клієнтів для розширення бази.
  • Консультувати щодо ефективного використання сервісів AUTO.RIA, щоб кожне оголошення приносило результат.
  • Аналізувати потреби клієнта, пропонувати рішення, які допомагають продавати швидше.
  • Активно працювати з клієнтською базою через дзвінки, CRM та онлайн-інструменти, проводити особисті зустрічі та презентувати нові сервіси AUTO.RIA для розвитку їхнього бізнесу.
  • Впливати на ключові показники: задоволеність клієнта, повторне розміщення, середній чек.
  • Готувати звітність за результатами своєї роботи.
⚡️Ти точно наш кандидат, якщо
  • Маєш досвід у клієнтському сервісі або продажах від 1-го року (B2B буде перевагою).
  • Вмієш слухати, ставити запитання, знаходити рішення під потребу клієнта.
  • Любиш активну комунікацію — дзвінки, консультації, презентації.
  • Володієш CRM та Google-інструментами, цінуєш структуру в роботі.
  • Хочеш працювати з продуктом, яким користуються мільйони українців.
🔗 Етапи відбору
  1. Телефонна розмова з рекрутером (15−20 хв)
  2. Інтерв'ю з лідером команди — знайомство, обговорення досвіду, очікувань і команди (45−60 хв).
  3. Тестове завдання.
  4. Фінальне інтерв'ю — зустріч із лідером команди та презентація тестового завдання (попередимо про учасників заздалегідь).
📌Що на тебе чекає в RIA.com?
  • Практичне втілення командних цінностей: відкрита комунікація, регулярні 1-on-1, фідбек, підтримка наставника із першого дня для швидкої адаптації, без мікроменеджменту чи тайм-трекерів.
  • Комфортні умови роботи: ремоут чи гібрид — вирішувати тобі. Комфортний офіс у Вінниці, стабільний графік роботи з пн по пт (9:00—18:00), офіційне працевлаштування.
  • Здоров’я та турбота про себе: онлайн-консультації корпоративного лікаря та підтримка ментального здоров’я з психологом, оплачувані лікарняні та 20 робочих днів відпустки, батьківська година (1 раз на тиждень).
  • Можливості розвитку: Performance Review з індивідуальним планом розвитку на рік, компенсація вивчення іноземних мов та професійного навчання, бонусна програма для підтримки хобі та відпочинку ріакомівців.
RIA.com — соціально відповідальна українська компанія. «Авто для ЗСУ» від AUTO.RIA — це фандрейзинговий проєкт, який офіційно працює з 2023 року. Завдяки активному залученню команди, креативним ініціативам і колабораціям із зірками та українським бізнесом, ми придбали та відправили більше 40 автівок: пікапи, позашляховики, тягачі та вантажівки для військових у найгарячіші напрямки.

Responsibilities

The Peraton Health, State and Local Sector is seeking a Software Development, Lead Associate to join us in supporting and maintaining the Medicare Fee For Service claims processing system. In this role, you will be a senior technical contributor on an Agile team providing maintenance and operations support for the Medicare Durable Medical Equipment ( DME) contract. 

As a Software Development, Lead Associate, you will you will work within a highly structured and rigorous development environment that follows the SAFe Agile/Scrum framework. This role focuses on handling project coordination and technical design to hands-on coding, unit testing, and defect resolution across functional areas of the mainframe legacy DME system.

Quality is vital to this mission, the role will build and execute unit test plans, test cases, and test data including COBOL and Assembler components. This role will also handle installing changes into internal testing regions, troubleshooting and resolving defects, identifying process improvements, and keeping technical documentation current. Additionally, this Lead Associate role will be translating customer goals and requirements into actionable work items for the team, while serving as a technical resource and mentor to developers.

Responsibilities:   

  • Design, codes, and unit tests, and debugs enhancements and fixes to the health claims processing system while adhering to strict coding standards.
  • Participates as a senior member of a persistent Agile development team supporting maintenance and operations.
  • Leads and completes development of complex components within the mainframe environment.
  • Works with minimal direction, exercising independent judgement on technical approaches and solutions.
  • Leads and participates in design activities, providing technical guidance on maintenance solutions.
  • Demonstrates advanced use and application of development concepts, practices, and techniques.
  • Designs, prepares and executes unit tests; represents team to clients on technical matters.
  • Provides solutions to a wide variety of complex technical problems.
  • Contributes to strategic technical direction of the development teams.
  • Applies technical knowledge to deliver maintenance solutions across multiple technology areas with minimal direction.
  • Implements end-user and enterprise solutions of high complexity with minimal direction.
  • Integrates deep technical expertise and business understanding to deliver stable, reliable solutions for clients.
  • Consults with team members and other organizations, clients and vendors on complex technical issues.
  • Provides time and resource estimates for assigned tasks and projects.
  • Develops solutions to complex business and technology problems in areas of proven expertise.
  • Mentors and provides technical guidance to junior and mid-level developers on the team.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: BS/BA with 6+ years of relevant experience; or Masters with 4 years of relevant experience; or HS diploma with 10+ years experience.
  • 6+ years of mainframe development experience in production or maintenance environment.
  • Proficiency with mainframe technologies including COBOL, JCL, CICS, TSO and VSAM.
  • Knowledge of health care claims processing, particularly Medicare Fee for Service.
  • Ability to perform well in a highly rigorous structured development environment.
  • Demonstrated experience as a senior software developer in a mainframe environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to determine and decompose business and technical requirements.
  • Application lifecycle methodology experience, specifically Agile/SCRUM
  • Strong communication skills and technical writing ability.
  • Ability to develop application project solutions and estimating.
  • Experience with Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, DME or Medicare Common Working File (CWF) specific processing systems.
  • Experience working with or in support of CMS programs and contracts.
  • Experience with DevOps/DevSecOps tools and frameworks through plan, define, build, test, release and deploy process.
  • Familiarity with development and collaboration tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Eclipse (IDz/RDz)
  • SAFe experience and/or certification.
  • Must be able to achieve and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Must be a US Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Assembler language in a mainframe environment.
  • Familiarity with development and collaboration tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Eclipse (IDz/RDz).
  • Exposure to modern languages such as Java or Python.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. jobs.description:
About this role:

Our teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market, strategically acquiring new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities, then uncovering opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Our reps own and drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure. They then transition new clients to the account management team for ongoing value delivery.

Our teams are relentless about building trust-based, value add relationships with clients, delivering long-term client value, and building their book of business over time. We are results driven, client committed, and highly collaborative.

Our reps will be given a territory of Large Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. In our GBS Large Enterprise segment, working with prospects with +$1bil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Seek out and drive new business opportunities with new-to-Gartner organizations across your territory, from initial client outreach to close, targeting Large Enterprise organizations.

  • Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics ensuring KPI’s are met.

  • Align the right combination of insight, guidance, and practical tools to bring value to the partnership.

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

  • 5+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.

  • Business development or new-client acquisition experience in a selling role highly desired.

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives.

  • Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree desired

Progression within Roles:

Gartner offers a lifetime of opportunities driven by our growth. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

Gartner has a promote from within culture and limitless opportunities for progression. Gartner leaders embrace this culture and are focused on helping associates achieve success in current role, as well as coaching associates to the next role or path, whether it be more senior levels, account management paths, or sales leadership.

Most of our Sales Managers and Team Leads are hired internally as part of our progression path.

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual "Winners Circle" event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 102,000 USD - 147,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. The Vaccines Health and Science Professional (HSP) is responsible for the promotion of a Vaccines Portfolio across customers and channels. This position will require regular live in field customer engagement in addition to virtual engagements.

The HSP is accountable for launching new products, deciding upon the best strategies to manage business relationships, understanding, and securing formulary access, and engaging in product promotion within the assigned geography. In addition, the HSP is charged with sales efforts and relationship development with customers and accounts, including Therapeutic Area Specialists, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).

The HSP should possess customer, market and business acumen combined with strong product and disease state knowledge; demonstrate strong sales, strategic business development, account management skills and in-depth customer engagement expertise in both virtual and in-person settings; utilize a systematic approach to virtual engagement (e.g., clear agenda, next steps/follow ups); have outstanding communications skills; be adept in the operation of digital and virtual tools/multi-platforms skills.   • Compliantly leverages product and disease state knowledge using approved clinically oriented disease state information and patient resources, as applicable

  • Collaborate effectively and compliantly with cross-functional colleagues, including Field Medical and Account Management, to address customer inquiries and advance Pfizer objectives

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in one or more of the following OR an associate’s degree with 6+ years of experience; OR high school diploma (or equivalent) with 8+ years of relevant experience:

  • Professional Sales or Promotional Activity

  • Small Business Owner or other Entrepreneurial experience, Marketing, Customer Service and/or Account Management

  • Relevant Healthcare/Scientific roles (e.g., RN, Pharmacist, PT, OT, etc.)

  • Educator (e.g., Teacher, Principal)

  • Full time Military experience

  • Must live within 25 miles of the border of the territory

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 1 year of pharmaceutical, biotech, medical sales and/or medical related marketing

  • Strong track record of sales or marketing success, strong territory management skills, outstanding communications skills, as well as demonstrated teamwork, leadership ability and accountability

Role Purpose

The Operations & Offices Manager is responsible for ensuring that BlackStone eIT's people, assets, compliance, and facilities operate reliably and consistently across all company locations. With offices spanning the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, and Morocco, and a large consultant workforce distributed across multiple countries, the role demands strong operational discipline, cross-border coordination capability, and the ability to lead a geographically dispersed team of varying skill levels.

Reporting directly to the Chief Process Officer, the successful candidate will be expected to run the Operations function with a high degree of autonomy — resolving day-to-day challenges independently, managing upward in a structured and concise manner, and maintaining consistently high standards of service to the business and its employees.

Key Responsibilities

People Operations — Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process for new joiners across all company geographies, ensuring Day 1 readiness in coordination with HR, IT, and Finance.
  • Manage the procurement, preparation, and handover of equipment to new joiners, maintaining accurate asset records throughout.
  • Oversee the full offboarding process, including equipment recovery, insurance cancellations, and all required documentation before a leaver is formally closed.
  • Manage employee medical insurance enrolment on joining and cancellation on exit, liaising directly with insurance providers and country coordinators.

Visa, Immigration & Compliance

  • Manage employee visa issuance, renewals, and cancellations across UAE, KSA, Jordan, and Egypt, coordinating with PROs and government authorities.
  • Maintain a proactive tracking system for all visa, permit, and commercial registration expiry dates — initiating renewals well ahead of deadlines.
  • Oversee company commercial licences and registrations across all operating jurisdictions.
  • Ensure full compliance with regional labour laws in the UAE, KSA, Jordan, Egypt, and the US, and maintain readiness for audits at all times.

Payroll & Finance Operations Support

  • Review and approve all Operations-originated payroll inputs — expense additions, deductions, and reimbursements — submitted by country coordinators before they reach the HR payroll cycle.
  • Ensure country-level payroll and expense submissions are accurate, complete, and delivered on time each month.
  • Coordinate with HR Payroll to resolve any Operations-originated variances or exceptions prior to Finance submission.

Office & Facilities Management

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API. Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.

As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.

We're looking for an Offensive Security Engineer to think like an attacker and validate the security of Array's products through real-world exploitation. You’re a paid hacker; you'll operate with full access to our applications, source code, and infrastructure to identify vulnerabilities that create meaningful business risk—not theoretical findings. AI should be one of your primary tools, enabling you to analyze large codebases, accelerate hypothesis generation, and increase testing coverage while relying on your own judgment to validate results.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of offensive security, application security, penetration testing, or red team experience with a track record of finding real application vulnerabilities.
  • Deep expertise in modern web applications, APIs, authentication, authorization, distributed systems, and the OWASP Top 10.
  • Experience developing proof-of-concept exploits that demonstrate real business impact, not just theoretical risk.
  • Proficiency using AI to accelerate vulnerability discovery, exploit development, code analysis, and security research while validating AI-generated output.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex vulnerabilities, attack paths, and remediation guidance to engineering teams.
  • A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.

You Will:

  • Identify, validate, and demonstrate realistic attack paths against Array's products, infrastructure, and internal systems with a focus on business impact.
  • Analyze large, multi-language codebases using AI and manual techniques to uncover vulnerabilities, generate exploit hypotheses, and perform variant analysis.
  • Build safe proof-of-concept exploits that demonstrate unauthorized access, privilege escalation, data exposure, business logic flaws, or other meaningful security risks.
  • Partner with engineering to validate remediations, confirm exploit paths are fully eliminated, and identify similar patterns elsewhere in the environment.
  • Document findings with clear evidence, technical root cause, business impact, and practical remediation guidance while continuously improving Array's offensive security capabilities.
  • Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it’s your default, not an afterthought.

Success Looks Like:

  • Demonstrated exploit paths to sensitive data, unauthorized access, or privilege escalation.
  • Security gaps identified that were not detected by existing tools or processes.
  • High-confidence validation that engineering fixes eliminate vulnerabilities and related attack paths.
  • Meaningful system coverage supported by documented testing methodology, whether vulnerabilities are found or not.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Job Summary

Senior Compliance Review Specialist

Aptive is seeking a Senior Compliance Review Specialist to plan and conduct structured compliance reviews for a federal health program. The role will help validate that participating organizations, service providers, or program stakeholders continue to meet applicable requirements and maintain sufficient supporting records.

The Senior Compliance Review Specialist will develop risk-informed review procedures, coordinate information requests, assess evidence, document findings, and support corrective-action follow-up. This position requires sound professional judgment, independence, tactful stakeholder engagement, and strong command of compliance documentation.

The ideal candidate has experience conducting operational, programmatic, monitoring, or compliance reviews and can build an approach that is rigorous, consistent, and proportionate to program risk.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a risk-informed compliance review methodology, review plan, procedures, evidence standards, templates, and checklists aligned with government direction.
  • Conduct reviews to validate program participation, services or activities performed, supporting documentation, operating practices, and continued compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Prepare and manage information request logs, receipt confirmations, evidence inventories, and follow-up correspondence.
  • Assess the sufficiency, reliability and consistency of submitted records and identify exceptions, control gaps and potential noncompliance.
  • Conduct interviews or virtual walkthroughs, as authorized, to understand operating practices and validate documentary evidence.
  • Document review scope, methodology, testing performed, findings, supporting evidence, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Classify findings by severity and risk and coordinate escalation of significant issues to the Project Manager.
  • Maintain complete, organized and review-ready audit workpapers with clear traceability between evidence, testing and conclusions.
  • Monitor corrective actions and validate closure documentation when requested.
  • Analyze cross-cutting audit trends and recommend program controls, applicant guidance, SOP updates or targeted technical assistance.

  • Knowledge of audit principles, evidence sufficiency, sampling, workpaper documentation and corrective-action tracking.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreDigible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform, the first of its kind.

At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

Core Values

  • Authenticity. The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.
  • Curiosity. The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.
  • Focus. The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.
  • Humility. The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".
  • Happiness. The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role

Digible is looking for an Insights & Analytics Strategist to join our Data team.

Our Data team owns the governed semantic layer, the Silver and Gold data models, and the trusted metric definitions that the rest of Digible builds on. This role sits next to that foundation but faces outward. It closes the gap between the data we already collect and the decisions our agency teams make every day for our roughly 1,000 multifamily clients.

You'll dig into data sources that aren't being used well today, turn them into client and business insight, and work directly with our Agency Solutions team to put that insight into action on real client accounts. This isn't a dashboard-building role, and it isn't a pure data engineering role either. Think of it as the connective tissue between the two: you take the semantic layer's trusted foundation, add in data nobody has operationalized yet, and put both to work alongside the agency. We'll measure your success by the decisions and outcomes you influence on client accounts, not just the reports you hand off.

You'll report to our Director of Data and partner most closely with our Director of Agency Solutions, sitting within a roughly 20-person technology department. You'll also work with Analytics Engineering on data foundations and Data Science when a question needs deeper modeling.

You'll Love This Job If You:

  • Embrace Digible's core values: authenticity, curiosity, focus, humility, and happiness
  • Enjoy turning a pile of underused data (call recordings, CRM activity, client financials) into a clear, defensible insight
  • Care as much about driving action as about being right. You're not satisfied until the insight changes what someone does
  • Like being embedded with a business team, understanding their goals well enough to see their next question coming
  • Move easily between analysis, storytelling, and stakeholder conversations
  • Don't mind taking a manual, one-off analysis and turning it into a repeatable pipeline or report
  • Already use AI tools as a normal part of how you explore, synthesize, and communicate
  • Are comfortable in ambiguity and don't need someone else to define your scope for you
  • Bring a customer-first mentality and genuine curiosity to your work
  • Want the impact of your work to show up in a client outcome, not just a delivered report

What You'll Do:

  • Operationalize Customer Analytics data. Build the pipeline and analysis to turn call and meeting intelligence into structured signal the agency can act on, closing today's biggest analytical blind spot
  • Deliver client and account insight that goes beyond financial performance: client segmentation, health signals, and account-level narrative that support client dossiers and QBR prep
  • Work embedded in agency workflows, close enough to Agency Solutions and account teams to understand their open questions, turning ad hoc requests into recurring, trustworthy analysis
  • Turn insight into action. Don't stop at the finding; work with agency partners to define the recommended action, track whether it was taken, and follow up on the outcome
  • Build analytics products that give account teams and clients a shared view of account health
  • Be a bridge to the governed semantic layer by pulling from and helping extend the Analytics Engineering team's trusted metric definitions, rather than building parallel, ungoverned ones. Flag gaps back to that team instead of working around them
  • Prove out ROI early. As a new, cross-functional role, you'll need a track record of concrete, attributable wins that justify continued investment

How Success Will Be Measured:

  • First 90 days: A subset of customer analytics data operationalized into at least one repeatable analysis, and a first client insight delivered and acted on by the agency team
  • Days 90 to 180: A small portfolio of insight-to-action wins tied to specific client accounts, with outcomes tracked, and clear handoff patterns established with Analytics Engineering for anything that should graduate into the governed semantic layer
  • Ongoing: A growing, attributable track record of insights that changed what the agency did on a client account, not just insights that were delivered

What You Should Have:

  • 4+ years of experience in an analytics, insights, or analytics-engineering role, ideally with direct exposure to a client-facing or agency/consulting environment
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort querying a modern cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) to go from raw data to insight on your own
  • Experience turning unstructured or semi-structured data (call transcripts, CRM notes, support tickets) into structured, analyzable signal
  • A track record of working directly with non-technical stakeholders: shaping a question, delivering an answer, and following through to action
  • Comfort with BI and reporting tools for both client-facing and internal analysis
  • Strong storytelling and written and verbal communication skills. You can make a data point land in a client or leadership conversation
  • Real fluency with AI-assisted tools in your analytical workflow, not just occasional use
  • A bias toward iterative, value-focused delivery. You'd rather ship a rough answer this week than a perfect one next quarter
  • Comfort operating with real ambiguity in a role that is still being defined
  • Comfort working without a Tech Lead or EM buffering your day-to-day technical direction. This is a standalone seat, not one embedded in an engineering pod

What Will Set You Apart:

  • Experience in a digital marketing agency, multifamily/real estate, or other client-services environment
  • Experience with conversation intelligence tools (Gong, Chorus, or similar) and turning them into structured analytics
  • Experience building client segmentation or account health scoring models
  • Familiarity with dbt, MetricFlow, or other semantic-layer tooling, even if you won't own it in this role
  • Experience navigating a dotted-line or matrixed reporting structure without losing momentum

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

This role is open to candidates located within the United States.

While this job description outlines the core expectations of the role, it's not a full list of everything you'll do at Digible. We believe in leaning in by hitting your key goals, sharing insights, and finding new ways to elevate performance, process, and client success.

Pay, Perks and More!

  • Salary Range: $125,000 to $145,000
  • 4-Day Work Week (32 Hour Work Week)
  • WFA (Work From Anywhere)
  • Discretionary Bonus
  • We offer 3 weeks of PTO as well as Sick leave, and Bereavement

HEADS UP! We believe in transparency throughout our hiring process. To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA DGXC Storage team handles some of the fastest training and inference tasks. Every GPU cycle depends on a storage platform built to keep tens of thousands of accelerators continuously busy. It maintains exabytes of data securely and powers the largest AI workloads worldwide across cloud, neocloud, and on-prem setups. With the growth of accelerated computing, storage is essential. It can make the difference between effective GPU use and wasted potential, and between launching a frontier model on time or missing the deadline by months. We’re looking for a hands-on Storage Software Engineer to join the storage team as an individual contributor and technical lead. You will contribute to open-source parallel and distributed file systems and keep our largest GPU clusters fast, reliable, and durable. You will stay deeply hands-on: writing and reviewing production code, chasing root causes in the field, and setting the configuration and tuning standards our GPU fleets run on. This is a chance to do foundational storage engineering for the AI era at the company that introduced accelerated computing.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Contribute to open-source file systems. Contribute code to open-source parallel and distributed file systems, and distributed object storage. Upstream fixes and features, and engage directly with the upstream communities and maintainers.

  • Serve as a hands-on storage software lead. Write and review production code yourself, and read kernel, NFS, NVMe-oF, or SPDK source when a bug requires it. Make the final technical calls on storage deliveries against measurable targets.

  • Triage and troubleshoot at scale. Triage, troubleshoot, and root-cause large, complex storage issues across very large GPU clusters (tens of thousands of GPUs) — I/O and metadata performance, data corruption, and recovery.

  • Validate architecture and capabilities. Validate storage architecture, capabilities, performance, and durability. Run scale tests, benchmarks, and recovery drills, and qualify new builds against measurable performance and durability targets.

  • Recommend configuration, tuning, and guidelines. Define and recommend configuration, tuning, and operational best practices for high-performance file systems on GPU infrastructure, and help operators and internal customers apply them.

  • Partner broadly. Work with training, inference, and accelerated-computing teams, site-reliability and operations, networking, and security, and collaborate with cloud providers, neocloud operators, and storage vendors on a common architecture.
