jobs.description:
Position Title:Agile Transformation SME
Location: Remote (In the U.S)

Other Considerations:U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Required)

POSITION SUMMARY

Sprezzatura Management Consulting is seeking a senior Enterprise Agile Transformation Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join the company’s Lean-Agile Center of Excellence (LACE). The SME will serve as an internal Agile consultant and transformation leader, deployed to strategic programs to improve delivery governance, planning, execution, predictability, transparency, and measurable customer outcomes. This is not solely a meeting facilitation or Scrum-ceremony role. It is a transformation leadership role requiring deep SAFe expertise, organizational change management capability, strong executive presence, and ability to establish, communicate, and sustain agreed delivery standards across complex organizations.

The Agile Transformation SME will spend approximately 75% of their time on a large enterprise-wide program supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs. The SME will enter an active transformation effort in which proposed changes include redesigning PI Planning, strengthening Scrum Master alignment within value streams, improving Agile governance, and consolidating Jira structures and reporting. The SME will enter during an active transition and assume senior Agile leadership responsibilities through a structured knowledge transfer. The immediate priority will be to validate the transformation roadmap with company and program leadership, establish clear decision rights, and lead execution without disrupting ongoing delivery.

The remaining capacity will support Sprezzatura's company-wide Lean-Agile Center of Excellence (LACE), cross-contract delivery standards, and other engagements as directed by the Director of Agile Delivery and Process Automation.

This position reports directly to the Director of Agile Delivery and Process Automation and operates as a member of Sprezzatura’s LACE. While assigned to customer programs, the SME will work in close partnership with the applicable Program Manager, delivery leadership, and customer stakeholders. The right candidate will serve as the functional Agile authority on assigned programs, the lead trainer and coach across Sprezzatura's delivery portfolio, and a key contributor to the company's Lean-Agile governance infrastructure.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial Strategic Assignment: Enterprise IT Program Transformation (~75%)

  • Own full RTE-level authority for the program’s Agile Release Train (ART), assuming the role through a structured knowledge transfer from the current transitioning RTE. Lead and continuously improve the integrated Agile planning cadence, PI Planning activities, cross-team dependency management, and delivery coordination across designated value streams, currently including Salesforce, Microsoft, Pega, Integration, and SaaS.
  • Partner with program and value-stream leadership to establish clear Agile roles, decision rights, escalation paths, planning calendars, and standards that account for the responsibilities of Sprezzatura, VA, System Integrators, Product Owners, and other delivery partners
  • Finalize and execute the PI Planning redesign approved by company and program leadership, including the event structure, readiness criteria, planning inputs, breakout facilitation and guidance, dependency management, risk identification, confidence vote, and VA stakeholder briefing.
  • Ensure PI Planning readiness includes a prioritized Program Epic Backlog, documented requirements and dependencies, capacity and constraint information, applicable architecture and roadmap inputs, and delivery of required planning artifacts in accordance with contractual and customer deadlines.
  • Establish objective readiness and success criteria for each PI Planning cycle, including backlog readiness, stakeholder alignment, dependency visibility, achievable team plans, risk ownership, PI objectives, and defined methods for measuring results throughout the increment.
  • Coach and develop the Scrum Master cohort, strengthen Scrum Master alignment within value streams, define consistent performance expectations, and establish an effective cross-program community of practice for coaching, problem solving, standards adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Assess Scrum Master capability and program needs; recommend role assignments, development plans, training, mentoring, and organizational adjustments in partnership with program and functional leadership.
  • Partner with the Program Manager, Deputy Program Managers, and delivery leaders to build constructive relationships with VA stakeholders and delivery partners; establish documented Agile working agreements, decision paths, escalation procedures, and governance records in VA-approved repositories.
  • Influence customer and partner behavior through evidence, transparency, facilitation, and agreed governance rather than relying on positional authority.
  • Lead program-level operations: implement the Jira consolidation from 21 projects to four value-stream-aligned boards, enforce intake governance, maintain program health metrics including ART Predictability scores, and train the full program on SAFe principles.
  • Establish and maintain meaningful program health measures such as PI objective achievement, predictability, throughput, capacity, cycle time, flow, dependency aging, risk resolution, milestone performance, backlog quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Establish and sustain backlog governance that supports continuous grooming, prioritization, elaboration of business, technical, and nonfunctional requirements, and traceability among program epics, epics, stories, dependencies, defects, and PI roadmaps.
  • Establish a transparent process for evaluating and integrating new or changing VA priorities during a PI, including impact analysis for scope, capacity, schedule, dependencies, risks, and existing commitments, followed by documented customer decisions and replanning as appropriate.
  • Lead Inspect and Adapt activities, retrospectives, root-cause analysis, corrective-action planning, and follow-through to ensure lessons learned result in measurable changes to delivery performance.
  • Build sustainable internal capability by transferring knowledge, developing program leaders and practitioners, documenting standards, and reducing long-term dependence on individual Agile experts.

Company-Wide Agile Center of Excellence (25%)

  • Support the Director of Agile Delivery and Process Automation in maturing and operating Sprezzatura's LACE, including company-wide Agile delivery SOPs, SM coaching infrastructure, and cross-contract delivery standards, under COO-level sponsorship.
  • Conduct Agile maturity assessments on Specialized Services and other Sprezzatura contracts, producing evidence-based findings reports and prioritized remediation roadmaps.
  • Design and deliver the Sprezzatura Delivery Academy and support the ongoing operation of the company OKR/CFR system, including objective-setting, KR development, and the Conversation, Feedback, and Recognition cadence.
  • Support other Sprezzatura contracts as directed, advising on Agile governance and coaching teams through transformation milestones.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree with 18+ years of relevant experience, including demonstrated leadership of large-scale Agile transformations in complex federal or enterprise environments.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior program-level Agile leadership roles (RTE, Agile Coach, or Transformation Lead) on programs of 200+ people across multiple teams.
  • Current SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC) certification. SAFe RTE strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end PI Planning events at scale, including pre-event design, cross-team dependency mapping, breakout facilitation, confidence vote management, and post-event I&A.
  • Proven track record of assessing underperforming or inconsistent delivery environments, identifying structural and behavioral impediments, building an evidence-based case for change, and implementing improvements while protecting ongoing customer delivery.
  • Experience designing and standing up Lean-Agile Centers of Excellence or equivalent governance bodies, including charter development, standards ownership, SM coaching infrastructure, and transformational backlog management.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and delivering SAFe training to large, diverse audiences including technical teams, product owners, program leadership, and government stakeholders.
  • Strong VA or federal agency stakeholder management experience, including ability to align government clients on Agile standards, manage verbal override attempts diplomatically, and build constructive VA champion relationships.
  • Prior experience in building a comprehensive digital workplace with customer experience focused outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience developing strategic roadmaps, measurable milestones, transformation backlogs, and execution plans, and aligning team-level delivery to program objectives and customer outcomes.
  • Experience conducting Agile maturity assessments and producing evidence-based findings reports, root cause analysis, and prioritized improvement roadmaps.
  • Advanced proficiency with Jira in large, multi-team environments, including project and board design, workflow configuration, permission and governance models, hierarchy and traceability standards, dashboards, reporting, data quality, consolidation planning, and Scrum and Kanban operating models.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and governing enterprise-wide Agile SOPs, playbooks, and delivery standards applicable across multiple contracts or business units.
  • Excellent communication skills across all levels, including team-level coaching, executive briefings, government client management, and written documentation. Ability to lead with evidence, not opinion.
  • Demonstrated organizational change-management experience, including stakeholder analysis, communication planning, adoption measurement, resistance management, leadership alignment, and sustainment.
  • Experience defining and using Agile and flow metrics - including predictability, throughput, cycle time, capacity, work in progress, dependency aging, backlog health, and objective achievement - to diagnose performance and guide decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance framework discipline with contractual requirements, customer constraints, operational work, and the needs of teams using Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery models
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA suitability determination/Public Trust designation and any other customer-required access or clearance associated with assigned engagements.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting VA DTC, OIT, or other VA digital modernization programs.
  • Experience designing and facilitating OKR/CFR operating systems at the program or company level.
  • Familiarity with federal security and authorization processes (ATO, SECURS, CAM/ServiceNow transitions).
  • Experience navigating multi-vendor, multi-prime contractor delivery environments with shared milestone accountability.
  • Background in professional services or government contracting firm environments, including understanding of how delivery standards translate across contracts with different clients, scopes, and team compositions.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Standard Business hours are Monday through Friday. Occasional extended or weekend hours may be required based on operational needs. Periodic travel to customers, company and program events as required. Must have reliable internet service that allows for effective telecommuting.

PAY RANGE

The base salary range for this position is $190,000 to $230,000 annually, depending on geographic work location, relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, security clearance, and contract requirements. Geographic salary ranges are determined in accordance with the company's compensation practices and represent a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting.

BENEFITS

Sprezzatura offers a comprehensive and flexible benefit package to include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Health Saving Account (when enrolled in eligible plan) with Company contribution
  • Company paid Life, Accidental Death, Short-term & Long-term Disability
  • Voluntary Accident, Hospital Indemnity, & Critical Care Insurance
  • Voluntary Medical & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Accrued Paid Time Off & Company Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company match

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Sprezzatura participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Sprezzaturais a mission-driven, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that thrives at the intersection of technology, innovation, and impact. We specialize in secure, scalable, and human-centered digital solutions that accelerate government transformation. Our work spans DevSecOps, health IT modernization, intelligent automation, benefits delivery, and digital communications. We partner with agencies ready to evolve—delivering not just strategy, but measurable execution. Rooted in operational excellence and driven by curiosity, we help our clients navigate complexity with clarity, turning ambitious ideas into real-world outcomes. No buzzwords. Just impact.

EEO STATEMENT

Sprezzatura is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants have the right to discuss, disclose, or inquire about compensation without retaliation. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
FMX is looking for a strategic, execution-minded Director of Product Marketing to lead our product marketing function and serve as the connective tissue across product, sales, and demand generation. This is a player-coach role: you'll set the vision for how FMX communicates value to the market while managing and developing a team of product marketing managers. You'll partner with leaders across the go-to-market organization to make sure positioning, launches, and enablement translate directly into pipeline and revenue.

Responsibilities:

As the Director of Product Marketing, you will:

  • Own the strategic direction for product marketing, establishing positioning, messaging, and launch frameworks that align product, sales, and marketing around one go-to-market motion.
  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of product marketing managers, building a function that scales alongside FMX's product roadmap and growth goals.
  • Serve as the primary connector between Product, Sales, and Demand Generation, ensuring GTM plans have clear ownership, timelines, and shared accountability across teams.
  • Lead market research into FMX’s target segments to define our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), perform Total Addressable Market (TAM) analysis, and provide targeting guidance for our GTM teams.
  • Set the standard for how FMX plans and executes go-to-market launches, from early positioning through post-launch adoption and retention.
  • Direct ongoing competitive analysis and market research to sharpen FMX's differentiation and inform product and sales strategy at the leadership level.
  • Ensure the sales organization has the messaging, collateral, and training needed to sell confidently, and measure enablement's impact on win rates and deal velocity.
  • Represent product marketing in leadership conversations, translating market and competitive insight into clear, confident recommendations for the executive team.
  • Define and report on KPIs that connect product marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and retention outcomes.

Requirements

Preferred Experience & Qualities:
What are we looking for in this role?:

  • 10+ years in product marketing, including 5+ years leading or managing a product marketing team, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Familiarity with facilities management, education, or government is a plus.
  • A confident, assertive communicator who can influence senior stakeholders and represent product marketing at the leadership table and with strategic prospects and customers.
  • A track record of moving quickly from strategy to execution and driving urgency across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product marketers into strong strategic partners.
  • Able to synthesize market, competitive, and product data into a clear point of view that shapes company strategy.
  • A track record of building trust and alignment across product, sales, and marketing leadership.
  • A match with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence and Integrity

The hiring process for this role:

    • Apply! Submit your resume and answers to the application questions below via the Workable portal
    • Phone screen with PeopleOps: A 30-minute conversation to review your background and experiences, discuss the culture at FMX, and ensure that you understand the general expectations for the role. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about compensation, benefits, etc.
    • Hiring manager conversation: A 60-minute conversation with the VP of Marketing and CSO.
    • Product Leadership Conversation: A 60-minute conversation with the CPO and VP of Product.
    • PMM Conversation: A 60-minute peer interview with the Product Marketing team.
    • On-site Panel: A day in person with marketing, product, and sales leadership.
    • Offer & Onboarding: Candidates who receive an offer will be required to complete a background check prior to onboarding. New hires are also expected to work onsite at our Columbus, OH office during their first week to complete onboarding and connect with the team in person.

Benefits

FMX Benefits and Life at FMX:

  • You’ll make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction of our product and the future of our company.
  • Competitive benefits: 100% company-paid health, dental, vision, long and short term disability, and life insurance.
  • Work from home: At FMX, we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We host one all-company event a year to ensure that you can put a face to a name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and coworkers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.
  • Home office stipend: We’ll give you everything necessary to do your job (company sponsored laptop, headset, etc.). We will also provide up to $500 to help with equipment, furniture and accessories. You will also get $60/month toward your home internet connection.
  • Generous PTO and UTO (unplanned time off) policies: If you’re sick, why should that cut into your vacation time?
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible schedule to help you manage personal appointments, such as doctor or dentist visits, as long as you're meeting performance expectations and project timelines.
  • You’ll enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.

Compensation:

  • The base salary range for this position is expected to be $140,000-150,000. There is also bonus potential.
  • 401(k) and medical / dental / vision / short and long term disability / life insurance.

Other Considerations: The candidate for this position can be located anywhere in the US.

Company:

FMX was founded in Columbus, Ohio, and is a remote-first organization headquartered “in the cloud”. We develop cloud-based, software-as-a-service facility maintenance and management product, enabling our customers to streamline processes, increase asset productivity, and turn actionable insights into meaningful results. Serving education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets, FMX is one of the fastest-growing companies in its space! Check us out at:

Job Title: Web Optimization Consultant

Contract Type: Consultant

Contract Duration: August - December 2026

Location: Remote

Application Deadline: 15 August 2026 (Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible)

Compensation: USD 30-60 per hour

Summary:

The Institute for War and Peace Reporting (IWPR) is seeking a Web Optimization Consultant to provide technical and strategic support to independent media outlets operating in restrictive environments across Latin America. The consultancy will focus on strengthening the overall performance of participating media websites by optimizing their architecture, content structure, technical performance, user experience, and search engine visibility, with the objective of increasing their visibility, organic traffic, and digital reach.

The consultant will conduct technical assessments of the assigned websites and work closely with editorial and technical teams to design and implement improvement plans tailored to each outlet's capacities and needs. The consultancy will also provide guidance on information architecture, technical optimization, SEO, content organization, website performance, accessibility, indexing, web analytics, and best practices to improve the discoverability and

consumption of journalistic content.

All advisory support must respect the editorial independence of the participating media outlets and strictly comply with IWPR's established security protocols.

The consultant must maintain close coordination with IWPR throughout the assignment, demonstrate flexibility to work remotely with teams that may face connectivity limitations or operate under challenging conditions, and strictly adhere to all established security procedures.

For more information on IWPR, please follow the link:

Scope of Work:

  • Provide remote, tailored web optimization advisory support to independent media outlets throughout the project implementation period.
  • Conduct technical and functional assessments of websites to identify opportunities for improvement related to information architecture, navigation, performance, accessibility, user experience, SEO, indexing, and content organization.
  • Design and implement web optimization plans tailored to the capacities, resources, and technological platforms of each media outlet.
  • Hold regular virtual meetings with beneficiary media teams to monitor the implementation of recommendations, address questions, and make adjustments throughout the process.
  • Provide technical support for optimizing content structure, taxonomies, internal linking, metadata, page speed, and other elements that contribute to improving overall website performance and search engine visibility.
  • Advise media teams on the use of monitoring and analytics tools to evaluate website performance, interpret results, and prioritize improvement actions.
  • Apply a practical, results-oriented methodology based on continuous follow-up, performance indicators, and documented deliverables.
  • Ensure full compliance at all times with IWPR's security protocols and reporting requirements.

Functions:

  • Conduct an initial assessment of each assigned website to identify opportunities for improvement and develop a work plan with measurable objectives and performance indicators.
  • Provide technical support throughout the implementation of improvements related to website architecture, performance, user experience, SEO, content organization, and other aspects of web optimization.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize the structure, functionality, and visibility of websites by applying international best practices and standards adapted to the context of independent media outlets.
  • Advise media teams on the use of analytics and monitoring tools to evaluate website performance and prioritize evidence-based improvement actions.
  • Hold regular virtual meetings with beneficiary media teams to monitor the implementation of recommendations, review progress, and address technical challenges.
  • Maintain close coordination with the IWPR team to share progress, identify challenges, recommend adjustments when necessary, and ensure compliance with project objectives, timelines, security protocols, and reporting requirements.

Minimum requirements:

  • Proven experience (minimum of 5 years) in website optimization, digital consulting, technical SEO, information architecture, or related fields.
  • Strong knowledge of website architecture, user experience (UX), website performance, technical optimization, indexing, on-page SEO, and best practices for improving search engine visibility.
  • Experience conducting website audits and designing optimization plans with measurable objectives and outcomes.
  • Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, PageSpeed, Insights, Lighthouse, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent platforms for website analysis and optimization.
  • Ability to interpret website performance metrics and develop evidence-based technical and strategic recommendations.
  • Ability to work remotely with teams operating in complex environments or with limited connectivity.
  • Experience working with digital media organizations will be considered an asset but is not a mandatory requirement.
  • Fluency in Spanish is required. Knowledge of English is desirable.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and IWPR reserves the right to fill the position before the closing date; early applications are therefore strongly encouraged, and interviews may be conducted prior to the deadline. IWPR will offer a competitive salary to the successful applicant.

Principals only. No calls please. Only those who have been considered for an interview will be contacted.

IWPR is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, veteran status or pregnancy and maternity. IWPR will never ask for payment for recruitment.

------

El resumen:

El Institute for War and Peace Reporting (IWPR) busca contratar un/a Consultor/a de Optimización Web para brindar apoyo técnico y estratégico a medios de comunicación independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina. La consultoría se centrará en fortalecer el desempeño integral de los sitios web de los medios participantes mediante la optimización de su arquitectura, estructura de contenidos, rendimiento técnico, experiencia de usuario y posicionamiento en motores de búsqueda, con el objetivo de incrementar su visibilidad, tráfico orgánico y alcance digital.

El/la consultor/a realizará diagnósticos técnicos de los sitios web asignados y trabajará de manera cercana con los equipos editoriales y técnicos para diseñar e implementar planes de mejora adaptados a las capacidades y necesidades de cada medio. Asimismo, brindará asesoría sobre arquitectura de la información, optimización técnica, SEO, organización de contenidos, rendimiento del sitio, accesibilidad, indexación, analítica web y mejores prácticas para mejorar el descubrimiento y consumo de contenidos periodísticos.

Todo el acompañamiento deberá respetar la independencia editorial de los medios participantes y cumplir estrictamente con los protocolos de seguridad establecidos por IWPR.

El/la consultor/a deberá mantener una coordinación permanente con IWPR durante toda la consultoría, demostrar flexibilidad para trabajar de forma remota con equipos que pueden enfrentar limitaciones de conectividad o desenvolverse en contextos complejos, y aplicar rigurosamente todos los procedimientos de seguridad establecidos.

Alcance de la consultoría:

  • Brindar asesoría remota y personalizada en optimización web a medios de comunicación independientes durante el período de implementación del proyecto.
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos y funcionales de los sitios web para identificar oportunidades de mejora relacionadas con arquitectura de información, navegación, rendimiento, accesibilidad, experiencia de usuario, SEO, indexación y organización de contenidos.

  • Mantener reuniones virtuales periódicas con los equipos de los medios beneficiarios para dar seguimiento a la implementación de las recomendaciones, revisar avances y resolver desafíos técnicos.

Requerimientos mínimos:

  • Experiencia trabajando con medios de comunicación digitales será considerada una ventaja, pero no constituye un requisito indispensable.

Las solicitudes se revisarán de forma continua y el IWPR se reserva el derecho de cubrir el puesto antes de la fecha límite. SailPoint's Cybersecurity organization is seeking a Sr. Security Software Engineer with a passion for cybersecurity and protecting the organization.

By building these advanced integrations, you will unlock maximum value and next-level security controls from our existing investments, giving you the unique opportunity to directly shape the future of our technical defenses and drive the execution of our overarching security program.

You will join a highly capable team of emerging and established talent, collaborating across Security Operations, IT, and Engineering to serve as a technical ambassador for the Cyber organization. We need a builder who naturally embodies SailPoint's 4 I's (Individual, Impact, Innovation, and Integrity) - someone who eagerly embraces complex challenges and acts as a positive, driving force within our thriving work culture. Ultimately, your innovative solutions will not only secure our enterprise but contribute meaningfully to the broader cyber ecosystem.

This position can be remote or based in Austin, TX.

Responsibilities:

  • Architect and develop robust, scalable custom security tools, middleware, and automation scripts that integrate isolated security platforms (e.g., Identity/Entra ID, MDM/Intune, EDR, SIEM, and SaaS apps)

  • Identify limitations in out-of-the-box vendor capabilities (such as custom mobile application management enforcement or complex access workflows) and build resilient custom software to close those gaps
  • Design and develop intuitive user interfaces (UIs) and dashboards for internal security tools, ensuring they are accessible and highly usable for Security Operations and business personnel
  • Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines for security controls, incident response playbooks (SOAR), and continuous monitoring workflows

  • Proactively ensure all custom development meets strict information security, secure coding (SSDLC), and compliance standards (e.g., ISO, NIST, SOX, etc.)

Background & Experience:

Job Summary

As a Senior Instructional System Designer supporting the VHA AI Education Hub (TOPR 0032), you will lead the design and development of AI-focused learning programs that equip Veterans Health Administration staff with the knowledge and skills needed to navigate an increasingly AI-integrated healthcare environment. Working within a federal healthcare context, you will collaborate with VHA subject matter experts, clinical stakeholders, and program leadership to build scalable, role-based learning pathways rooted in occupational analysis and adult learning principles. Your work will directly advance VHA's mission to prepare its workforce for responsible and effective AI adoption across one of the nation's largest integrated healthcare systems. The ideal candidate is a seasoned instructional designer who thrives in complex, matrixed environments and brings a research-informed, learner-centered approach to every project. You are equally comfortable leading strategic curriculum planning conversations and rolling up your sleeves to produce high-quality course content, assessments, and supporting materials on deadline.

Primary Responsibilities

Design and maintain AI Foundations and role-based learning pathways for VHA staff, ensuring content is evidence-informed, accessible, and aligned with VHA workforce development priorities and AI adoption goals. Conduct healthcare occupational analyses to identify training needs, determine learning objectives, and map task-learning relationships that form the basis for structured instructional design plans. Develop engaging course content, formative and summative assessments, job aids, facilitator guides, and other supporting instructional materials across multiple modalities (e.g., eLearning, instructor-led, blended). Coordinate with VHA subject matter experts, clinical leads, and program stakeholders to validate instructional content for accuracy, relevance, and compliance with federal healthcare and Section 508 accessibility standards. jobs.title: AI Senior Engineer - Graph
jobs.excerpt: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did.
jobs.description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

What you’ll be doing

We are seeking someone who views the Knowledge Graph not just as a database, but as a living organism that requires constant care, feeding, and pruning. You understand that a RAG system is only as good as the data underlying it. You are intrigued by the complexity of ingesting massive, messy datasets and transforming them into clean, connected knowledge.

In short, someone who likes:

  • Architecting Graph ETL: Designing and developing robust ETL pipelines specifically for graph ingestion. You aren't just dumping rows into tables; you are determining how disparate data sources connect, evolve, and relate in a graph structure.
  • Data Ingestion at Scale: Managing high-volume data streams using tools like Kafka and implementing CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns to ensure the graph reflects real-time reality.
  • Automated Graph Hygiene: Writing scripts and jobs for deduplication, orphan node detection, and data consistency checks. You take pride in a clean schema.
  • Modeling Time: Handling complex temporal relationships (e.g., how property ownership or financial status changes over time) within the graph.
  • Performance Tuning: Ensuring that as the graph grows (25k+ reports and beyond), the underlying query performance remains snappy through optimizing indexes and storage.

What we’re looking for

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

  • Neo4j Expertise (Must Have):4+ years of hands-on experience. You master Cypher, schema design, and the operational side of managing a production graph.
  • ETL & Pipeline Mastery: Strong background in building data pipelines. You know how to take raw data, clean it, and structure it for graph ingestion.
  • Streaming & CDC: Familiarity with event streaming platforms like Kafka and Change Data Capture methodologies to sync operational databases with the graph.
  • Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for writing ingestion scripts, maintenance jobs, and custom graph algorithms.
  • Data Integrity Focus: Experience implementing automated jobs for entity resolution, deduplication, and quality assurance.

Nice-to-Have:

  • C# Knowledge: Ability to read or contribute to C# codebases.
  • Domain Experience: Prior work in Finance or Real Estate sectors.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed
  • Payments made in USD
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years
  • A monthly wellness stipend and snack boxes delivered to your home

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Wireline Program Specialist is a professional-level subject matter expert responsible for the analysis, solutioning, and independent management of wireline telecommunications services supporting the Department of Energy (DOE) enterprise, including DOE Headquarters locations in Washington, D.C. and Germantown, Maryland, and approximately 150 field sites, laboratories, and customer locations nationwide.

This position requires the exercise of independent professional judgment across a broad range of complex, non-routine wireline service challenges. The Wireline Program Specialist analyzes requirements, develops solutions, and makes independent decisions on service delivery, vendor management, inventory strategy, and process improvement. Work is performed with minimal supervision and requires specialized knowledge of federal telecommunications procurement, wireline provisioning, GSA contract vehicles, and enterprise network operations.

This position works in close coordination with the federal Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), Task Monitor, CO/COR/IM-12/IM-13 team, and program management leadership, and is accountable for the quality and timeliness of all wireline program deliverables in alignment with the CBOSS PWS requirements.

Responsibilities

Wireline Services Analysis and Program Management

  • Serve as the technical authority for wireline service operations across the DOE enterprise, applying specialized knowledge of TDM, VoIP, SIP, Ethernet, POTS, and ISDN PRI to analyze requirements and develop optimal service configurations.
  • Evaluate customer requirements and independently determine appropriate service solutions for MACD (Moves, Adds, Changes, and Disconnects) activities, applying professional discretion on non-standard or complex requests.
  • Analyze service order workflows and independently identify process improvements to reduce cycle time, improve accuracy, and ensure contractual SLA compliance across DOE Headquarters and field sites.
  • Assess vendor and carrier performance against contractual obligations; independently identify deficiencies and develop corrective action recommendations for escalation or direct resolution.
  • Evaluate funding status and contracting requirements for incoming orders; apply knowledge of federal procurement rules to independently resolve funding or compliance issues before order execution.
  • Apply independent judgment to design and configure voice and data communication systems for high-visibility government clients, ensuring alignment with DOE standards and security requirements.
  • Develop and manage escalation strategies for at-risk orders across DOE customer organizations; independently determine when and how to resolve provisioning delays.
  • Evaluate and recommend adoption of emerging technologies, including Starlink satellite service integration and network modernization initiatives, to improve service delivery and reduce cost across the DOE enterprise.
  • Oversee management of the entire HQ phone number block; apply professional expertise to establish and maintain standards for assignment, tracking, and lifecycle management.

Inventory Integrity and Program Analysis

  • Establish and apply inventory management standards for all wireline services and circuits across the DOE enterprise, ensuring data integrity across the full-service lifecycle.
  • Analyze inventory data to identify systemic discrepancies, trends, and root causes; develop and implement corrective strategies.
  • Interpret Agency billing system outputs and exception reports to diagnose underlying inventory or process failures and independently determine the appropriate resolution path within required SLA timelines.
  • Evaluate vendor documentation against order records to identify patterns of error; develop vendor accountability measures and escalate recurring issues through appropriate channels.
  • Design and produce analytical reports for government and customer inquiries (e.g., circuit status, service plan analysis, upgrade eligibility).
  • Oversee capacity planning and database integrity for wireline circuit infrastructure, applying technical expertise to anticipate future service demands and recommend proactive solutions.

Documentation, SOPs & Process Improvement

  • Lead the development, review, and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for wireline service operations.
  • Lead root cause analysis for service issues and independently develop and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Oversee maintenance of accurate network and circuit diagrams, configuration records, and service documentation; establish standards for documentation quality and accessibility across the program team.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for the CO/COR/IM-12/IM-13 team on wireline matters, providing independent analysis and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with the TVT team for order submission and fulfillment tracking, applying independent judgment to resolve issues that arise during the fulfillment process.
  • Liaise with vendors, carriers, and internal DOE stakeholders to resolve service issues and manage escalations, applying independent judgment to determine appropriate resolution strategies.
  • Support GETS/WPS/TSP emergency telecommunications activities as needed, coordinating with DHS Office of Emergency Communications and ensuring DOE compliance with priority telecommunications service requirements per PWS Section 2.1.3.

Qualifications

Education Requirements 

  • Minimum of 4 years with High School Diploma.  

Required Qualifications 

  • Must be a US Citizen 
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance 
  • Experience in federal or enterprise telecommunications provisioning, systems analysis, or network operations
  • Demonstrated knowledge of wireline voice and data services, including carrier management, circuit ordering, and data service management.
  • Proficiency with inventory and ordering systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with federal leads in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience managing large-scale phone number blocks (HQ-level or enterprise-level).
  • Familiarity with conferencing services and emerging technologies such as Starlink.
  • Experience supporting DOE or other federal agency telecom programs at scale (1M+ services).
  • Knowledge of MACD processes and telecom inventory database management.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

As an Access Operations Analyst within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations team, you will be responsible for ensuring secure, timely, and efficient identity lifecycle management within HealthEquity’s technologies. This role ensures employees and business partners have timely access to the resources they need while balancing strong security controls with exceptional customer service. This role requires attention to detail, the ability to work independently, interaction with internal IT and business customers, as well as collaboration with a dynamic team. The successful candidate will have a thorough understanding of access management concepts and technologies.

What you’ll be doing

  • Identity Lifecycle Management:
    • Manage the end-to-end identity lifecycle by provisioning, modifying, and deprovisioning user access while ensuring compliance with established IAM policies and controls
    • Support Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, Exchange, and related identity platforms to maintain accurate and secure user access.
    • Configure and troubleshoot multi-factor authentication methods, including Passkeys, Yubikeys, FIDO2 credentials, and Microsoft Authenticator registrations.
  • Risk Management:
    • Work closely with the cybersecurity team to respond to incidents and implement corrective actions.

  • Experience supporting Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, and Exchange environments with a strong understanding of account administration and group management.
  • Knowledge of BeyondTrust and privileged access management practices, including administration of privileged accounts, password vaulting, and service account controls.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting MFA solutions, including YubiKey registration and Passkeys.

Job Title: Responsible AI Manager - Agentic AI Governance

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Responsible AI Manager - Agentic AI Governance

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Responsible AI Manager, Agentic AI sits within the Amgen Responsible AI team in the Artificial Intelligence & Data Science organization. You will play a key role in shaping and operationalizing practical, risk-based governance for agentic AI across Amgen, helping ensure these technologies can be used broadly, responsibly, and with appropriate controls. By enabling innovation at scale while protecting trust, quality, safety, and compliance, this work helps Amgen advance AI responsibly in support of its mission.

You will enable governance-by-design for enterprise AI capabilities, while also defining governance approaches for other agentic AI adoption patterns, including third-party solutions and embedded or configurable agentic AI capabilities in existing or new software and platforms.

This position sits at the intersection of Responsible AI governance, risk and compliance, cybersecurity, law, data science, and enterprise AI platform enablement. You will work closely with teams that own and operate enterprise AI platforms, tools, and capabilities, to translate Responsible AI, compliance and regulatory expectations into actionable governance requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of governance approaches for agentic AI, partnering with AI platform and product owners, data science teams, cybersecurity, legal, compliance, privacy, and quality functions.
  • Translate Responsible AI expectations, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements into actionable governance requirements, operational processes, and user guidance.
  • Define governance requirements for technical controls and safeguards, such as usage restrictions, access controls, human oversight, logging, anomaly detection, incident escalation, and mechanisms to pause, restrict, or disable AI-enabled functionality when appropriate.
  • Monitor emerging AI technologies, risks, standards, and regulatory developments; assess their impact on the enterprise, and evolve governance frameworks, standards, and controls to enable responsible adoption of new AI capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain Responsible AI policies, standards, playbooks, procedures, guidance, and other control documentation to support consistent AI governance, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Develop materials for leadership, governance forums, and cross-functional working groups, communicating risks, recommendations, decisions, implementation progress, and governance outcomes to support informed decision-making.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of experience in AI/ML product development, MLOps/LLMOps, data science, software engineering, Responsible AI, AI governance, AI risk, or a related field

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 4 years in AI/ML product development, MLOps/LLMOps, data science, software engineering, Responsible AI, AI governance, AI risk, or a related field

OR

Associate’s degree and 8 years in AI/ML product development, MLOps/LLMOps, data science, software engineering, Responsible AI, AI governance, AI risk, or a related field

OR

High school diploma / GED and 10 years in AI/ML product development, MLOps/LLMOps, data science, software engineering, Responsible AI, AI governance, AI risk, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications:

Must-Have Skills:

  • Technical fluency in AI/ML, generative AI, or agentic AI systems, including the ability to engage with technical teams on topics such as model and agent behavior, logging and telemetry, tool use, system prompts or instructions, configuration files, SDKs, APIs, and access controls.
  • Strong understanding of AI risks and governance considerations, including human oversight, accountability and transparency, privacy, validity and reliability, appropriate use, and fairness and bias mitigation.
  • Familiarity with AI regulatory, policy, or standards developments, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Ability to work effectively across technical, legal, compliance, risk, cybersecurity, data science, and business teams, including influencing stakeholders without direct ownership of the underlying technology platforms.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Prior hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, software development, AI product development, MLOps, LLMOps, platform governance, or technical AI risk management.
  • Experience with agentic AI, generative AI platforms, AI assistants, custom AI tools, workflow automation, AI-enabled software features, runtime monitoring, or enterprise AI product governance.
  • Experience translating Responsible AI, AI governance, risk, compliance, or regulatory expectations into practical business processes, governance requirements, technical control expectations, guidance, or operating models.
  • Prior work in a regulated industry, such as biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, financial services, or another environment with significant compliance, privacy, security, quality, or regulatory expectations.

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

What we do matters. So do you.

With over 250 team members across the UK, Bulgaria, France, Portugal, Germany, and Spain, we are continually innovating the after-checkout experience for our retailers by reducing cost and complexity, driving sustainability, and fostering customer loyalty.

  • High willingness and ability to transmit knowledge. Curious and keeping up to date with industry novelties.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4–6 fashion and apparel accounts. These clients move fast — seasonal drops, trend-driven creative, influencer campaigns that need to be in market in days, not weeks.

The growth constraints in fashion are usually one of three things: the brand is winning on product but losing on customer acquisition efficiency; they're acquiring customers but not retaining them; or their creative is outpacing their targeting strategy (or vice versa). Your job is to find which one it is, build the roadmap, and hold the team to it.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with close attention to creative performance and cohort retention trends
  • Maintain a working understanding of fashion business fundamentals, including pricing strategy, merchandising, and multi-channel distribution (DTC, wholesale, retail, marketplaces, etc)
  • Own the senior client relationship; QBRs should connect creative and campaign decisions back to business outcomes
  • Coordinate paid search, paid social, influencer, SEO, email, and creative teams — in fashion these functions depend on each other more than in most other verticals
  • Consult on customer retention strategy: repeat purchase rate, LTV by acquisition cohort, and loyalty mechanics
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Coach and give direct feedback to analysts and specialists

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in fashion or apparel marketing, agency or brand side
  • Understands how creative strategy and media strategy interact — has an opinion on which comes first and why
  • Fluent in the influencer and UGC ecosystem: knows how to brief, evaluate, and scale it without losing brand control
  • Comfortable with DTC-first brands and understands the economics: CAC, LTV, repeat rate, margin by channel
  • Experience with Meta-heavy media mixes and the measurement challenges that come with them — incrementality testing, creative fatigue, audience saturation
  • Has worked with brands that move seasonally and knows how to build a strategy that accounts for it
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

In this role, you'll apply your full-stack engineering expertise to design, build, and maintain functional, robust, and user-friendly web applications. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end-to-end.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini-SaaS tools, and AI-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores.
  • Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role-based access where needed.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features.
  • Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly.
  • Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor full-stack applications to improve correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Write clear, testable code and debug end-to-end issues across frontend, backend, and database.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in full-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in full-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser-based applications end-to-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and build production-ready web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar).
  • Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design.
  • Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows.
  • Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, , Railway, or similar).
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped web applications (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.

Job Title: Senior Managing Attorney

Location: Remote, United States

Business Unit: Legal Solutions
