jobs.excerpt: Company Introduction:Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered.
jobs.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Be the Team's Deepest Problem-Solver

Every ops floor needs a small number of people who can be handed the hardest problem in the queue and trusted to get it right — balancing cost, speed, and customer impact without defaulting to escalation. As an Operations Specialist III, you're that person for your team.

You resolve what OS I and OS II can't, you help the team solve it themselves next time, and you understand the business well enough to make the close calls — which carrier, which cost, which tradeoff — that protect both service quality and margin. For the rare issue that needs to be fielded by someone supporting Ops leadership and account managers directly, you know when to bring in an Ops Expert.

What You'll Do

Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist II job description, in addition to the following:

Resolve the Hardest Escalations

  • Independently resolve all escalated issues using available resources with minimal to no assistance
  • Assist in resolving team member escalations and questions
  • Anticipate problems before they surface and act early

Make the Margin and Cost Tradeoffs

  • Understand margin versus total cost for an order and apply that knowledge to additional charge approvals
  • Balance speed, cost, and customer impact when making big-picture decisions, without defaulting to escalation (e.g., choosing a carrier based on service reliability and error-rate history rather than the fastest or cheapest option alone)
  • Maintain deep, practiced knowledge of the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your assigned sector

Set the Standard for the Team

  • Serve as the go-to resource on sector-specific process nuance and edge cases within the team
  • Flag SOP gaps and suggest improvements to your supervisor based on frontline experience
  • Uphold team expectations by leading through example
  • Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements; assist teammates with related questions

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance

As an OS III, you'll be expected to maintain minimal to no errors or service failures, make sound decisions under pressure, and meet the customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist II, or equivalent experience independently resolving complex, time-critical logistics escalations
  • Working knowledge of margin and cost tradeoffs, and comfort applying that knowledge to real-time approval decisions
  • Deep, near-expert familiarity with the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your sector
  • Track record of coaching or supporting less-tenured teammates through difficult issues
  • Sound judgment under pressure, with a track record of getting ahead of problems rather than reacting to them
  • Willingness to obtain additional certifications, where applicable within your sector
  • Available for 2 weeks of training in person on-site in our Carlsbad, CA headquarters

Advancement to Ops Expert

Ops Expert is a step up in scope, not just tenure: it moves from executing within your sector to being the escalation point leadership and account managers turn to directly, with elevated coaching and live-operations responsibility. To advance, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

  • Minimum of 9-12 months in the OS III role
  • Consistently meeting or exceeding OS III performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed across two consecutive Semi-Annual Reviews (SARs)
  • Demonstrated ability to guide teammates in real time — catching and correcting issues as they happen, not just after the fact
  • Working familiarity with monitoring and resourcing tools (e.g., Zendesk, Twilio, live dashboards) beyond your own queue
  • Willingness to obtain additional certifications required for the Expert tier, where applicable, in addition to your existing sector certifications
  • Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to operate as the sector's top escalation resource and take on informal team-leadership responsibility

Compensation

  • Hourly pay range: $26-30/hr
  • High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options
  • 401K company contribution program
  • Professional learning and training reimbursements

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.

About Aegis Ventures

Aegis Ventures partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to launch and scale transformative companies in digital health and artificial intelligence. Our platform brings together market-shaping ideas, growth capital, and ambitious individuals to solve major societal problems. With a focus on innovations in healthcare, Aegis has launched four successful portfolio companies in partnership with Northwell Health and recently announced the Digital Consortium to co-develop, invest in, and launch new companies.

About the Company

Optain is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking clinicians, software, and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we screen, manage, and treat eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through a combination of our teleophthalmology clinical team, our AI and machine learning technology, and our best in class fundus camera. Optain targets front-line screening and new care settings at an accessible price. At a systemic level, this not only ensures greater access to care but also promises to reduce the strains of an overburdened healthcare system.

Optain’s recently closed Series A (led by major US private equity firms, strategic investors, and health systems) was done with the expectations of rapid commercial growth. Optain has achieved regulatory clearance and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, the Middle East, and Europe, and is actively scaling across multiple health systems in the US.

About the Job

As the Senior Operations Manager, you will own US customer operations - the function that connects our commercial momentum to actual customer outcomes. That means managing camera ordering and inventory from our manufacturing partners, getting hardware to new customers quickly and in step with our sales pipeline, standing up and running our US camera servicing function, and owning the contract execution process for new commercial agreements. Today these workflows are manual and founder-led. Your job is to take them over, run them well, and systematically redesign them for scale. This is a role for someone who has done this kind of work before, takes ownership seriously, and knows the difference between running a process and building one that doesn't need you.

Optain is at an inflection point. We have FDA clearance, a growing camera footprint, and a commercial pipeline that is moving fast. The operational infrastructure to support that growth is being built in real time, and this role sits at the center of that work.

This is a remote, US-based position.

What You'll Do

  • Own camera ordering, inventory management, and fulfillment -- manage the relationship with our factory, maintain accurate inventory, and ensure new customers receive and activate cameras in step with our sales momentum.
  • Stand up and run US camera servicing operations, including returns, repairs, and warranty coordination.
  • Own end-to-end contract execution for US commercial agreements -- work with the sales team on commercial terms, draft and redline customer contracts, and drive them through to execution.
  • Build and maintain the contract lifecycle process, including workflow tooling, signing authority routing, and playbooks that make future contracting faster and more repeatable.
  • Manage legacy contract obligations inherited from an acquired business and support ongoing compliance with existing customer agreements.
  • Draft internal policies and SOPs to close operational gaps as the company grows.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across customer ops workflows -- the goal is a function that scales without adding headcount linearly.

What You'll Need

  • 4-7 years of experience in business or operations roles, with direct exposure to hardware logistics, customer contract management, or both
  • Startup experience strongly preferred -- you have worked in a Series A or B environment and are comfortable operating without a defined playbook
  • Prior experience in management consulting or investment banking is a plus -- we value the analytical rigor and work product standards that come with it
  • Experience in a regulated industry is a strong plus; medical device, IVD, or health tech with a hardware component is ideal
  • A systems thinker who doesn't just execute tasks but asks how to make the next iteration easier and more scalable
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work; experience building or automating workflows with AI tooling is a strong plus
  • Exceptional written communication and attention to detail
  • Someone who takes ownership seriously, communicates proactively, and is comfortable operating with limited structure -- you will often be defining the process, not following one
  • US-based, comfortable with remote work and occasional travel for team offsites and customer engagements

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package, including a strong base salary, performance-based bonus, and the chance to earn upside.
  • Top-tier health, vision, dental, and commuter benefits.
  • Generous monthly health and wellness reimbursement.
  • Unparalleled exposure to new business building at the intersection of artificial intelligence and healthcare.
  • The opportunity to help solve difficult problems and collaborate with world-class experts from healthcare provider networks, academia, and industry.
  • A chance to work with a highly talented, close-knit team and world-leading mentors who can act as a support network and sounding board throughout your entrepreneurial journey.

Salary Range

  • $130,000 - $160,000 base salary, depending on experience and alignment with role expectations.

Highlights:

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be a key contributor to our core product, building and scaling features that are central to the donation experience for millions of users. You'll leverage your expertise in Node.js, React, and TypeScript to develop complex components—from dynamic donation widgets to data-driven admin dashboards—with a relentless focus on code quality, scalability, and user experience.

This is an ideal opportunity if you love solving real-world problems at scale and want to grow within a mission-driven, high-impact engineering culture.

  • Design, build, and maintain resilient frontend and backend features using React and Node.js.
  • Develop our core products, including donation checkouts, embeddable widgets, and donor/partner portals.
  • Architect and develop system components that scale across millions of monthly transactions.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly testable code.
  • Drive architecture and technical design discussions to find elegant solutions to complex problems.
  • Mentor peers by conducting thoughtful code reviews and providing constructive feedback.
  • Partner with product managers and designers to clarify requirements and shape the roadmap.
  • Proactively identify and resolve bugs, performance bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional fullstack development experience.
  • Deep understanding of modern JavaScript (event loop, closures, promises, prototypes).
  • Expert-level proficiency with React and its ecosystem (familiarity with Vue is a plus).
  • Strong backend expertise with Node.js (experience with Koa or NestJS is highly preferred).
  • Experience with Webpack configuration, performance optimization, and profiling.
  • A keen eye for detail and a high sense of ownership and accountability for your work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MongoDB, ClickHouse, or Elasticsearch.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong personal portfolio.

Bonus points

  • Curiosity and a hypothesis-driven mindset.
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, data-rich environments.

Why work with us

  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next.
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution.

  • The compensation range for this role is: $3,800 - $5,100 gross per month.

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Customer Service Representative (Telehealth)

About the Role

This isn't a traditional call center role.

At LumiMeds, our Customer Service Representatives are the first point of contact for patients who trust us with their health journey. You're not simply answering questions—you'll help patients navigate our platform, resolve issues with empathy and urgency, and ensure every interaction leaves them feeling supported.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, takes ownership of problems, and enjoys helping people. If you need step-by-step instructions for every situation, this probably isn't the right role. If you enjoy solving problems, thinking critically, and creating an exceptional patient experience, we'd love to meet you.

  • Provide exceptional support to patients via phone, email, chat, and SMS
  • Resolve patient inquiries related to appointments, prescriptions, billing, subscriptions, and account management
  • Guide patients through the telehealth experience with empathy, professionalism, and accuracy
  • Escalate clinical questions appropriately while maintaining patient confidence

  • Document every interaction accurately within our CRM and patient management systems
  • Follow up proactively to ensure issues are fully resolved
  • Identify recurring patient pain points and provide recommendations to improve processes
  • Meet established KPIs including response times, customer satisfaction (CSAT), first contact resolution, and quality metrics
  • Represent the LumiMeds brand with professionalism in every patient interaction

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Service, Patient Support, or Customer Experience
  • Experience supporting customers remotely (phone, chat, and email)
  • Professional-level English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail
  • Comfortable handling multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously
  • Strong empathy without losing efficiency or accountability
  • Experience using CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar
  • Comfortable working U.S. business hours
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment

  • Experience supporting subscription-based businesses
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or healthcare privacy standards
  • Experience with Slack, Dialpad, Intercom, or similar support platforms
  • Experience working in startups or high-growth companies

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Patients consistently rate your support highly
  • You resolve issues efficiently while maintaining empathy
  • You take ownership instead of passing problems to others
  • You communicate clearly across teams and with patients
  • You proactively identify opportunities to improve the patient experience
  • You thrive in an environment where priorities evolve quickly

Why LumiMeds?

We're building a company where patient experience is just as important as clinical outcomes. Every conversation matters, every interaction builds trust, and every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on someone's health journey.

If you're excited about helping people, solving problems, and being part of a fast-growing telehealth company, we'd love to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

jobs.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About The Role

Veeam is building a global SRE function to support the Veeam Data Cloud, our new SaaS platform. This role focuses on our Government and Sovereign Cloud environment.

Due to clearance and access requirements, this team operates with restricted access to GOV infrastructure. That means you'll be part of a small team responsible for the full platform stack — including all VDC workloads. You won't always be able to hand off problems to other teams; you need to understand the entire architecture well enough to own it. You'll need to get up to speed on the platform quickly, often by reading code, docs, and architecture artifacts rather than getting direct access to environments from day one.

This is a ground-up role — you'll help define how reliability engineering works here by mapping systems, writing runbooks, setting baselines, and building the practices this team will run on going forward.

What You'll Do

Discovery & Documentation

  • Get up to speed on the full platform — all VDC workloads, dependencies, and risk areas. Much of this will happen through code, docs, and conversations rather than direct environment access.

  • Work with SMEs across the org to fill knowledge gaps and build onboarding material for the team.

  • Write and maintain runbooks, architecture docs, and operational guides.

Reliability & Incident Response

  • Design infrastructure for high availability and fault tolerance on Azure (including Azure Government).

  • Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets where none exist today.

  • Run incident response and blameless postmortems. Turn incidents into improvements.

  • Identify reliability risks across modern and legacy workloads and build practical remediation plans that work within compliance constraints.

Observability

  • Close observability gaps — define instrumentation requirements and drive implementation.

  • Set alerting, telemetry, and monitoring standards with partner teams.

  • Build automation to reduce toil and support fleet management.

  • Participate in on-call rotations.

Infrastructure & Delivery

  • Work with IaC, CI/CD, deployment automation, and config management — including in air-gapped or compliance-restricted environments.

  • Build and maintain testing, canary deployment, and release validation pipelines.

  • Integrate chaos engineering and monitoring tools, adapting choices to meet regulatory requirements.

Collaboration

  • Work across product, platform, security, legal, compliance, and operations teams.

  • Own problems end-to-end — identify gaps, drive solutions, don't wait for direction.

  • Mentor other engineers and help spread SRE practices across the org.

Technologies we work with

  • Microsoft TFS, Azure DevOps, Git, BitBucket
  • Azure (Entra ID, API Management, Cosmos Db, Storage services, Azure Functions, static website hosting, Azure security, etc.) 
  • IaC tools (Azure ARM templates, AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, the Serverless Framework, etc.) 
  • Observability (Azure Monitor, AppInsights, Elastic Stack)

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, with 3+ years in SRE, Platform Engineering, or similar — across multi-service platforms, not just single-service environments.

  • Experience with Government or Sovereign Cloud (e.g., Azure Government, AWS GovCloud).

  • Experience in regulated compliance environments — government (FedRAMP, CMMC, IL2/IL4/IL5), financial (PCI-DSS, SOX), or healthcare (HIPAA, HITRUST). You understand how compliance shapes architecture and operations.

  • Strong experience building and running production services on cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred, including Azure Government).

  • Able to learn large, complex platforms quickly with limited guidance — comfortable building understanding from code, docs, and architecture artifacts when direct environment access is restricted.

  • Can investigate systems independently and produce clear docs, risk assessments, and improvement plans.

  • Comfortable working across teams — engineering, product, security, compliance, operations.

  • Programming skills in one or more of: TypeScript/JS, Go, Java, C#, or similar.

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK stack).

  • Experience with IaC (Terraform, Terragrunt, Pulumi) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

  • Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling — GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, FluxCD, or Dagger.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems, networking, and cloud-native architecture.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

Bonus Skills

  • Experience on B2B SaaS platforms in regulated or government markets.

  • Background in chaos engineering, resilience testing, or performance/load testing.

  • Have built an SRE or reliability function from scratch before.

  • Experience across mixed environments — modern cloud-native and older legacy systems.

  • Familiar with AI-first development workflows — using LLM-powered tools for infrastructure automation, code generation, and documentation.

Why Join?

  • Build the GOV reliability practice from day one — your decisions will shape how this team works.

  • Help define SRE at Veeam across a globally distributed engineering org.

  • Work with strong teams across product, cloud engineering, security, and compliance.

  • Professional development resources including mentorship, training, and volunteer days.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. You will own the decisions that matter most: what we build, what we buy or partner for, and whether a product is ready to launch and stand behind. You will build a single, coherent product roadmap and a product story that both business leaders and technical architects can read and trust.

This is a build-inside-a-large-enterprise role. You will ship great product by partnering closely with engineering rather than commanding it, by designing commercial models that fit a services-led business, and by creating demand and clarity in an environment that does not run on classic product-led-growth mechanics. If you are energized by shipping real product under real constraints, this is a role with genuine scope and impact. If you need full org-chart authority over engineering to feel effective, this is not the right fit — and we would rather be honest about that up front.

What You Will Own

  • Product strategy and roadmap across three product lines, unified into one coherent plan and narrative.
  • The build-versus-partner-versus-consulting decision for new products and features.
  • Launch-readiness decisions: owning the criteria, the checklist, and the accountability for whether a product ships.
  • Creating a great culture of product management across a team of 20+ product managers.
  • Post-launch product performance review and the fast-follow feature decisions that come out of it.
  • A single source of truth for product materials, built and maintained jointly with the Commercial leader.
  • Market intelligence, competitive landscape, and product-level enablement.
  • Joint responsibility for pricing and packaging, in partnership with Commercial.

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • Ten or more years in product management, with at least three to five years leading product in a senior or head-of-product capacity.
  • A track record of shipping software products inside a large, complex, matrixed organization — where you delivered by influencing teams you did not directly control, not by relying on reporting lines.
  • Experience owning a product roadmap end to end, including hard prioritization and cut decisions under fixed external commitments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business complexity into a clear product strategy that both non-technical executives and technical leaders can act on.
  • Experience partnering deeply with engineering as an equal, and with commercial and delivery functions, to get product into production.

Strongly Preferred

  • Product leadership in an environment with heavy IT, security, or compliance dependencies — where other teams controlled parts of your critical path.
  • Experience building or evolving commercial and pricing models for software delivered inside a services, enterprise, or embedded context, rather than pure self-serve SaaS.
  • Experience shipping product while the organization itself was changing — a restructure, integration, carve-out, or platform consolidation.
  • Applied experience with AI or machine-learning products in production.

Skills and Attributes

  • Deep product craft: you know what great product management and product-led growth look like, and you can build that discipline in a team — while adapting it to an environment that does not have all the ideal conditions.
  • Influence without authority: you win engineering, commercial, and delivery partners over through credibility, sequencing, and judgment.
  • Decisiveness under ambiguity: you make and defend hard scope calls to protect a commitment, rather than deferring to endless alignment.
  • Clear communication: you make complex product direction legible across very different audiences in the same room.
  • Bias to ship: you treat constraints as the terrain to navigate, not as reasons a thing cannot be done.

Compensation and Benefits

This is a Vice President level role.

The base salary range for this position is $210000- $250000, plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. jobs.excerpt: Role Overview You thrive where structure meets scale.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

You thrive where structure meets scale. You can orchestrate hundreds of interconnected content deliverables across global programs, spot downstream dependencies before they impact execution, and bring operational clarity to fast-moving, high-visibility initiatives. If that sounds like your ideal Wednesday, keep reading.

The Senior Manager, Event Content Program Management & Operations partners with the Flagship Programs and Event Content leadership to establish structured event content operating models and deliver flawless execution across ServiceNow’s most visible marketing moments: Knowledge, World Forums, and AI Summits.

This role goes beyond session and presentation management. You will drive end-to-end program management of complex content ecosystems spanning content strategy, keynote content management, session recommendations, presentation quality, on-site demo signage, and recurring content updates that reflect the latest product roadmap innovations and announcements. You own the full event content lifecycle — from pre-event planning and content availability through live execution and post-event operations — across ServiceNow’s first-party flagship programs. You will be the operational backbone of the event content function, a trusted partner to the Flagship Programs leader, and a collaborator across the broader PSM Launch Office & Flagship Programs leadership team on special projects and initiatives that don’t fit neatly into a single function.

You don’t need a clean handoff to get started, and you’re just as effective owning five things at once as you are going deep on one.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who is energized by building, thrives in complexity, and brings a rigorous, PMP-style approach to execution at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Event Content Program Management & Execution (50%)

  • Own end-to-end program management of event content operations across multiple concurrent programs including Knowledge, and tier 1 3rd party events (such as, MSFT Ignite, AWS re:Invent and more).
  • Lead the ongoing communication and activation of strategic event narratives across stakeholders, teams, and customer-facing channels.
  • Orchestrate execution across workstreams including Product Marketing, Events, Regional and Field Marketing, and Customer Marketing.
  • Own the annual third-party event planning recommendation process, project managing PSM’s assessment and prioritization of external event participation across the portfolio.
  • Manage event-to-event content availability, ensuring the right content is identified, prepared, and accessible across Knowledge, and tier 1 3rd party events.
  • Manage complex content portfolios and quarterly refreshes reflecting the latest product innovations and announcements.
  • Ensure alignment between corporate narrative messaging strategy and content execution across all sessions and supporting touchpoints.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability to deadlines, deliverables, and dependencies.
  • Lead program-level cadence including weekly stakeholder updates, timeline and deliverable tracking, and risk escalation.
  • Surface blockers and trade-offs early and drive resolution with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure quality control, consistency, and completeness across all event content outputs.
  • Deliver executive-ready program reporting with clear insights into program health.

Program Infrastructure & Operating Model (30%)

  • Design and implement scalable operating models for event content planning, tracking, and execution.
  • Build reusable templates, playbooks, checklists, and workflow documentation that scale across event programs.
  • Build and own the content availability operating model for first-party events, establishing the intake process, tracking infrastructure, and governance that scales from event to event.
  • Establish systems of record for timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Partner closely with the PMO Excellence and Launch Operations Senior Manager to ensure event content programs connect to the broader PSM execution infrastructure.
  • Champion PMO best practices including scope management, timeline discipline, dependency tracking, and risk mitigation.
  • Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives and program learnings across events.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through AI-enabled workflows, automation, and tooling.
  • Build and evolve a centralized event content playbook that scales across global programs.

Cross-Team Special Projects (20%)

  • Take on ad hoc program management responsibilities across the PSM Launch Office and Flagship Programs team as assigned, including initiatives that span functions or require dedicated coordination without a permanent home.
  • Support business operations responsibilities over time as the team’s operating model matures.

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience:

  • 8 to 12 years of program management experience within B2B enterprise technology or large-scale marketing organizations.

  • Direct experience managing event content operations including sessions, speakers, agendas, or large-scale content programs.

  • Proven experience building or scaling program management infrastructure including templates, operating models, and governance frameworks.

  • Familiarity with flagship event environments such as global conferences and summits and the associated content lifecycle.

  • Experience managing complex multi-workstream programs with high stakeholder density and tight timelines.

Core Competencies

  • Program management rigor with strong command of scope, schedule, dependency mapping, risk management, and governance.

  • Operating model design with the ability to bring structure and clarity to complex, ambiguous environments.

  • Program orchestration at scale across large, interdependent workstreams and functions.

  • Executive communication that distills complexity into clear, actionable insights and reporting.

  • Stakeholder management that navigates matrixed organizations with influence, clarity, and accountability.

  • Detail orientation with systems thinking that balances granular tracking with end-to-end program outcomes.

  • Cross-program integration mindset that spots dependencies, shared assets, and connection points across concurrent workstreams and acts on them proactively.

Differentiating Attributes

  • Process-first mindset that sees structure and discipline as critical enablers of speed and scale.

  • High ownership and accountability with proactive follow-through to completion.

  • Thrives under pressure and is energized by high-stakes environments, competing priorities, and situations where structure doesn’t yet exist.

  • Bias for action with a low tolerance for ambiguity as an excuse to wait — drives toward clarity and moves work forward before being asked.

  • Builder mentality energized by creating new systems, playbooks, and templates from the ground up.

  • Continuous improvement mindset always refining and optimizing how work gets done.

  • Flexibility and range to move between structured event program execution and ambiguous special projects without losing momentum.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in project and program management tools such as Workfront, Smartsheet, Asana, or similar.

  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills for executive reporting and tracking.

  • Experience building dashboards, trackers, and workflow documentation.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Loop and Teams environments.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance operations and streamline workflows.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Ramp on active event programs, content workstreams, and stakeholder landscape.

  • Build working relationships with core cross-functional partners.

  • Assess current gaps in process, tracking, and governance — and come in with a point of view, not just observations.

First 90 Days

  • Establish structured operating cadence across programs including status, tracking, and reporting.

  • Take ownership of day-to-day event content operations with minimal oversight.

  • Introduce initial process improvements and standardization.

First 6 Months

  • Deliver a scalable, repeatable operating model for event content execution.

  • Improve on-time delivery, visibility, and stakeholder alignment across programs.

  • Establish centralized playbooks and measurable improvements in execution quality.

  • Begin contributing to cross-team special projects and broader PSM initiatives as assigned.

jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Join us in creating a better way!

At eHealth, our mission is to expertly guide consumers through their health insurance and related options when, where, and how they prefer. We’re creating a better way – one that’s transparent and trustworthy for both our consumers externally and our employees internally.

Move your career forward while connecting countless people to the life- changing, quality care they deserve. Our diverse team of innovators supports one another in solving some of the toughest challenges. We’re always on the lookout for creative opportunities to do right by our customers, and each other. Together, we’re creating a better way to work, united by our common passion to make a difference.

Do you have a passion for helping others? Do you enjoy providing solutions to complex customer needs? Are you looking for a company that offers support and advancement opportunities while working from home? If so, our seasonal Carrier Associate Benefit Advisor role may be for you! eHealth, the leading private online marketplace for health insurance, is growing and looking for customer centric, career-driven individuals interested in launching a career within the insurance industry. This is a sales role within a call center environment.

Who we are:

At eHealth, our mission is to expertly guide consumers through their health insurance and related options when, where, and how they prefer. We’re creating a better way – one that’s transparent and trustworthy for both our consumers externally and our employees internally.

Move your career forward while connecting countless people to the life-changing, quality care they deserve. Our diverse team of innovators supports one another in solving some of the toughest challenges. We’re always on the lookout for creative opportunities to do right by our customers, and each other. Together, we’re creating a better way to work, united by our common passion to make a difference.

What you’ll do:

As a seasonal Carrier Associate Benefit Advisor, you will guide beneficiaries as they navigate one of the most important purchasing decisions of their life, selecting their health insurance coverage. You will listen, consult, and advise clients over the phone on their health insurance options. We partner with top national and regional health insurance companies, so you will have the ability to ensure customers get the right coverage for their situation.

Your initial training will provide a springboard into a successful career selling health insurance, including preparing you for the state licensing exam. With the remaining six weeks of training, we will get you up and running quickly!

Who you are:

  • You have the ability to obtain your resident state health insurance license or currently possess an active health insurance license.

  • You have previous sales experience or a passion for learning and growing in a sales role.

  • You have strong technology skills; you can easily navigate between multiple systems.

  • You are coachable and teachable.

  • You have a high level of integrity and customer focus.

  • You align with eHealth’s mission and demonstrate our values in your behaviors, practices, and decisions.

What you should know:

This is a sales role within a call center environment. You will spend your workday on the phone answering calls from beneficiaries. Your calls will be recorded and monitored. You may be required to make outbound calls to follow up on leads and cross sell ancillary products. You will be required to meet daily sales metrics and goals.

To be successful in this role you need to have good technological proficiency as the role requires you to toggle between multiple computer applications and screens while on the phone.

Hours:

  • Must be able to work 5:00AM-7:00PM PST, including weekends as needed.

  • Must be available to work extended hours during the Annual Enrollment period, October 15th to December 7th.

Licensing:

Our Carrier Associate Benefit Advisors are licensed insurance agents. As a licensed position working within a regulated industry, all candidates must undergo extensive background checks, including lifetime criminal background and credit history reports. eHealth may deny employment to or terminate the employment of any applicant or employee for whom the results of the background check prevents or adversely affects licensing or certification.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base pay plus uncapped commission incentives

  • Paid training

  • Ongoing support and resources

  • Medical benefits after 90 days of employment

  • Cell phone and internet reimbursement

Our Values:

  • One Team

  • Customer Centric

  • Innovation

  • Integrity

  • Quality

  • Accountability

  • Resilience

  • Financial Stewardship

*Please note the above is a summary of responsibilities; a full job description is available upon request

-

The base pay range reflects the anticipated pay range for this position. The actual base pay offered will depend on various factors including individual skills, experience, performance, qualifications, the department budget, and the location where work is performed. Base pay is one component of eHealth’s total rewards package, which also includes a monthly commission-based incentive plan, plus an array of benefits designed to support employees’ personal and professional wellness.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Manager - Pharma
jobs.excerpt: At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right.
jobs.description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us.

H1’s Customer Success team is focused on building deep, trusted relationships with existing customers to ensure they successfully implement the H1 platform, drive sustained engagement, and realize measurable business value from our solutions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1
The primary objective of the Principal Customer Success Manager is to serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to a portfolio of H1’s largest and most complex customers. You will own the customer relationship end-to-end, partnering closely with both senior client stakeholders and users to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth across either H1’s Clinical or Medical & Commercial product lines.

This role is designed for a highly autonomous, principal-level Customer Success leader who thrives in ambiguity, independently owns complex customer programs, strong personal accountability, and influences outcomes across customers, partners, and internal teams. Success in this role requires exceptional judgment, executive presence, and the ability to lead without direct authority.

You will:

  • Own large-scale customer programs involving multiple business units, internal teams, System Integrators (SIs), and executive stakeholders.
    - Lead cross-functional initiatives by establishing governance, driving accountability, managing dependencies, and ensuring successful execution across internal and external teams.
    - Operate as the strategic point of contact for complex customer engagements, aligning competing priorities while driving measurable business outcomes and managing the overall account.
    - Lead multiple concurrent, cross-functional customer programs, balancing competing priorities across customer executives, implementation partners, and internal stakeholders while maintaining alignment on strategic objectives.
    - Build strong relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders, positioning H1 as a critical partner in achieving their organizational goals.
    - Operate with minimal oversight while independently prioritizing competing customer and business needs.
    - Exercise sound judgment in highly ambiguous situations where there may not be an established playbook.
    - Identify gaps, define solutions, and drive execution without requiring direction from leadership.
    - Successfully navigate complex stakeholder dynamics during periods of organizational change or customer escalation.
    - Own and drive account strategy, including implementation and adoption plans, success metrics, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities.
    - Lead regular executive business reviews, clearly articulating performance against KPIs, ROI, and strategic impact.
    - Serve as the voice of the customer internally, providing structured feedback to product, engineering, and leadership teams to inform roadmap and prioritization.
    - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to ensure a seamless customer experience across the full lifecycle.
    - Consistently drive improvements in MAUs, NPS, CSAT, retention, and ARR across your book of business.
    - Proactively identify and mitigate risk across all areas of the account.

ABOUT YOU
We’re looking for a Principal Customer Success Manager who is passionate about delivering measurable value to enterprise customers at scale. You bring a strategic mindset, strong executive presence, and the ability to balance deep problem-solving with long-term relationship management. You thrive in fast-paced environments and take pride in owning outcomes for your customers.
- You quickly establish credibility and require little ramp-up to begin managing strategic customer relationships in the Pharma & CRO space.
- You naturally create structure in ambiguous environments and enjoy solving complex organizational challenges.
- You have exceptional ownership and accountability, following through on commitments without requiring close oversight.
- You are known for bringing order to difficult customer situations and driving successful outcomes.
- You influence without authority and effectively lead cross-functional teams toward shared objectives.

REQUIREMENTS
- 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Program Management, or equivalent strategic customer-facing experience within an Enterprise or Strategic B2B SaaS environment.
- Demonstrated experience owning complex, high-ARR accounts with senior stakeholder engagement.
- Strong project management experience across multi-threaded, high-priority initiatives.
- Experience working in or with Life Sciences organizations strongly preferred; Medical Affairs or Clinical experience is a plus.
- Proven ability to manage renewals, mitigate risk, and identify expansion opportunities.

COMPENSATION
This role pays $115,000 to $135,000 per year, based on experience, plus variable commission, based on performance, in addition to stock options.

Anticipated role close date: 09/07/2026

H1 OFFERS

  • Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
  • Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
  • Retirement options
  • Health & charitable donation stipends
  • Impactful Business Resource Groups
  • Flexible work hours & the opportunity to work from anywhere
  • The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe
H1 is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy), age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
H1 is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to your recruiter once you've begun the interview process. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote (US)

Company: Kintsugi AI – Solving Sales Tax for Modern Commerce

About Kintsugi AI

Kintsugi AI is on a mission to remove the friction of sales tax compliance for fast-growing companies. Our AI-driven platform makes sales tax automation simple, accurate, and scalable. We partner with CFOs, accountants, and advisors who need a trusted solution to keep their clients compliant while freeing up their time to focus on growth.

As a fast-growing fintech startup, we’re looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, takes ownership, and is excited to help us build a best-in-class partner ecosystem.

The Role

As our Accounting Partnerships Manager, you will be the driving force behind building and growing relationships with accounting, fractional CFO, and advisory partners. You’ll help them view Kintsugi as their go-to solution for sales tax compliance—bringing value to their clients and revenue to our business.

This role blends business development, partner management, and strategy. You’ll source new partners, nurture existing ones, and build scalable programs that enable Kintsugi to expand its reach through trusted finance leaders.

What You’ll Do

  • Source & Close New Partners

    • Identify and onboard accounting firms, CFO consultants, and advisors to refer clients to Kintsugi.

    • Run scaled outbound campaigns to build a steady pipeline of new partners.

    • Stay highly organized, managing a CRM with over 100 named partners, growing by the day

    • Serve as the face of Kintsugi, keeping partners updated on the product, offerings, and any relevant updates

  • Manage & Grow Relationships

    • Serve as the primary contact for partners, keeping them engaged and informed.

    • Route deals, track referrals, and ensure partners receive agreed-upon rev share.

    • Develop strategies to increase partner-driven deal flow.

  • Enable & Activate Partners

    • Host partner events such as dinners, roundtables, and webinars.

    • Represent Kintsugi at conferences and industry events.

    • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and product to create enablement resources that keep partners aligned with Kintsugi’s growth.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or channel sales, ideally in fintech, accounting, or SaaS.

  • Strong understanding of CFOs, accounting firms, or financial advisory ecosystems.

  • Entrepreneurial and highly autonomous—comfortable figuring things out in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Organized and detail-oriented, with experience using CRM tools to manage pipeline and relationships.

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder who can influence senior finance professionals.

  • Bonus: Experience hosting events or representing a company at conferences.

Why Join Kintsugi AI?

  • Be part of a fast-growing fintech startup solving one of the biggest headaches in business: sales tax compliance.

  • Build the foundation of our partner ecosystem and play a pivotal role in company growth.

  • Work with a mission-driven, collaborative team that values autonomy, creativity, and execution.

  • Competitive salary, equity, and benefits.

jobs.title: Chaplain Part-Time - Hazlet, NJ | **Bilingual Spanish Preferred
jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-Time, Hazlet, NJ

Bilingual Spanish Required

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

jobs.excerpt: MISSIONMirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases.
jobs.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Regional Business Director (RBD) is a first-line field leader responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of (7) Regional Account Managers to deliver strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned region. The RBD translates national and zone strategy into focused local execution, builds a culture of continuous learning and accountability, and ensures the team operates with clinical credibility, business discipline, and a deep commitment to patients and caregivers.

This leader will create clarity in a complex rare disease environment, set high standards for execution, and develop talent through frequent field coaching, timely feedback, individualized development plans, and stretch opportunities. The RBD will also serve as a trusted cross-functional partner, bringing forward actionable field insights and aligning Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Advocacy around the needs of customers, patients, and the business.

Assigned Area: NY, NJ, PA, MD, DC, VA

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Regional Strategy & Performance Leadership

  • Translate national and zone priorities into a focused regional business plan with clear objectives, account priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Set a disciplined operating rhythm that includes field coaching, business reviews, performance tracking, opportunity planning, and rapid course correction.
  • Use data, market intelligence, and field insights to identify growth opportunities, anticipate barriers, and improve execution across the region.
  • Own regional results and resource stewardship, including budget management, forecasting, and alignment of team activity to the highest-impact opportunities.

People Leadership, Coaching & Development

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, engage, and retain high-performing Regional Account Managers who demonstrate strong clinical credibility, business judgment, and patient focus.
  • Spend meaningful time in the field observing customer engagement, coaching in the moment, reinforcing strengths, and addressing capability gaps through clear, actionable feedback.
  • Create individualized development plans, provide stretch opportunities, and build succession and promotion readiness across the team.
  • Set clear expectations and hold self and team accountable for behaviors, execution quality, and results; address performance concerns promptly, consistently, and fairly.

Customer, Account & Patient Impact

  • Ensure the team develops thoughtful account strategies that reflect local patient journeys, referral networks, access dynamics, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Raise the quality and consistency of customer engagement across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology settings, including priority systems and centers of excellence.
  • Support compliant coordination across field partners to help remove appropriate barriers in the patient journey from identification through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Promote a customer’s experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, and follow-through with healthcare professionals, and care teams.

Clinical & Business Acumen

  • Build a team that can confidently bridge science and strategy in a high-science rare disease market.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, the Liver portfolio, market dynamics, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Coach the team to communicate with clinical relevance, ask insightful questions, challenge constructively, and tailor engagement to the needs of each customer and account.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build trusted partnerships across Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Bring forward timely, objective, and actionable field insights that inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, and execution priorities.
  • Align cross-functional partners around regional opportunities and barriers, clarify ownership, and ensure consistent follow-through on agreed actions.

Culture, Change & Compliance

  • Lead with humility, transparency, optimism, and consistency; create a safe, inclusive environment where people can learn, contribute, and perform at their best.
  • Champion change, simplify complexity, remove obstacles, and help the team remain focused and resilient amid ambiguity and evolving business needs.
  • Model and reinforce the highest standards of ethical conduct and compliance with all laws, regulations, company policies, and approved promotional practices.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 10+ years of progressive commercial experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • 3+ years of successful first-line sales leadership experience with direct responsibility for field team performance and talent development.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering business results while building engaged, capable, and accountable teams.
  • Strong experience coaching in the field, providing candid and constructive feedback, managing performance, and developing future leaders.
  • Rare disease, orphan drug, or highly specialized high-science commercial experience.
  • Experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or other complex specialty markets.
  • Experience leading through launch, indication expansion, organizational change, or a dynamic competitive market.
  • Knowledge of account-based selling, health-system dynamics, referral networks, centers of excellence and the role of patient services in rare disease markets
  • Experience partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, and Operations.
  • Ability to interpret business data, identify insights, develop regional strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Excellent communication, executive presence, judgment, organizational skills, and ability to prioritize in a fast-moving environment.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
