ROLE SUMMARY

The Internal Medicine Antiviral Field Medical Director, Sr. Director is responsible for providing Antiviral (AV) therapeutic area/product expertise through engagements with a priority set of external medical stakeholders (“EMS”—e.g. HCPs) and leading and supporting field medical initiatives in the assigned territory. In addition, this role will have significant leadership responsibilities for leading, developing, and ensuring effective implementation of the AV FMD team’s early engagement work in support of assigned Life Cycle Management (LCM) clinical programs.

SENIOR DIRECTOR FMD-LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES

In addition to the AV FMD territory responsibilities listed below, this Senior Director–level AV FMD role responsibilities also include but are not limited to:

  • Representing the FMD role on the assigned LCM clinical study team(s) and proposing appropriate FMD early engagement activities for endorsement by the AV FMD TLs and IM FMD Group VP;

  • Conducting the appropriate training for FMDs (in collaboration with the respective study teams) on how to compliantly engage with clinical trialists and ensure the FMDs have the requisite protocol knowledge and understanding of the respective LCM protocols;

  • Recommending and ensuring approval of relevant medical content and related materials FMDs will need with which to engage these contracted clinical trialists;

  • Mentoring additional FMD colleagues that may be identified to assist in representing the FMD group on the clinical study team(s);

  • Developing processes to track, measure, and characterize the impact of the FMD earlier engagement work for the assigned LCM clinical program working with key cross-functional partners in R & D, Global Medical Affairs, and MEI;

  • Ensuring FMD leadership is aligned with and endorses the respective LCM early engagement support and maintain effective relationships with the respective internal cross-functional partners.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and execute independent Medical strategies and engagements for appropriate assigned external medical stakeholders within a territory, compliantly coordinating with other Pfizer colleagues as needed to achieve Medical objectives.

  • Provide truthful, accurate, and scientifically supported information in response to direct unsolicited medical requests from external medical stakeholders in a manner that complies with all applicable Pfizer guidelines, policies, and procedures.

  • Educate external medical stakeholders based on patient care gaps and aligned to medical strategy with the goal of enhancing understanding of disease state and guideline-based care and improve overall patient care.

  • Maintain required level of knowledge of relevant TA/disease states and Pfizer medicines, providing therapeutic area/product information to both internal and external stakeholders as needed.

  • Field relevant inbound queries from external medical stakeholders via established triage process

  • In collaboration with US and/or Global Medical Affairs colleagues, partner with IM/SC Research & Development and Global Product Development (GPD) in the identification of potential sites for Pfizer-sponsored clinical trials, including identification of sites serving under-represented patient populations in trials.

  • Serve as a Medical resource to HQ Medical Affairs, other Field Medical colleagues, and external Therapeutic Area investigators and researchers as appropriate.

  • Appropriately provide Medical support throughout the Investigator Sponsored Research (ISR) process.

  • Cultivate research and therapeutic area expertise, including familiarity with latest congress data and disease state literature.

  • Understand the principles of study design, methodology, data analysis, and interpretation and communicate these concepts with external medical stakeholders.

  • Deliver insights on local patient organization structure, capabilities, and patient population needs.

  • Serve on Medical and/or TA and asset cross-functional committees, as appropriate.

  • Represent Pfizer Medical Affairs leadership with clinical/professional associations and/or societies, consistently demonstrating medical professionalism in all interactions.

  • Understand the priorities of Pfizer Medical Affairs in order to contribute to Medical educational content strategy development and execute aligned Field Medical tactics.

  • Maintain effective and appropriate scientific communication and collaboration among headquarters Medical colleagues, Medical Information, and other Pfizer Field Medical colleagues.

  • Demonstrate expertise in scientific communication across multiple channels, including, but not limited to, live and virtual presentations in small or large settings, written communication, and telephone or virtual conversations.

  • Optimize patient care improvement in Medical communications and deliverables, incorporating Health Literacy and cultural awareness principles to ensure that patients remain the ultimate focus.

  • Conduct all activities in accordance with all relevant policies, procedures and compliance guidance.

  • Achieve leadership-defined expectations regarding the number of external medical stakeholders.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

  • MD/DO degree required and 5 years relevant experience required.

  • Significant field medical experience in planning and conducting “Early Engagement” field medical activities with clinical trialists.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior leader influencing outcomes without direct authority.

  • Strong strategic thinking, executive presence, analytical rigor, and communication skills.

  • Subject matter expert recognized across internal and external stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including the ability to influence and collaborate with peers and create business impact.

  • Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills.

  • Demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills: ability to understand and respond to multiple external and internal stakeholders’ demands and manage and handle conflict constructively.

  • Demonstrate ability to manage a significant volume of projects developed in a remote environment, while exhibiting the ability to prioritize, successfully implement, and demonstrate excellent judgment skills and work in a continuous improvement environment.

  • Work within a matrixed, multi-disciplinary team to foster strong Pfizer/external medical stakeholder professional relationships which are aligned with Pfizer Medical objectives

  • Effectively manage through and lead change in an ever-changing and evolving external health care environment.

  • Demonstrate change agility; be flexible to new opportunities (e.g. new therapeutic areas) and adaptable to organizational change.

  • Problem-solve and network enterprise wide as appropriate to identify solutions.

  • Collaborate effectively and demonstrate leadership and teamwork with peers, internal stakeholders and external medical stakeholders that inspires alignment and partnership on a shared vision or strategy.

  • Be a self-starter, be accountable, and have a sense of urgency in delivering results that have medical impact and yield a positive external medical stakeholder experience.

  • Maintain self-awareness and continually choose behaviors and responses based on how it impacts one’s own and others’ performance and engagement.

  • Demonstrate clinical and technical skills.

  • Rapidly adopt and utilize new digital technology and other resources with medical external medical stakeholders and record medical interactions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with internal/external SOPs/Rules/Regulations regarding Pfizer/external medical stakeholder interactions and relationships, etc.

  • Previous Field Medical experience

  • Candidate currently in role as an Antiviral FMD and have least 3 years of antiviral FMD experience with a track record of field medical innovation.

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Operate a Pfizer company car and regularly fly on airplanes (i.e. attend external medical stakeholder meetings; attend NYHQ meetings, etc. required; proximity to airline ‘hub’ city); maintain flexibility to travel 40-50% of time.

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired.

Other Job Details

Authentic8 Silo places any type of digital analyst in region-specific, multi-application workspaces, securely and anonymously, anywhere across the globe. Target content can be captured, analyzed, and transformed in order to derive intelligence and support investigation requirements. All delivered in a cloud-native, multi-tenant platform.
Compliance officers, mission managers, and administrators have their own specific audit and oversight requirements; to meet these needs, Silo also ensures compliance and appropriate use through class-leading policy enforcement and audit logging.
Silo transforms how more than 750 of the world's most sophisticated organizations, from domestic and foreign government agencies to commercial entities across all sectors conduct their digital investigations.
We're looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager to own Authentic8's content engine end-to-end. That means the website, the editorial calendar, the orchestration of everything we publish, the way it gets optimized, and the way it moves ICPs from unaware to educated to converted.

Our users and buyers are specialists: threat intel analysts, SOC operators, OSINT investigators, financial crime teams, law enforcement. Their world runs on tradecraft and know-how. That expertise comes from our Product Marketing Manager, internal subject matter experts, customers, and external voices. You won't be writing the original thought leadership. You'll orchestrate it: brief the experts, edit their drafts, package their work, ship it, and turn each piece into a family of assets that reach every ICP across every channel we play in.

You'll report to the Head of Marketing, manage a Marketing Specialist, and partner with our Product Marketing Manager and other internal and external subject matter experts who fuel the content pipeline. You're a fit if you treat AI as a force multiplier (not a novelty), obsess over performance metrics, love a good A/B test, and get satisfaction from watching a bounce rate drop or a page climb the SERP.

What You'll Own:

    Own the website:
  • Serve as the primary owner of authentic8.com. You're the one accountable for what's on it, how it performs, and how fast we can change it
  • Partner with internal operations and external web developers to plan, prioritize, and ship updates
  • Manage the content roadmap across the homepage, product pages, use case pages, resource hub, and landing pages
  • Keep the site fast, clean, and aligned to current positioning as messaging and products evolve
  • Fix what's broken (links, forms, tracking, SEO issues) and prevent regressions
    • Set the content strategy:
  • Own the content marketing roadmap and editorial calendar, aligned to ICP (segment + vertical + use case) and full-funnel buyer journey (awareness to consideration to conversion to retention and upsell)
  • Identify content gaps and pitch new ideas grounded in ICP needs, competitive dynamics, and search demand
  • Prioritize what gets built next based on pipeline impact, not opinions
    • Orchestrate the content pipeline:
  • Brief internal SMEs (Product, CTO, Sales, CS) and external voices (customers, partners, industry experts). Get them what they need to contribute, and manage the intake of their drafts
  • Edit, refine, and package SME-driven content into publishable assets: blog posts, videos, case studies, solution briefs, whitepapers, webinars, newsletters, and nurture emails
  • Partner with external designers, video producers, and editors to scale output without dropping quality
  • Make sure every asset connects to something else: no orphan content, no siloed asset. Every piece has a place in a buyer journey

    • Lead and develop the team:

  • Manage a Marketing Specialist who runs our organic social program. Set clear priorities, coach on craft, and unblock them
  • Make sure organic social pulls from the same content strategy and asset library, so social becomes another distribution channel for the engine (not a side project)
  • Build the content function as a repeatable, high-output engine, not a hero-driven scramble
  • Bring the team along on AI workflows so productivity compounds
    • Optimize for search, AI, and humans:
  • SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO across the website, blog, and long-form assets
  • Keyword research covering paid and organic terms for our products and competitors
  • Heading structure, semantic keyword density, meta descriptions, and schema
  • FAQ and content structure that makes our pages LLM-scrapable and citable in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity answers
  • Third-party content placement to build authority signals
    • Turn one asset into ten:
  • Break long-form content (whitepapers, webinars, podcasts) into blog series, LinkedIn carousels, email sequences, short-form video, and sales enablement snippets
  • Use AI workflows to repurpose at scale without losing quality or voice
  • Daisy-chain smaller assets to drive deeper engagement and gated conversions

    • Optimize for conversion at every stage:

  • Landing page optimization: tight CTA alignment, low cognitive load, clear pain/solution, social proof, single action
  • CTA and offer testing by funnel stage (TOFU awareness, MOFU consideration, BOFU decision)
  • A/B testing variants of pages, headlines, offers, and creative
  • Improve scroll depth, dwell time, CTR, and bounce rate on key pages
    • Report on what actually moves pipeline:
  • Track content contribution to MQLs, opportunities, and revenue, not just traffic
  • Distinguish bot/engine traffic from human intent
  • Feed insights back into the content roadmap so we double down on what converts

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of B2B content marketing experience, with meaningful time in a fast-paced startup or scale-up
  • Experience managing and developing direct reports
  • Direct experience owning a company website end-to-end, working with internal operations and external developers
  • Proven ability to build and run an editorial calendar aligned to ICPs, use cases, and the full buyer journey
  • Track record of orchestrating SME-driven content: briefing internal and external experts, editing their drafts, and packaging their expertise into ICP-facing assets
  • Deep SEO fluency: technical, on-page, keyword strategy, and content architecture
  • Working knowledge of AEO and GEO. You've already been experimenting with how to show up in AI answers
  • Hands-on with AI tools for content repurposing, editing, and personalization at scale. You treat AI as an extension of your capabilities, not a threat to your craft
  • Proven track record of measurable content wins: organic traffic lift, ranking improvements, conversion rate gains, or pipeline contribution
  • Exceptional editing and copywriting chops. You can turn a rough SME draft into a publishable asset, rework a headline, sharpen a CTA, or restructure a landing page without needing hand-holding.
  • Strong project management. You can juggle a dozen assets across a dozen channels without dropping the ball.
  • Able to bring your best practices to the table and enhance current processes. Confident to present those ideas to key stakeholders
  • Comfortable with the tools listed and confident pulling your own reports:Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, WordPress, Claude Code, SEMrush, Asana, Zoom, Google Workspace Suite, Frontify content management system

What success looks like in year 1:

  • You've taken clean ownership of the website and improved its performance on the metrics that matter (organic traffic, ranking, conversion, page speed)
  • Editorial calendar is running on rhythm, mapped to ICP and funnel stage, and every planned asset ships on time
  • SME-to-published pipeline is smooth. Experts contribute, drafts land, assets ship, and no one is waiting on you.
  • Your direct report is growing. Their output and range are visibly stronger than at the start of the year.
  • Every high-priority page and asset is optimized for search, AEO, and conversion
  • Content library is auditable, decay is managed, and we know what's working
  • Repurposing engine is running: each major asset produces at least 5-8 derivative pieces
  • Measurable lift in organic traffic, ranking for target keywords, and content-attributed pipeline
  • We're consistently cited in AI answer engines for our ICP's most important questions

Compensation:

    Salary: $130,000 - $150,000 plus bonus eligibility and Equity
    Individual pay will be determined by job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Authentic8 Core Values & Principles:

Integrity: We apply our best efforts. We are honest with and accountable to others.
Mission-Focused: We clearly define and communicate our goals and do not stray in the pursuit of our objective.
Respect: We value and respect the ideas and experience our diverse backgrounds bring us. Positive consideration of differing viewpoints makes us stronger.
We are collaborative: We recognize the best work is the product of teams. We must each be reliable and expect to rely on others.
We are transparent: By operating with common information and understanding we ensure that we are aligned.
We find innovative solutions: We seek innovative solutions not as a buzzword but as a means to solve difficult problems with zeal, efficiency and quality.
We take ownership: We are responsible for our actions, our reputation and our business.
Authentic8 offers competitive benefits, including medical, dental and vision, flexible PTO, a 401k program and stock options.
It is the policy of Authentic8 to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Tajik-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: TajikInterpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Tajik Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Tajikand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inTajikand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Ninety (90) days from the posting date of July 10, 2026.

About Arlo:

At Arlo, we're passionate about creating innovative and reliable solutions that help people protect what matters most to them. Our team is dedicated to delivering products that exceed our customers' expectations, while always pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of protection technology. We believe that everyone deserves to feel safe and secure, whether they're at home or away, and we're committed to providing our customers with the peace of mind they need to live their lives without worry. Arlo’s deep expertise in AI- and CV-powered analytics, cloud services, user experience, product design, and innovative wireless and RF connectivity enables the delivery of a seamless, smart security experience for Arlo users that is easy to set up and interact with every day.

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Regulatory Compliance Engineer to join our team. Reporting to Director, Regulatory Compliance, you will be responsible for supporting day-to-day regulatory compliance operations, serving as a subject matter expert, and representing Arlo on regulatory topics with internal and external partners.

Regulatory Strategy & Execution

  • Support global regulatory approval strategies for new and sustaining products; identify risks early and drive mitigation.
  • Manage compliance across EMC, Product Safety, Wireless/RF, and International Approvals.
  • Develop certification plans, schedules, and budgets aligned with product milestones.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic accounts, delivering high-quality service and expert regulatory guidance.

Product Compliance & Certification

  • Identify applicable regulatory, radio, safety, and EMC standards in partnership with engineering, suppliers, and test labs.
  • Manage homologation projects across all sales regions for timely, cost-effective approvals.
  • Develop and execute product test plans and manage international regulatory approvals end-to-end.
  • Manage GCF and PTCRB carrier certifications for Arlo's cellular portfolio.

Program Management

  • Own certification timelines, schedules, and budgets across all active NPI and sustaining products; escalate risks and variances promptly.
  • Serve as primary contact for test labs, NRTLs, certification bodies, and international agents; coordinate cross-functionally to resolve blockers.
  • Track certification status, expiration dates, and renewals; maintain a compliance dashboard and communicate status to key stakeholders.
  • Continuously improve team processes and tools for efficiency and scalability.

Documentation & Compliance Records

  • Own and maintain all regulatory compliance documentation, ensuring records are accurate and audit ready.
  • Apply knowledge of configuration management practices (BOMs, ECR/ECO/MCO) to maintain compliance records.
  • Support the ESG Committee by contributing compliance data to Arlo's CSR/ESG disclosures.

The successful candidate will have: -

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related technical field.
  • Experience in consumer electronics regulatory compliance (e.g., security cameras, lighting, battery, power adapters, solar panels), with solid understanding of product safety standards and third-party certification processes.
  • Proven program management skills — able to own certification timelines, manage budgets, track multi-project status, and communicate clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to influence at all levels and translate complex technical compliance matters into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Highly analytical and organized, with a track record of managing competing priorities across multiple programs.
  • Working knowledge of product configuration management practices (BOMs, ECR/ECO/MCO, rules of interchangeability).
  • Ability to travel internationally a few times a year.
  • Experience with carrier certifications is preferred (e.g., Verizon, AT&T, US Cellular, Z-Wave, ZigBee, Telstra).
  • Mandarin speaking a plus.

The pay range for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries at commencement of employment. In the United States, the expected range is $145,000 to $165,000 USD per year, and in Canada, $110,000 to $125,000 CAD per year, plus equity. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including location, role, job-related knowledge, skills, relevant education, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including bonus, equity, and a full range of benefits. Details of all benefits will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

We’re committed to inclusivity and selecting the strongest candidate—no matter their background. Even if you don’t meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re happy to support growth in areas essential to the role. Interested in learning more about our workplace? Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare. Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.
Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.
As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best-in-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.
Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human-to-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.

We're looking for a Director of Financial Planning & Analytics to own the systems, models, and processes that power financial decision-making at Headlight Health. Reporting to the CFO, you'll own the forecasting and analytics function that drives revenue visibility, budgeting, and long-range planning across a growing multi-site behavioral health organization.

This is not a traditional FP&A role, and it is not a people management role. You'll operate as a senior individual contributor owning the analytical infrastructure — developing scalable models and planning frameworks that help leadership understand where the business is going, not just where it's been. You'll work at the intersection of finance, billing operations, and data, building the forecasting capabilities that a scaling healthcare company needs.Success in this role depends on your ability to continuously identify what's preventing our financial picture from being accurate, timely, and actionable. Sometimes that means improving a model. More often, it means uncovering gaps in upstream data quality, billing processes, or systems — and driving cross-functional solutions to fix them. We're looking for someone who understands how finance, operations, and data come together in a healthcare environment, and who has built planning capabilities from the ground up.

This role is for remote applicants. For local candidates this role will be hybrid. Apply here.

This is a role where the work evolves constantly. We're still building a lot of our processes, and the person in this seat will have real influence over how they take shape. If you want a defined playbook to execute, this probably isn't the right fit. If you want to understand a complex system and help make it better, we'd love to talk.

Our Pillars

  • Make things easier.
  • Forge genuine connections.
  • Elevate the standard.

Roles and Responsiblities

  • Own the company's forecasting methodology across revenue, reimbursement, and long-range planning — partnering closely with our Sales & Operations Planning function on provider productivity.
  • Improve, build, and evolve driver-based financial models that support executive decision-making, budgeting, scenario analysis, and growth planning.
  • Continuously identify gaps in data, systems, and billing processes that limit forecasting accuracy or scalability, and drive cross-functional efforts to resolve them.
  • Influence stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Billing, and Clinical to implement process improvements, strengthen data quality, and improve the inputs that power planning.
  • Lead the evolution of financial reporting from manual, spreadsheet-driven workflows toward scalable, repeatable processes and modern planning tools.
  • Partner with billing and operations teams to operationalize financial models and build reporting infrastructure that reflects how the business actually works.
  • Establish governance, documentation, and feedback loops that measure forecast performance, identify variance root causes, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Support investor reporting, board materials, and fundraising with clear, well-supported financial narratives.
  • Own the annual budget, forecast, and long-range planning cycle end-to-end.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in financial planning, strategic finance, or financial analytics — ideally in healthcare, MSO, or a complex multi-site services environment.
  • Deep expertise building forecasting models for revenue, operating expenses, and long-range planning.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare revenue cycle economics — reimbursement, payer contracts, and AR dynamics. Familiarity with provider productivity metrics is a plus; you'll partner with our S&OP function rather than own that domain.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes behind forecasting or planning challenges and drive improvements to business processes, systems, or data quality.
  • Proven success influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority to implement operational or analytical change.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency; SQL experience preferred or strong willingness to learn.
  • Experience with modern planning or BI tools (Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Pigment, Power BI, Tableau, or similar) preferred.
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
  • This role is for remote applicants. For local candidates this role will be hybrid. Apply here.

What Success Looks Like

  • Forecast accuracy improves because you've identified and resolved underlying data, process, and systems gaps — not just refined spreadsheet formulas.
  • Revenue and reimbursement forecasts become trusted inputs for executive and board decision-making because assumptions are transparent and business inputs are reliable.
  • Finance evolves from a reactive reporting function to a proactive planning capability, with scalable models and repeatable workflows.
  • Cross-functional teams — billing, operations, clinical — adopt new processes that improve the quality and timeliness of financial inputs.
  • Leadership has a clear, reliable picture of where the business is going, with the scenario analysis and risk visibility to make confident decisions.
  • You operate as a force multiplier — a senior individual contributor who drives the quality of financial thinking across the organization who helps build the finance team out over time.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental and Vision on the first of the month after employment
  • Paid Vacation, Sick, and Holiday time

  • Opportunity to work in a cutting-edge healthcare technology environment

You'll bring a strong point of view, lead cross-functional collaboration with confidence, and serve as a go-to resource for both your product domain and the customers it serves. This role is for someone who operates with a high degree of autonomy, thinks beyond features to outcomes, and mentors those around them.

What you’ll do

Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for one or more significant product areas within Blackthorn's suite
  • Define and prioritize outcomes, not just features, by deeply understanding customer needs, market trends, and business goals
  • Develop and maintain a well-reasoned, clearly communicated product roadmap aligned with company priorities

Execution & Delivery

  • Lead cross-functional squads through discovery, definition, and delivery of complex product initiatives
  • Write clear, thorough product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that set engineering and QA up for success
  • Drive Engineering team alignment and ensure your team is focused, unblocked, and moving toward meaningful outcomes
  • Own the squad’s delivery cadence, stay close to the work, track commitments, and actively remove blockers before they compound.
  • Work fluently in Blackthorn’s AI-first development environment, using AI tooling to accelerate discovery, documentation, and delivery.
  • Use product analytics and qualitative research to validate decisions and continuously improve shipped product

Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

  • Act as the primary product voice for your domain in conversations with Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success
  • Lead customer discovery interviews and synthesize insights into actionable product direction
  • Communicate confidently with senior leadership on roadmap, tradeoffs, and progress
  • Represent Blackthorn's product perspective with external partners and customers as needed

Team & Culture

  • Champion AI tooling and experimentation to improve both internal workflows and customer-facing experiences

What we look for

  • Solid experience as a Product Manager in a SaaS product environment, with a track record of owning and delivering complex product areas
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with the ability to drive execution through cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable presenting to executives and engaging with customers
  • Experience using product analytics to inform decisions and measure outcomes
  • Enthusiasm and fluency for AI and a proactive approach to finding ways it can improve products and processes
  • Proven ability to maintain high delivery velocity within a dedicated squad in an iterative, AI-assisted engineering environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with payments, events, or communications products
  • Familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem (platform capabilities, AppExchange dynamics, customer expectations)
  • Deep knowledge of Higher Education, Healthcare, or Nonprofit verticals
  • Experience mentoring or leading other PMs
  • Experience with mobile applications or event check-in technology
  • Background in UX, engineering, or consulting that informs how you work with technical teams

What we offer

  • An incredible team of smart and supportive people
  • A deep feeling of satisfaction and completion
  • Fully remote global team working from home
  • Stock options for every employee
  • Flexible work week
  • $400 office stipend
  • Maternity/Paternity leave
  • Student loan debt assistance
  • Pledge 1% - time off during the year for helping nonprofits
  • Health insurance contribution (if in the US)
  • Children's 529 college fund assistance (if in the US)

About Blackthorn

Blackthorn turns any organization's Salesforce® CRM into event planning software powered by their connected data. We're a growing, distributed team with teammates across the globe, and we build Salesforce-native tools that help teams create events, engage attendees, process payments, and measure success — all without leaving their CRM. Our customers range from tiny nonprofits to global corporations, and our products are known for going live in hours, not weeks. We believe the best enterprise software should feel as intuitive as the apps you use every day.

Why our work matters

Most event management tools force teams to juggle disconnected systems, wrestle with flimsy integrations, and spend more time syncing data than planning events. We're building the alternative: a connected platform inside Salesforce that gives organizations richer analytics to prove event ROI, better attendee experiences through personalization and automation, and the flexibility to fit any workflow. Every feature we ship helps our customers spend less time on logistics and more time on the events themselves.

What the job will bring you

A deep level of satisfaction through ownership of your role. You'll get more autonomy than at other companies (our team has told us). Connection. Our team is tightly knit, assisted through occasional team meetups (as we're remote). Challenge. We're trying to move as quickly as possible. This is not for you if you want to sit back and chill. As Ray Dalio says about life, "Meaningful work and meaningful relationships" provide meaning to life. We aim to bring this.

While we are a remote-first culture, we are currently only able to accept applicants in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, and WI

Our systems regularly process more than 12 billion emails during peak events like Black Friday, and our throughput requirements continue to scale rapidly. As an L2 engineer, you will help build and operate backend services at scale, working alongside more senior engineers on our dual-cloud infrastructure spanning Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure. Qualifications

jobs.description:
Lirio is a technology/software company that provides expertise in a variety of behavioral science domains (e.g., behavioral economics, social psychology, public health), data science, and machine learning to drive consumer engagement, close gaps in preventive and chronic care, and promote health and well-being across an individual’s lifespan. Lirio’s behavior change AI platform unites behavioral science with advanced artificial intelligence (AI) to deliver Precision Nudging health interventions. Precision Nudging is the application of behavioral science to health interventions personalized by AI to each individual that overcome barriers to action at the right time and place for scalable, behavior change.

This is a remote role with the opportunity to be hybrid if located in Tennessee. All applicants must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

To ensure an excellent onboarding experience and integration into the company, new colleagues will spend their first week onsite at one of our offices in Tennessee. Travel expenses will be paid. This is a requirement.

Position Summary

The LeadProduct Manager, Platform and Integrations owns the evolution of the platform foundation that enables Lirio to serve as the behavioral intelligence layer powering enterprise healthcare consumer engagement. This role leads Lirio’s intelligent decisioning and orchestration capabilities, and enterprise ecosystem integrations, translating behavioral science and AI-driven intelligence into coordinated, personalized interventions delivered through existing channels and technologies. They anticipate market trends and consumer needs and translate them into scalable product capabilities and clear product requirements. Partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data Science, AI/ML, Behavioral Science, Analytics, Security, and Client Success, they align teams around the product strategy and roadmap for Lirio’s core platform, making well-informed product and architectural trade-offs.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Market & Product Strategy

  • Envision, articulate, and deliver the platform strategy and product bets that shape Lirio's position in the healthcare market.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer and business challenges, market dynamics, and emerging opportunities by engaging customers and stakeholders, monitoring regulatory and policy developments, and participating in industry forums, and use those insights to shape product strategy.
  • Critically evaluate information from multiple sources and apply systems thinking to prioritize across competing demands, making rigorous, evidence-based trade-offs.

Platform & Integration Ownership

  • Own Lirio's decisioning and orchestration capabilities as products, defining how behavioral and AI-driven intelligence becomes coordinated, personalized interventions across the channels clients already use.
  • Own Lirio’s healthcare integration layer, including integrations with EHRs, HIEs, CRMs, digital experience platforms, and content management systems, as well as standards-based interoperability using FHIR, HL7, IAL2, and other relevant frameworks that connect Lirio to enterprise healthcare ecosystems.
  • Lead the build-out of integrations with Lirio's partner platforms, assessing technical fit, defining and prioritizing the integration requirements, and driving them through to delivery.
  • Define clear product requirements for data flows, event-driven workflows, identity, consent, and analytics, and make sound product and architectural trade-offs in partnership with engineering.
  • Keep the platform reliable, interoperable, extensible, and scalable across healthcare verticals and enterprise environments.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, AI/ML, Behavioral Science, Design, Analytics, Security, and Client Success to align teams and translate complex opportunities into clear requirements and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Lead through influence and leadership across organizational boundaries, building consensus among senior stakeholders, aligning competing priorities around platform outcomes, and guiding decisions on complex product, technical, and business trade-offs.
  • Serve as a trusted senior product voice with clients, partners, and executives, shaping understanding of platform strategy through clear recommendations, surfacing risks and dependencies, and constructively challenging requests and assumptions when evidence or long-term product value demands it.
  • Mentor and coach product managers, strengthening product practices and execution excellence across the organization.

Outcomes, Compliance & Responsible AI

  • Define, monitor, and ensure product metrics tie platform investment to company-level outcomes, spanning product adoption, operational, engagement, and health-outcome measures, and unlocking scalable revenue opportunities.
  • Embed healthcare compliance, security, and responsible AI into every stage of the product lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive product management experience, including ownership of complex enterprise platforms, integrations, or other technically sophisticated products, with demonstrated success setting strategy, influencing senior stakeholders, navigating product and architectural trade-offs, and delivering scalable capabilities across clients or markets.
  • Proven track record of leading complex platform initiatives from discovery through delivery with measurable impact on adoption, scalability, and business outcomes.
  • Strong product fundamentals: discovery, requirements definition, outcomes-driven prioritization, success metrics, and using data to validate assumptions and demonstrate impact.
  • Strong systems thinking and decision-making rigor, with the ability to reason across interconnected platforms, data, and integrations, weigh trade-offs against evidence, and make sound calls in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.
  • Proven ability to set technical product direction that is adopted across multiple teams, influencing without direct authority.
  • Strong communicator who distills complex technical ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives.
  • Understanding of the healthcare market and buyers (payers, providers, employers, retail health) highly preferred.
  • Experience defining or delivering partner, third-party, or platform integrations highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership in healthcare platforms, interoperability, or applied AI.
  • Does not need to write production code, but must be comfortable understanding system architecture, integration patterns, data models, event-driven workflows, identity resolution, analytics, and technical constraints.
  • Preferred technical experience may include REST APIs, Model Context Protocols and other integration patterns; healthcare data and interoperability (FHIR, HL7, EHR, pharmacy, or claims data); cloud-based and event-driven platforms; data pipelines, reporting, experimentation, and measurement; identity, consent, privacy, and preference management; and enterprise scalability, reliability, observability, and security.
  • Skilled negotiator who can challenge assumptions and push back on competing demands while keeping stakeholders aligned around the best product decision.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data and regulatory requirements strongly preferred.
  • Preferred: healthcare, digital health, payer/provider, retail health, or life sciences experience; experience with AI/ML-enabled or intelligence products; familiarity with HIPAA, PHI/ePHI, or regulated environments; and startup or high-growth company experience.

  • 401K with company match

POSITION SUMMARY

This position assists with the development of education/training materials, conducts and coordinates training and development of Health Information Management staff and other Banner staff as appropriate, including physicians/providers, and provides technical staff training in the usage of information systems components of the medical records database system. Creates and maintains all department training materials, tools and/or records. Conducts new hire skill assessments, department specific orientation, and initial training for work tasks and functions. Provides continuing education and annual regulatory updates.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Assesses and identifies skills, competencies and areas of learning and instruction needed for new hires, staff and department management. Assists with the development of education and training within specified area, which may include preparation of related educational materials.

2. Plans and coordinates the orientation programs for new hires to provide an introduction to the department and facility, to define employment expectations and standards, to provide prerequisite knowledge required, and to train in the basic job skills.

3. Develops and maintains an education calendar and individual continuing education and orientation record for each member of the assigned work group. Develops and conducts programs with educational materials, procedures and exercises that are task/function specific using a variety of learning and evaluation strategies for all staff.

4. Provides for onsite support of trainees, and acts as a knowledge resource for all staff. Problem-solves and troubleshoots issues involving HIMS electronic applications. This may include monitoring and reviewing clinical documentation to ensure that clinical coding is accurate for proper reimbursement and that coding compliance is complete.

5. Works in regional/system-wide teams to develop Health Information Management Systems and Services educational materials and activities, and promotes standardized practices throughout the region and/or company.

6. May collect and/or coordinate the collection of data, compile reports and graphs and present findings at Medical Staff Committee meetings, Clinical Documentation Specialist meetings and/or other appropriate department, facility and system level meetings. May also coordinate and perform clinical pertinence and inter-disciplinary chart reviews, ensuring the reviews meet government and regulatory standards.

7. Maintains a current knowledge relating to Health Information Management Systems by attending educational workshops/conferences, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and/or participating in professional societies. This may also include performing ongoing research to ensure compliance with clinical documentation and/or regulatory guidelines and standards.

8. Works independently under general supervision and utilizes analytical and creative thinking skills, and influencing abilities. Training responsibilities include, but are not limited to, all HIMS staff and staff assigned to related work teams, as well as physicians/providers. Customers include Health Information Management, Financial Services and Clinical Documentation leadership and staff, as well as other members of the integrated healthcare team.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Must possess a current knowledge of business and/or healthcare as normally obtained through the completion of a bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration or related field, plus advanced training in Health Information Management requirements and systems and in adult learning principles.

In the acute care coding environment, requires a Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technologist (RHIT) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) in an active status with the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC). In the ambulatory coding environment, requires Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification or Certified Coding Specialist-Physician (CCS-P), with RHIA, RHIT or CCS certification preferred. Requires the knowledge typically acquired over three or more years of work experience in healthcare information management. Must be well versed in regulatory requirements for medical record documentation, as well as Medical Staff Rules and Regulations where applicable. Must have demonstrated education and training skills. Medical terminology and an understanding of the laws and regulations associated with medical records functions are required. Must be able to function as part of a team, using effective interpersonal and instructional skills. Must possess excellent written, verbal, and customer service skills, and have the ability to conduct educational needs analysis and to teach effectively to a wide range of comprehension levels.

Must be proficient in the use of common office and presentation software and have an advanced knowledge and experience with computer healthcare applications and hardware.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Previous training/teaching experience and customer service education experience preferred. Creativity and knowledge of adult learning principles preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

The ideal candidate brings deep analytical capabilities, strategic thinking, and the cross-functional leadership presence required to positively influence and own outcomes across all regions, segments, and go-to-market motions. This person will have decision rights, executive presence, and the confidence to drive alignment across senior leaders and resolve conflicts when they arise.

Key Responsibilities

Pricing Strategy & Packaging

  • Own pricing and packaging architecture across plans, bundles, add-ons, usage metrics, and segment-specific offers.

  • Design pricing models (subscription, usage-based, tiered, value-based, etc.) that support company growth objectives across product-led and sales-led motions.

  • Conduct pricing analyses to identify revenue optimization opportunities and margin improvements.

  • Evaluate competitive pricing, market trends, and customer willingness-to-pay.

  • Develop pricing strategies that account for global markets, currencies, and regional dynamics, ensuring consistency while allowing for localized optimization.

  • Design and optimize pricing models that incorporate payments, transaction fees, and monetization of payment flows (e.g., take rates, interchange, processing fees).

  • Lead end-to-end pricing for existing customers and new product launches, from architecting packaging and tier logic to setting price points that drive retention, growth, and margin targets, ensuring new offerings integrate cleanly with existing bundles and tiering structures.

Revenue Growth & Profitability

  • Partner with Sales leadership to establish pricing guardrails, discounting frameworks, and deal approval processes.

  • Own implementation of final tiered approval authority matrix on discounting for individual deals, ensuring pricing discipline while supporting sales velocity.

  • Monitor pricing performance and drive initiatives to improve ARR, deal size, and profitability.

  • Drive monetization strategies that optimize end-to-end revenue, including payments-related revenue streams, while balancing customer experience and conversion.

AI & Advanced Analytics

  • Apply AI-driven analytics and predictive modeling to optimize pricing strategies for existing and new customers, forecast revenue impact, and identify pricing opportunities across customer segments.

  • Use machine learning and advanced data insights to analyze customer behavior, price elasticity, and market dynamics to inform pricing decisions.

  • Partner with Data and Technology teams to implement AI-enabled pricing tools and automation that enhance pricing intelligence and decision-making.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product and Product Marketing to ensure pricing is tightly connected to product packaging and positioning.

  • Collaborate with Finance to forecast revenue impact of pricing changes and track pricing KPIs.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations to operationalize pricing models within CRM and quoting tools.

  • Partner with Payments, Finance, and Product teams to connect pricing with payment infrastructure, cost structures, and margin optimization across geographies.

Analytics & Insights

  • Build pricing models and analytics to evaluate elasticity, customer segments, and pricing scenarios.

  • Establish dashboards and reporting to track pricing effectiveness and revenue impact.

  • Use data-driven insights to guide leadership in decision-making.

  • Analyze regional pricing performance, currency impacts, and payment-related economics to inform global pricing strategy and profitability.

Governance & Enablement

  • Establish and lead a formal cross-functional pricing committee that reviews and approves all pricing changes, evaluates new pricing concepts, and provides consistent governance across the business.

  • Own pricing governance, approval frameworks, and decision rights across list pricing, discounting, and segment-specific offers.

  • Implement pricing policies and discount guidelines that protect margins while enabling sales execution.

  • Support sales enablement by developing pricing tools, training, and documentation.

  • Ensure pricing compliance across deals and contracts.

Qualifications

  • 10–15+ years of experience in pricing, revenue strategy, revenue operations, finance, or consulting.

  • Experience in SaaS, technology, or subscription-based business models preferred.

  • Proven track record developing and implementing pricing and packaging strategies in SaaS/subscription businesses.

  • Experience with monetization experiments, pricing rollouts, migrations, or commercial launches.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in financial modeling and data analysis.

  • Experience partnering with executive leadership and influencing cross-functional teams.

  • Deep understanding of deal economics, discounting strategies, and revenue metrics (ARR, ACV, LTV, CAC).

  • Experience applying AI and advanced analytics tools to support pricing optimization, forecasting, demand modeling, and revenue insights.

  • Familiarity with AI-driven pricing tools, predictive analytics, or machine learning models used to analyze customer behavior, price elasticity, and market dynamics.

  • Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and leadership skills.

  • Experience operating in international or multi-currency environments, with an understanding of regional pricing strategies and market dynamics.

  • Experience in businesses with both product-led growth (PLG) and sales-led growth (SLG) monetization motions strongly preferred.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience implementing pricing within CRM/CPQ systems (e.g., Salesforce).

  • Experience leading pricing teams or centers of excellence.

  • Familiarity with global payment processing, interchange economics, and cost structures.

  • Experience scaling pricing strategies across international markets and multiple currencies.

  • Experience working with or alongside payments platforms, fintech products, or embedded payments solutions.

We are seeking a hands-on, full-stack Product Manager to support the evolution of Mitratech's Applicant Tracking System (ATS) within our HR Solutions (HRS) division.

This is not a purely strategic PM role. You will be expected to write detailed requirements, run day-to-day sprint execution, and step directly into gaps — supporting teams without a dedicated TPM, or filling in where design or engineering resourcing is thin — as needed. You'll work closely with two scrum teams, owning day-to-day product direction, removing delivery roadblocks, and ensuring consistent progress against roadmap priorities.

You will act as the connective tissue between business stakeholders, customers, and engineering — translating complex needs into actionable outcomes while maintaining a strong focus on customer value and business impact.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of product initiatives across multiple Scrum teams
  • Write detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria yourself — not just direct others to write them
  • Act as the primary point of contact for two Scrum teams, providing clarity, prioritization, and rapid decision-making
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring alignment with roadmap goals
  • Remove blockers and proactively address risks to maintain delivery momentum
  • Partner with stakeholders across business, sales, customer success, and support to gather requirements and align priorities
  • Conduct customer, market, and competitive research to inform product direction
  • Define success metrics and evaluate product performance, including adoption, engagement, and business outcomes
  • Lead sprint ceremonies (planning, grooming, reviews) as a regular part of the role, not an occasional one
  • Test, validate, and iterate on features in close collaboration with engineering and QA
  • Present product updates, demos, and business cases to internal and external audiences

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 2–5 years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a hybrid PM/PO role in B2B SaaS — ideally in lean or small teams where you personally owned requirements, backlog, and delivery without a dedicated TPM, EM, or tech lead to lean on
  • Proven ability to drive execution across multiple releases or product initiatives, including writing your own requirements and staying close to daily sprint work
  • Strong ability to write clear, detailed product requirements and work closely with engineering teams
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with high delivery expectations
  • Experience applying AI tools (e.g., LLMs, analytics, or automation tools) to generate customer insights, improve product decisions, or increase team productivity
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and make decisions with limited guidance, in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and user-centric thinking skills
  • Excellent communication skills — able to give direct, structured answers (problem → action → outcome) with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, globally distributed team environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HR technology, ATS platforms, or talent acquisition workflows
  • Understanding of hiring lifecycle challenges (high-volume hiring, onboarding, compliance)
  • Exposure to integrating acquired products or platform consolidation efforts
  • Familiarity with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Figma, Miro, and Productboard

What Success Looks Like

  • You drive consistent, predictable delivery across multiple scrum teams
  • You are highly responsive and unblock teams quickly to maintain velocity
  • You translate ambiguity into clear, actionable plans and requirements
  • You build strong trust with engineering, stakeholders, and leadership
  • You deliver features that improve hiring efficiency and customer outcomes

In a nutshell, we're helping prevent a repeat of the 2008 global financial crisis by offering the data and tools required to make smarter data-driven decisions resulting in a safer world for all of us.

A Senior Reverse Engineer marries quantitative skills with a deep understanding of ABS, RMBS, Private Credit, Structured Finance, and Mortgage markets to ensure that users, across all of the asset classes dv01 serves, receive accurate deal data and cashflows.

The Senior Reverse Engineer reports to the Securitizations Manager. Because securitization cashflows are dependent on loan level data and impact various products, Reverse Engineers partner closely with our Integration, QA and Data Engineering teams in ensuring valid cashflow projections. The role offers cross-functional exposure across our business, consequently providing you with great exposure to the different areas in which you may want to develop your career, as you grow with us.

You will:

  • Reverse engineer structure finance transactions. You will set up deal waterfalls for Consumer Unsecured, Mortgages, Student Loans, Private Credit and other asset classes based on the Offering Memorandum and supporting documents. You will be a critical piece in dv01's cashflow efforts across the structured finance space.
  • Expand your structured finance knowledge. You will gain exposure to many facets of the ABS and RMBS spaces, combining information from a variety of sources (cashflow tieout packages, deal documents, trustee reports, etc.) that all flow into dv01's wide range of client offerings.
  • Enhance your technical skills. You will work closely with engineering teams at dv01 to develop and productize solutions both for our customers and internally. You will drive processes to improve data quality through a variety of technologies.

You are:

  • Proficient in cashflow modeling of complex deal structures with a focus on Private Credit transactions. You have 4+ years experience working in structured finance reverse engineering. An expert in interpreting complex deal documentation and extracting relevant data and concepts. Highly effective at collaborating with quantitative analysts, QA teams, and data engineers to ensure the seamless onboarding and ongoing maintenance of securitized deals.
  • An analytical problem solver. You are proficient in Excel. You have solid quantitative skills and are competent at modeling deal waterfalls. You either know or are eager to learn Python/SQL to perform ad-hoc data analysis, with a desire and ability to grow quickly on the technical front.
  • Able to analyze financial statements. You are able to identify key metrics and transactional details on cashflow statements, investor reports, securitization trustee reports and are not afraid to get your hands dirty by diving into loan-level data.

You are an experienced psychiatric clinician who understands both the realities of direct patient care and the opportunities technology creates to improve access to mental healthcare. You are equally comfortable consulting on complex clinical situations, analyzing operational data, improving processes, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, and coaching team members.

You thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace ambiguity, and are excited by the opportunity to build and scale psychiatric operations as BetterHelp continues expanding its behavioral healthcare services.

What will you do?

Clinical Quality & Compliance

  • Lead a team who conducts audits and reviews of provider activity and clinical documentation as needed.
  • Lead psychiatric quality assurance initiatives and support investigations involving provider performance, prescribing concerns, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance.
  • Help your team provide actionable, constructive, and clinically informed feedback to psychiatric providers.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Credentialing, and Patient Safety teams to ensure adherence to applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Stay current on evolving telehealth, prescribing, and psychiatric practice regulations and communicate relevant changes throughout the organization.
  • Develop strong relationships with providers to improve engagement, satisfaction, retention, and platform success.
  • Identify trends impacting psychiatric providers and recommend operational improvements.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Directly manage and develop Psychiatry Operations team members, including Clinical Operations Managers, Quality Assurance Specialists, and Psychiatry Support Specialists.
  • Establish team priorities, workflows, performance expectations, and operational goals.
  • Coach and mentor team members through complex clinical and operational scenarios.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and development as the Psychiatry Operations function scales.

Operational Excellence & Strategy

  • Monitor key performance indicators, quality metrics, provider engagement data, and operational trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Use data-driven decision making to optimize provider experience, member outcomes, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives involving psychiatric care delivery, provider support, quality assurance, and risk mitigation.
  • Help develop scalable operational processes to support future growth and expansion of psychiatric offerings.

Product & Innovation

  • Serve as a clinical subject matter expert for psychiatric care delivery and medication management workflows. Partner with Associate Medical Director for thought-partnership.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, AI, and Clinical Operations stakeholders to identify opportunities for platform enhancements.
  • Provide clinical guidance on new products, tools, workflows, and technology initiatives impacting psychiatric providers and members.
  • Support implementation and adoption of new technologies, including AI-enabled workflows and quality initiatives.

External Representation

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, and Public Relations teams as needed.
  • Participate in provider-facing webinars, training events, educational content, and media opportunities.
  • Represent BetterHelp's commitment to safe, ethical, and accessible psychiatric care.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain a small caseload of psychiatric clients on the platform (approx 2-3 clinical hours per week) to understand the lived experience of our providers.
  • Support insurance and payer-related quality initiatives as BetterHelp expands its healthcare offerings.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • Active, unrestricted Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) license in good standing.
  • Minimum 5 years of post-licensure clinical experience providing psychiatric assessment, diagnosis, and medication management.
  • Demonstrated leadership, supervisory, or management experience.
  • Strong understanding of psychiatric prescribing practices, risk assessment, documentation standards, and clinical quality management.
  • Experience investigating or resolving complex clinical, quality, compliance, or provider performance concerns.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-informed decisions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with clinical, operational, legal, product, and executive stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and drive projects to completion.
  • Passion for improving access to high-quality mental healthcare through innovation and technology.
  • Ideally located or licensed in AL, GA, IN, MO, MS, NC, OH, TN, TX

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience delivering psychiatric services via telehealth preferred.
  • Experience supporting or supervising other psychiatric providers.
  • Experience in healthcare operations, quality assurance, utilization management, or clinical leadership roles.

  • Support Patriot's values through leadership, collaboration, and customer-focused decision-making.

Please note: this is a sample of your responsibilities. You'll need to adapt quickly as priorities evolve to support an exceptional customer experience.
