The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on Senior Database Reliability Engineer to help design, build, and scale the database platform used across Sezzle’s applications.

This is not a traditional DBA role. This role is for an engineer who can combine deep database knowledge with software engineering, infrastructure engineering, and platform thinking. You will help build the systems, libraries, automation, standards, and guardrails that make database usage across Sezzle reliable, secure, scalable, and easy for developers to adopt correctly.

As a Senior Database Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for improving how Sezzle applications connect to, migrate, operate, observe, and scale their databases. You will work across application teams, infrastructure, security, and engineering leadership to define patterns that improve database reliability by design — not just by operational response.

You should be comfortable owning problems end-to-end: understanding application behavior, reading code, reviewing database access patterns, building shared tooling, improving connection management, designing migration safety checks, analyzing production performance, and helping developers use databases in safer and more scalable ways.

You should consider yourself a DOer to be a good fit for this role. We are looking for someone who can ship production-quality engineering work, not just advise from the sidelines. With AI tooling and automation, you should be a force multiplier for database reliability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Sezzle.

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain shared database platform components used by Sezzle applications, such as database connection packages, database client libraries, migration tooling, safety checks, query standards, and developer-facing abstractions.
  • Establish reliable, scalable patterns for how Sezzle services connect to and interact with relational databases across production, staging, and development environments.
  • Partner with backend engineering teams to improve database usage in application code, including connection lifecycle, transaction handling, retries, timeouts, pooling, query patterns, and migration workflows.
  • Build automation and internal tooling that makes database operations safer, more repeatable, and less dependent on manual intervention.
  • Define and enforce engineering standards for database access, schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, connection management, and operational readiness.
  • Architect and improve database infrastructure across AWS RDS/Aurora MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDS Proxy, read replicas, backups, failover, parameter groups, monitoring, and capacity planning.
  • Lead database reliability initiatives that reduce operational risk, improve performance, and help Sezzle scale safely.
  • Review application designs and database changes early in the development lifecycle to ensure reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security are built in from the start.
  • Build guardrails for database migrations, including automated checks, rollback expectations, schema review workflows, migration observability, and production safety controls.
  • Improve developer self-service for database provisioning, access, schema management, local development, testing, and observability.
  • Investigate production database issues by combining application telemetry, database metrics, logs, query plans, traces, and cloud infrastructure data.
  • Identify and fix systemic database problems, not just symptoms — including bad access patterns, unsafe migrations, inefficient queries, connection storms, lock contention, replication lag, and capacity bottlenecks.
  • Create and maintain high-signal dashboards, alerts, SLOs, SLIs, runbooks, and operational readiness checks for database-backed services.
  • Drive improvements in database backup validation, restore testing, disaster recovery, failover readiness, and business continuity.
  • Work with security and compliance teams to improve database access controls, auditability, encryption, secrets management, least privilege, and PCI/SOC 2 aligned controls.
  • Mentor engineers on database design, query performance, safe migrations, operational readiness, and production debugging.
  • Use automation and AI tooling where appropriate to improve migration review, query analysis, incident investigation, documentation, and developer productivity.

What We look for:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, database engineering, SRE, or platform engineering experience.
  • Strong software engineering ability in at least one production programming language such as Go, Python, or TypeScript.
  • Proven ability to build production-quality internal tools, libraries, frameworks, services, or platform components used by other engineers.
  • Deep hands-on experience with relational databases, especially MySQL and/or PostgreSQL, in high-availability production environments.
  • Strong understanding of how application code interacts with databases, including connection pooling, transactions, isolation levels, retries, timeouts, deadlocks, locking, migrations, and query execution.
  • Experience designing or improving shared database access patterns, internal database packages, ORM wrappers, migration frameworks, or developer-facing database tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS RDS/Aurora, including provisioning, upgrades, replicas, backups, failover, monitoring, parameter tuning, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience with database connection management technologies such as RDS Proxy, PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or application-level pooling.
  • Strong ability to analyze database performance using query plans, indexes, slow query logs, wait events, locks, metrics, and application traces.
  • Experience designing safe database migration processes for production systems.
  • Strong understanding of observability for database-backed applications, including metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerting, and incident response.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD systems such as Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, or similar tooling.
  • Ability to influence engineering teams through clear design reviews, documentation, technical standards, and practical implementation.
  • Ability to operate independently, identify high-impact problems, propose pragmatic solutions, and drive them to completion.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience building platform capabilities for a microservices environment.
  • Experience with Golang application development and database access patterns.
  • Experience creating database libraries, SDKs, service templates, migration frameworks, or paved-road developer tooling.
  • Experience improving database reliability across many services or teams, not just one application.
  • Experience with fintech, payments, banking, e-commerce, or other high-volume transactional systems.
  • Experience with compliance-sensitive environments such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, or SOX.
  • Experience with database access governance, audit logging, secrets management, encryption, IAM authentication, and least-privilege access models.
  • Experience with large-scale operational automation for provisioning, patching, failover testing, backup validation, access management, or schema review.
  • Experience with distributed systems patterns such as transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, idempotency, queues, eventual consistency, and data consistency tradeoffs.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, Performance Insights, OpenTelemetry, or New Relic.
  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch or other supporting data stores.
  • Familiarity with AI developer tooling such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, and using it to be a more productive engineer.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About Sybilla Technologies📡
Sybilla Technologies designs, builds and operates robotic optical observatories for monitoring objects in space. The company specializes in complete systems, software for automated data acquisition, analysis, and scheduling networks of sensors. We work in the domains of Space Situational Awareness, Space Surveillance and Tracking, Space Traffic Management, stellar and planetary research, education, and commercial on-demand observations.

About The Role
As a Passive RF / Signal Processing Engineer, you will develop software that processes SDR and RF data collected by distributed ground stations. Your work will span the entire signal processing pipeline—from ingesting raw IQ captures through synchronization, spectral analysis and signal detection to extracting meaningful information from real-world satellite transmissions.

This is a software-first engineering role for someone who enjoys solving challenging DSP problems, bridging theory with real hardware limitations, and delivering reliable, production-ready tools. If you're passionate about RF signal processing, satellite communications, or SDR technologies, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge solutions that support the future of space operations.

As a Passive RF Signal Processing Engineer, you will:
  • Design and develop software pipelines for processing RF/IQ data collected from SDR-based satellite monitoring systems.
  • Build robust tools for SDR data ingestion, validation, metadata verification, and format conversion.
  • Implement digital signal processing algorithms, including filtering, resampling, DC offset removal, and Doppler compensation.
  • Develop solutions for spectral analysis, channelization, and signal characterization.
  • Implement precise time synchronization mechanisms using GPSDO and distributed sensor networks.
  • Support satellite listening workflows by integrating orbital data, pass prediction, Doppler correction, and capture correlation.
  • Analyze system performance by measuring clock drift, timing accuracy, frequency offsets, and hardware-related impairments.
  • Develop signal detection and localization algorithms using techniques such as FDOA and TDOA.
  • Research, prototype and evaluate new DSP and RF processing methods before transforming them into maintainable production software.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, RF specialists, hardware teams, and system analysts to deliver reliable operational capabilities.
Essential Experience:
  • Professional experience developing software for RF, SDR, telecommunications, GNSS, satellite communications, telemetry, spectrum monitoring or comparable signal processing systems.
  • Strong understanding of digital signal processing fundamentals, including sampling theory, aliasing, FFT/STFT, filtering, resampling, synchronization, modulation/demodulation, SNR estimation and spectral analysis.
  • Hands-on experience working with RF/IQ data, including signal formats, metadata handling, and processing pipelines.
  • Strong Python programming skills with NumPy and SciPy, and the ability to develop reproducible scripts, notebooks, CLIs or data processing services.
  • Experience using Git, automated testing, debugging, profiling and modern software engineering best practices.
  • Ability to study technical specifications and scientific literature, prototype and benchmark algorithms, and translate them into robust, maintainable software.
  • Ability to communicate technical results through spectrograms, residual error plots, logs, and concise technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and spoken English.
Nice to Have
  • Experience developing performance-critical DSP software in C/C++.
  • Experience with GNU Radio, UHD/USRP, RTL-SDR, HackRF, bladeRF, LimeSDR or similar SDR ecosystems. Experience with satellite communications, telemetry decoding, or TT&C systems.
  • Knowledge of Doppler compensation, TLE/orbit propagation, and satellite pass prediction.
  • Familiarity with RF geolocation techniques such as TDOA, FDOA, and calibration methods.
  • Experience building or operating an SDR station, antenna systems, GPSDO or satellite ground stations.
  • Practical experience troubleshooting RF hardware, including antenna polarization, gain staging, clock synchronization, LO drift, interference, multipath effects and calibration.
  • Experience using RF laboratory equipment such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, or signal generators.
  • Contributions to open-source DSP/SDR projects, technical publications, conference presentations or personal RF engineering projects.
What We Offer
  • Joining Sybilla Technologies means becoming part of a growing deep-tech company operating at the forefront of the space industry. We offer:
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge satellite monitoring and Space Domain Awareness technologies
  • Real engineering challenges involving RF, DSP, SDR and space systems
  • Remote-first working model with our headquarters located in Bydgoszcz
  • Compensation package (which will depend on candidate`s skills and qualifications):
    • Employment contract (UoP):20,000–24,000 PLN gross
    • B2B: 155–185 PLN net/hour
  • Flexible working hours and full-time employment
  • Private medical care (LuxMed)
  • Multisport card
  • A collaborative environment where your ideas directly influence products used in real-world space applications
  • The opportunity to work alongside highly skilled engineers solving technically demanding problems with real impact

As part of your participation in the recruitment process, we will process your personal data. The controller of your personal data is Sybilla Technologies sp. z o.o., with its registered office in Bydgoszcz.

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREOur mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities. Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact.We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

We are a growing, private-equity-backed business focused on meaningful work

OUR TEAM & CULTURE

We believe technology should strengthen communities and support the professionals who lead their programs. Our team is committed to building meaningful tools while fostering a workplace where people feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

We take the work seriously. We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

A senior C#/.NET engineer who modernizes the platform, not just maintains it

Our flagship product, Volunteer Impact, is a mature, revenue-generating platform built on VB.NET and .NET Framework. It works. It serves thousands of organizations. And it needs to move to .NET 10 and C# so we can hire, ship, and build on a modern stack.

You’ve done this before. You’ve been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-modern-.NET migration of a real production monolith where downtime had to be tightly managed. You know how to migrate incrementally without breaking a live system, and your opinions come from experience, not theory. You’ve lived in NHibernate, swapped out legacy DI containers and dead dependencies, and dealt with custom security frameworks that predate ASP.NET Core’s policy model.

You’re still hands-on. You write code daily, configure your own CI pipelines, and can replace a legacy dependency, validate the regression risk, and ship the change to production. You want a role where you own the company’s most important technical initiative, not one where you draw architecture diagrams and hand them off.

You do serious work with a small core team, supported by fractional DevOps and release expertise when it matters, and a dedicated quality engineering function that owns the regression gate protecting this migration. You own the technical path, make sound trade-offs, and work directly with those partners to move the platform forward. You’re here to build the engineering foundation, not inherit one.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the migration of the Volunteer Impact backend from VB.NET/.NET Framework to C#/.NET 10, defining the migration approach and executing it incrementally against a live production system
  • Modernize a custom security framework (70+ custom attributes) into something that works on the new stack, with zero authorization bypasses
  • Strengthen the existing CI/CD pipeline and, with our quality engineering function, wire in the gates that catch functional and performance regressions before they reach production
  • Ship migrated areas to production independently and incrementally while the legacy application keeps running
  • Become the second engineer who can independently cut, validate, and deploy a production release
  • Identify, evaluate, and replace legacy dependencies that don’t have a path forward to modern .NET, without introducing functional or performance regressions
  • Make the technical sequencing calls: which areas migrate first, which dependencies get replaced when, and where automated conversion is viable vs. manual rewrite
  • Lay the foundation for the team to grow by modernizing the stack to one that any C# developer can contribute to

Requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8+ years of professional C#/.NET experience, with real depth in the framework, not just the latest version
  • You’ve personally led or been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-.NET Core (or later) migration of a large, production monolith serving paying customers
  • You’ve migrated a production system incrementally with minimal downtime and can articulate the approach you’d take here
  • Deep NHibernate experience is strongly preferred. We’re keeping NHibernate to reduce migration risk, so the value is understanding a mature data access layer, preserving existing behaviour, and knowing where modernization helps without unnecessary churn.
  • You’ve replaced legacy dependencies in production: DI containers, bundling frameworks, service hosting, and unsupported third-party libraries. You know how to swap critical components while the plane is flying.
  • Hands-on experience with legacy .NET ecosystem components: ASP.NET MVC-to-Core routing, custom security frameworks, and the kinds of dependencies that don’t have a clean upgrade path
  • Familiarity with migrating SSRS reports to a modern reporting platform is a benefit. We have a significant reporting footprint, so preserving report behaviour during that move would be valuable.
  • You’ve improved CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications and know how to work with a quality function to build gates that catch functional and performance regressions early
  • You’re comfortable in a small core team with shared DevOps and DBA support available, and a dedicated quality engineering partner who owns the regression gate across our platforms. You can make sound technical decisions, debug hands-on, and know when to pull the right support in.
  • VB.NET familiarity is a bonus, not a requirement. The job is the conversion, not maintaining VB.NET.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿401(k) (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿Unlimited vacation + 9 paid holidays
  • ﻿﻿Paid parental leave
  • ﻿﻿Competitive comp package

jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

The OpenConfig team who are responsible for building a dynamic, programmable data centre infrastructure using software-defined networking principles such as declarative configuration and model-driven management and operations.

What You'll Do

Arista’s engineering team started from a blank sheet of paper to architect an entirely new networking operating system. Arista’s unique architecture is based on three guiding principles:

1. State orientation

2. Open standards-based approach

3. Single software image consistency

1) State Orientation for publish-subscribe communication

State Orientation uses a unique multi-process state-sharing architecture that separates state information from protocol processing and application logic with a central database shared by diverse applications. Both system state and data are stored in the system database where data is accessed via an automated publish/subscribe model. This distinct design principle provides module independence, self-healing resiliency, and multi-process software stability. It is an elegant distributed systems solution applied holistically right across the network. This contrasts with the decades-old legacy approach of many competitors that uses extensive inter-process communications (IPC), a shared memory bus, or a complex message passing framework to communicate across the system components.

2) An Open Approach

Arista took to heart the lessons of the open-source world and built EOS on top of an unmodified Linux kernel, maintaining full, secured access to the Linux shell and utilities. It is notable that it is the same Linux OS that Arista’s customers run in their data centers and on their servers. This foundational methodology enables EOS to preserve the security, feature development, and tools of the Linux community, unlike legacy approaches where the original OS kernel is either modified or based on older, less maintained versions. By adhering to open source Linux, EOS also natively supports Linux containers and virtual machines, simplifying the deployment of new services and enhancing DevOps practices.

3) A Single Image

Arista’s third and crucial guiding principle is to provide a single software image that runs across all products in various packaging forms - physical platforms, virtual machines, and containers. The EOS single image uses the same source code, and the same version of the software released across the entire portfolio of switches and routers, thus improving network testing and reliability while reducing the complexity and cost of network operations. This approach is a large differentiator to legacy vendors who use multiple operating systems with numerous images to implement a siloed network. Managing these multiple software images with quality control testing or new features testing multiplies operational costs. In contrast, when Arista releases a new software version, customers merely deploy a single image network-wide. In addition, having a single image improves automation workflows by allowing DevOps tools, such as Ansible or Terraform, to work across all Arista devices with a single integration. Using these integrations, operators can establish Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that build, test, and deploy network configurations across the entire data center with increased speed and reliability.

  • Strong engineering and Computer Science fundamentals.
  • Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills.
  • 5+ Fluency in one of C or C++ programming.
  • Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • Participate in evaluating and onboarding new cloud engineering talent as the team grows

  • Architect, deploy, and manage a secure Azure cloud environment including hub-spoke network topology, Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, API Management, and Private Endpoints

  • Establish and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Azure Bicep) practices including module structure, state management, review workflow, and environment promotion — ensuring all infrastructure changes are version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and auditable with no undocumented manual changes in production

Requisition Number: 105241

Solution Principal Sr

Now is the time to expand your knowledge and drive business solutions with Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in Digital Enablement, Cloud, Data, AI, Innovative Apps, Cybersecurity, and Intelligent Edge, we guide organizations through their complex digital journey.

About the role

As a Sr. Solution Principal – Microsoft AI & Innovation, you will be a key presales leader responsible for shaping and selling AI-led professional services across the Microsoft ecosystem. You will consult with clients, assess their AI readiness and Microsoft estate, define pragmatic AI adoption roadmaps, and translate them into clearly scoped professional services Statements of Work (SOWs). Your remit spans the full Microsoft surface area — Modern Work (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams), Capability (Azure platform, infrastructure, and security foundations), Application Development (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, custom agents), and Data & AI (Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry) — with a heavy focus on Microsoft Agent 365 and enterprise AI strategy.

As agentic AI moves from experimentation to enterprise-scale operation, clients need a trusted advisor who can connect AI ambition to a governed, secure, and value-driven adoption path. You will be that advisor — shaping how organizations deploy, govern, and scale AI agents responsibly on Microsoft.

You will need a balance of:

  • Strategic presales acumen across the Microsoft AI portfolio
  • Deep understanding of AI adoption, Agent 365 governance, and the Microsoft Cloud
  • Business consulting and AI strategy skills
  • Strong SOW and deal-structuring experience

You will partner closely with account teams, solution architects, and delivery leaders to design AI-driven solutions that achieve measurable client outcomes.

In this role, you will:

Client consulting & discovery

  • Align into top accounts to build relationships with senior IT and business stakeholders (CIO, CDO, CTO, CISO, Head of Modern Work, and Line-of-Business leaders).
  • Lead AI discovery and readiness workshops to understand current-state Microsoft estate, workplace productivity patterns, data landscape, governance maturity, and agent adoption readiness.
  • Assess the client’s Microsoft footprint — Microsoft 365 and Copilot adoption, Azure platform maturity, identity and security posture (Entra, Purview, Defender), and data estate (Fabric, Azure data services) — to identify pain points and AI opportunities.
  • Translate business objectives into prioritized AI use cases and adoption roadmaps spanning Copilot rollout, custom agent development, Agent 365 governance, and modern data foundations.

AI strategy & solution architecture

  • Define future-state Microsoft AI architectures that span Modern Work, Capability, Application Development, and Data & AI — anchored on Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft Agent 365.
  • Shape enterprise AI strategy: help clients move from ad hoc agent experimentation to a governed operating model, defining how agents are identified, owned, secured, and scaled.
  • Position Microsoft Agent 365 as the control plane for AI agents — covering agent identity (Microsoft Entra Agent ID), observability, governance, security, and lifecycle management across first-party, custom, and third-party agents.
  • Recommend responsible-AI and Zero Trust patterns that align agent access with least-privilege, Conditional Access, data protection (Purview), and threat protection (Defender).
  • Craft outcome-focused solution narratives that connect AI investments to business value (productivity gains, faster time-to-insight, reduced manual effort, trusted and governed automation).
  • Collaborate with technical SMEs (AI engineers, data engineers, app developers, cloud and security architects) to validate feasibility, sizing, and delivery approach.

SOW creation & deal structuring

  • Lead the creation of professional services proposals and SOWs across the Microsoft AI portfolio (AI readiness assessments, Copilot adoption, agent development, Agent 365 governance enablement, data modernization, and app modernization for AI).
  • Define scope, deliverables, assumptions, and client responsibilities with enough detail to enable predictable delivery.
  • Design deal structures that meet internal margin targets, align with preferred delivery models (fixed-fee, T&M, multi-phase roadmaps), and match client expectations and risk tolerance.
  • Work with resource management and delivery leaders to develop realistic staffing and ramp plans based on skills, availability, and project timelines.
  • Ensure SOWs adhere to Insight’s standards, legal/commercial guidelines, and risk controls.

Sales collaboration & pipeline support

  • Engage with sellers to refine understanding of client needs during qualification and shape win strategies for Microsoft AI opportunities.
  • Support account teams in early-stage opportunity shaping, including ideation of AI engagements (assessments, PoCs, Copilot pilots, agent programs, multi-phase transformations).
  • Represent client needs across all Insight capabilities, with a focus on expanding AI deal size and attaching services to Microsoft platform and licensing investments.
  • Support sellers in executive presentations, proposal walkthroughs, and orals — clearly articulating our Microsoft AI value proposition and differentiation.
  • Participate in internal deal reviews with Insight leadership, presenting solution approach, delivery risks, and financials.

Partner engagement & offerings

  • Develop strong working relationships with Microsoft field and product teams and incorporate the latest Microsoft AI capabilities (Copilot, Agent 365, Azure AI Foundry, Fabric) into client solutions.
  • Leverage Microsoft partner incentives and funding (PoCs, pilots, workshops, assessments, FastTrack) to accelerate AI opportunities.
  • Provide feedback into Insight’s Microsoft AI offerings and accelerators based on client demand and field experience.

Governance, quality & reporting

  • Own solutions for assigned opportunities end-to-end, ensuring consistency between presales design and delivery handoff.
  • Actively track Microsoft AI opportunities being worked, providing leadership with regular reporting on pipeline, revenue, and gross profit.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of presales artifacts (templates, reference architectures, SOW standards, estimators).

What we’re looking for

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years in technology roles such as Solution Architect, AI/Cloud Architect, Modern Work Architect, App Development Lead, or Data & AI Architect, including client-facing responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated presales or sales engineering experience for professional services, including discovery, solution shaping, and SOW creation.
  • Proven track record designing and/or delivering solutions on the Microsoft Cloud — Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Azure, Azure AI, Microsoft Fabric, and identity/security (Entra, Purview, Defender).
  • Hands-on familiarity with agentic AI and the emerging Microsoft agent stack — Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Agent 365 / Microsoft Entra Agent ID.
  • Experience positioning AI responsibly, including governance, security, and compliance considerations for enterprise AI adoption.

Core skills

Strong understanding of the Microsoft AI landscape across four pillars:

  • Modern Work — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, adoption and change management.
  • Capability — Azure platform, infrastructure, identity, and Zero Trust security foundations.
  • Application Development — Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, custom and autonomous agent development, MCP-connected services.
  • Data & AI — Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, and the data foundations required to enable trusted AI and agents.

Depth in enterprise AI governance and Agent 365, including:

  • Agent identity and lifecycle (Microsoft Entra Agent ID: identity, ownership/sponsorship, least-privilege, Conditional Access).
  • Agent observability, discovery/registry, and centralized policy-driven governance.
  • Security and compliance for agents via Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview.
  • Ability to assess a client’s AI maturity and propose pragmatic, phased roadmaps (assess → foundation → use-case enablement → govern & scale).
  • Strong understanding of clients’ IT and business decision-making process, especially for AI, productivity, and platform investments.
  • Demonstrated ability to solution across multiple business units and offerings, integrating Modern Work, Cloud, Data, AI, Apps, and Managed Services where appropriate.
  • Financial acumen: understanding of pricing, deal economics, business case development, and ROI in the context of AI programs.

Excellent communication skills:

  • Ability to present complex AI concepts in business-friendly language to executives.
  • Ability to go deep technically with architects, engineers, and data scientists.
  • Strong written skills for proposal and SOW development.

Desirable

  • Experience with consultative frameworks for AI (AI strategy assessments, operating-model design, AI readiness and responsible-AI assessments).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, MCP, and the broader agent developer ecosystem.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, Microsoft 365 / Copilot).
  • Industry-specific experience (e.g., financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail) is a plus.

Soft skills

  • Executive presence with the ability to earn trust quickly in C-level conversations.
  • Strong facilitation skills for workshops and multi-stakeholder sessions.
  • Root cause analysis, structured problem solving, and the ability to simplify complexity.
  • Collaborative working style with sales, delivery, and partner teams.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to structure opportunities and deals from early concept to well-defined scope.

What you can expect

We’re legendary for taking care of you, your family, and helping you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:

  • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Bonus incentives
  • Company 401(k) match
  • Freedom to work from another location—even an international destination—for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities. Join us today—your ambITious journey starts here.

ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Greystar is seeking a Platform Engineer to join the Data team. This is a senior, deeply technical platform operations role responsible for the reliability, governance, and cost efficiency of Greystar’s enterprise data infrastructure — a Databricks-native medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) running entirely on Microsoft Azure. You will work within the DataOps pod under the Analytics Engineering umbrella, owning Databricks workspace administration, Unity Catalog governance, Azure infrastructure operations, and multi-system platform support.

This role is platform-engineering-heavy. Most of your day lives inside Databricks workspace administration and the full Azure data services stack: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, Key Vault, Log Analytics, and beyond. You will enforce platform standards, govern identity and access, optimize compute and storage spend, and provide platform support for EDP, DALDW, ADF, Synapse, Cosmos DB, and SQL Server. Deep mastery of Databricks administration and the Azure platform is a baseline expectation.

Databricks Platform Engineering & Administration

Azure Infrastructure & Integration

Multi-Platform Support

• Support compliance, audit readiness, and Key Vault secret rotation and management

CI/CD & Environment Deployments

• Own the full deployment pipeline for DMP data workflows — promoting changes from development through staging to production

• Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Enterprise: branch strategies, PR automation, environment-specific configuration management, and release gating

• Enforce deployment standards: automated testing gates, rollback procedures, change documentation, and environment parity controls

Identity, Access & Governance

• Maintain data lineage, metadata management, and governance framework documentation

Environment Parity & Dev/Staging/Prod Management

AI-Driven Platform Observability & Self-Healing Infrastructure

• Build and maintain AI-powered platform observability infrastructure — using LLMs and ML models to detect pipeline drift, classify anomalies, predict SLA risk, and generate automated incident summaries at the platform layer

Data Pipeline Architecture & Platform Standards

• Own DMP pipeline architecture patterns from an infrastructure standpoint — Delta Live Tables (DLT) design standards, schema evolution enforcement, and medallion layer contracts

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

• Design and maintain DR strategies for the DMP platform — including Delta table backup policies, ADLS Gen2 geo-redundancy configuration, and Databricks workspace recovery runbooks

• Define RTO and RPO targets for business-critical DMP data domains; test and validate recovery procedures on a recurring basis

Cloud & FinOps / Azure Architect

About the Company

Our client is a globally recognized beauty and personal care retailer specializing in skincare, body care, hair care, cosmetics, and fragrances. Founded in the United Kingdom in the 1970s, the company has built a strong reputation for offering high-quality products made with naturally inspired ingredients while promoting ethical and sustainable business practices.

The organization is committed to cruelty-free beauty, responsible sourcing, environmental sustainability, and supporting communities through fair trade initiatives. Its mission extends beyond selling beauty products by advocating for social and environmental causes, including human rights, animal welfare, and reducing environmental impact.

With a strong international presence through retail stores, franchise partners, and e-commerce platforms, the organization serves millions of customers worldwide. It continues to innovate by developing eco-friendly packaging, expanding refill programs, and creating products that align with the growing demand for sustainable and ethically produced beauty solutions.

Today, it is recognized as one of the world's leading ethical beauty brands, combining quality products with a purpose-driven approach to business and a commitment to making a positive impact on people and the planet.

Position: Cloud & FinOps / Azure Architect

We are seeking an experienced Cloud & FinOps / Azure Architect to lead the governance, architecture, security, and cost optimization of our Microsoft Azure environment.

This is a strategic leadership role responsible for designing scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud solutions while overseeing an enterprise Azure estate containing more than 20 years of historical data. You will drive our FinOps strategy, optimize cloud spending, define data lifecycle management, and architect modern Azure data platforms that balance performance, scalability, and cost.

If you're passionate about Azure architecture, cloud financial management, and enterprise data platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Azure Architecture & Governance

  • Lead the architecture, governance, and strategic direction of the Microsoft Azure environment.
  • Design scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
  • Establish and maintain Azure governance standards, policies, and best practices.
  • Review and approve technical designs to ensure architectural consistency, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Promote cost optimization as a core architectural principle across all cloud initiatives.

FinOps & Cloud Cost Optimization

  • Define and implement an enterprise-wide Azure FinOps framework.
  • Drive cloud cost transparency, budgeting, forecasting, and financial accountability through show back and chargeback models.
  • Establish cost guardrails, budgets, and anomaly detection processes.
  • Optimize Azure spending across:
    • Storage tiers (Hot, Cool, Archive)
    • Compute resources (Reserved Instances, Autoscaling, Shutdown Policies)
    • Backup and disaster recovery strategies
    • Licensing and reserved capacity
  • Partner closely with Finance and business stakeholders to maximize cloud ROI.

Azure Data Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Develop and implement an enterprise data lifecycle strategy for more than 20 years of historical data.
  • Define data classification policies for active, inactive, and archival data.
  • Design tiered Azure storage strategies aligned with business and compliance requirements.
  • Lead data rationalization initiatives by identifying redundant, obsolete, trivial (ROT), and duplicate data.
  • Optimize backup strategies by aligning recovery objectives (RPO/RTO) with business criticality.
  • Implement data compression, partitioning, pruning, and lifecycle policies to reduce long-term storage costs.

Azure Data Platform Architecture

  • Own the architecture of enterprise Azure data platforms, including:
    • Azure Data Lake
    • Azure Databricks
    • Customer Data Platforms (CDP) such as Amperity
    • Integration platforms (iPaaS)
  • Design efficient and scalable data pipelines.
  • Optimize batch and real-time processing workloads.
  • Minimize unnecessary data movement across platforms.
  • Establish reusable data product architectures that reduce duplication across business teams.
  • Ensure effective separation of compute and storage for maximum performance and cost efficiency.

Azure Data Cost Reduction Program

Lead enterprise-wide initiatives to optimize Azure data costs through:

  • Comprehensive assessment of Azure infrastructure and storage utilization.
  • Identification of high-cost storage accounts, redundant backups, and unused datasets.
  • Implementation of storage lifecycle management policies.
  • Archiving cold data and optimizing backup strategies.
  • Redesigning cloud architecture to improve long-term efficiency.
  • Developing real-time cost dashboards and continuous optimization processes.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Microsoft and cloud partners to identify cost optimization opportunities.
  • Evaluate licensing, reserved capacity, and commercial optimization strategies.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Data, Security, and Finance teams to align cloud investments with business priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive experience designing and managing enterprise Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Proven experience leading Azure FinOps or large-scale cloud cost optimization initiatives.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Azure Governance
    • Azure Storage and Lifecycle Management
    • Azure Data Lake
    • Azure Databricks
    • Enterprise Cloud Architecture
    • Cloud Security
  • Experience managing large-scale historical data estates (10+ years of enterprise data).
  • Strong understanding of cloud financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization.
  • Experience designing scalable and cost-efficient enterprise data platforms.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Foundation Certification (or equivalent).
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDP), including Amperity.
  • Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM) and data governance frameworks.
  • Experience with enterprise analytics and large-scale data ecosystems.

Required Skills

  • Azure Open AI

Role Overview

As a Design System Engineer, you’ll be the technical steward of the component library that every product engineer at PermitFlow builds on top of. You'll work at the intersection of design and engineering, partnering closely with our Design Systems lead to define and ship the atoms, molecules, and organisms that keep our product consistent, fast to build, and delightful to use.

This isn't a supporting role. You'll set the standards, own the roadmap, review PRs into the library, and be the go-to person when teams hit the edges of what our design system supports. You'll also lead the federated model we've established — working with team champions across our product squads to drive adoption, surface gaps, and maintain quality across a fast-moving codebase.

What You'll Do

  • Own the day-to-day development and evolution of PermitFlow's React component library

  • Build and maintain components across all levels of the Atomic Design hierarchy — atoms, molecules, organisms, and templates — ensuring each is robust, accessible, and documented in Storybook

  • Define and enforce component standards: API contracts, design token usage, prop interfaces, and variant patterns

  • Review PRs into the component library, maintaining quality bar and ensuring consistency

  • Partner with designers using Figma to translate design specs into production-grade components with fidelity

  • Manage the library's roadmap, balancing new component development with migration work as we bring the broader application into alignment

  • Work with Chromatic for visual regression testing and manage the Storybook instance as the source of truth for component documentation

  • Lead the Design Systems Guild — a cross-team working group of engineering champions — sharing updates, aligning on patterns, and reviewing proposals before implementation

  • Reduce overall frontend complexity: our migration work has already yielded thousands of lines of consolidation, and there's more to go

What We're Looking For

  • Strong React and TypeScript fundamentals — you think in components, not just in pages

  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining a production design system or component library, not just consuming one — a portfolio, GitHub profile, or Storybook instance you can share carries more weight than a resume line

  • A sharp eye for visual and interaction design — you notice when something is off and can articulate why clearly

  • Experience working in close partnership with product designers: giving and receiving feedback on specs, negotiating tradeoffs, and aligning on the right abstraction before something gets built

  • Familiarity with design tooling (Figma) and developer experience tooling (Storybook, Chromatic, or equivalents)

  • Strong written communication — you'll be setting standards that product engineers read and follow, and documenting decisions that outlast you

  • Experience with Tailwind CSS is a strong plus

  • Experience with ShadCN or Radix UI primitives is a strong plus

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) is a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team — where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the Mobile Team

You'll join the mobile team inside our Engineering department. The team builds the products that let nonprofits accept donations in the physical world. Tap to Donate lets a staff member or volunteer accept contactless payments directly on a smartphone. Giving Station is a self-service donation point: a donor selects an amount on a tablet and pays through a connected external payment terminal.

  • bare React Native (0.79, Old Architecture)

You will design, build, and maintain the mobile applications that power Fundraise Up's product on iOS and Android. Mobile is the primary focus, with contributions extending to the backend and web frontend the product depends on to deliver features end-to-end. You'll work across the full development lifecycle — from requirements analysis through implementation, testing, store release, and production support — and ensure the applications are reliable, performant, and secure across the devices and OS versions in use.

  • Review code and designs for correctness — component and navigation structure, rendering, native integration, and alignment with mobile patterns — catching issues before release.

  • Monitor the operational health of shipped work — track releases and staged rollouts, watch release health, and respond to post-release issues on both platforms.

  • Understanding of mobile security — secure storage and handling of sensitive and payment data.
  • Confident day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools — for research, troubleshooting, and implementation.

  • Track record of owning mobile initiatives end-to-end — from requirements through store release, including the backend and web frontend changes they require.

  • Experience owning the release process — app signing, store submission, and staged rollouts.
  • Experience establishing mobile engineering practice from little — standards, CI/CD, and release — across inherited and greenfield codebases.

Nice to Have

jobs.excerpt: Hello!  We're Teya. Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe.
jobs.description:
Hello! We're Teya.

Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe. Founded in 2019, we build easy to use, integrated tools that enable our members to accept payments and boost business performance.

At Teya we believe small, local businesses are the lifeblood of our communities.

We’re here because we don’t believe there’s a level playing field that gives small businesses with a fighting chance against the giants of the high street.

We’re here because we see banks and legacy service providers making things harder for them. We don’t think the best technology or the best service should be reserved for those with the biggest headquarters.

We’re here to fight for a future where small, local businesses can thrive, and to commit the same dedication they offer all of us.

Become a part of our story.

We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our mission. We offer a chance to create impact in a high-energy and connected culture, while benefiting from continuous learning opportunities, a supportive community which is proud to serve our mission, and comprehensive benefits.

Role description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our ePOS Integration team, with a specialised focus on building and scaling the frontend experience for our product and enhancing its supporting backend services:

In this pivotal role, you'll design, develop, and maintain the partner developer web portal that empowers our integration partners and third-party developers to manage accounts, spin up sandbox environments, complete integration certifications, access development support, and navigate our API documentation. As a full-stack engineer, you'll work across the frontend and contribute to the backend services that power the portal. Your work will directly shape how partners build on top of our platform, from their first sandbox call to production go-live.

You'll be joining an exciting remake of the product, meaning you'll have a foundational role in defining the web experience for partner developers from near the ground up. You'll translate complex integration and certification workflows into intuitive, secure, and high-performance developer interfaces, while supporting the backend services behind them, collaborating closely alongside product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, and platform teams. Your expertise will be instrumental in delivering a developer experience that makes integrating with us fast, clear, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, responsive full stack features for the Business Account portal using React, TypeScript, and GraphQL, with ownership spanning both frontend implementation and integration with backend services.

  • Work closely with product and design teams to understand merchant needs and translate complex financial workflows—such as transfers, scheduled payments, account management, and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows—into secure, end-to-end user experiences backed by reliable APIs.

  • Build and maintain data-rich, high-performance interfaces for transaction feeds, balances, statements, and multi-currency views, ensuring efficient data fetching, state management, and seamless interaction with backend services.

  • Develop and maintain GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API integrations, ensuring consistency between frontend requirements and backend data models while promoting type safety and end-to-end reliability.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack, applying strong TypeScript practices and contributing to overall system stability, security, and scalability.

  • Actively participate in code reviews across frontend and backend contributions, helping establish engineering best practices in a team transitioning from a mobile-first to a full stack, web-capable organization.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, data inefficiencies, and production issues across the full stack, ensuring a smooth, reliable experience for merchant users.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest frontend technologies, trends, and best practices, applying them to enhance our merchant-facing web platform.

Your Story

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend/web development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type manipulation, generics, and understanding of complex type inference.

  • Strong proficiency in React.js and its core principles, developed with a type-safe approach.

  • Experience supporting Backend services in Java and Spring Boot

  • Extensive experience with Next.js for server-side rendering, static site generation, and API routes, with a focus on TypeScript integration.

  • Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

  • Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API, Zustand) in a TypeScript environment.

  • Strong experience consuming GraphQL APIs (e.g., Apollo Client), with an understanding of how to define and use types for API responses.

  • Strong understanding of web performance optimisation techniques.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities, especially when working within cross-functional teams spanning product, design, backend, and mobile engineering.

Optional Tech Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Proficiency with UI component libraries such as Chakra UI or Material UI, with experience leveraging their TypeScript definitions.

  • Experience with RESTful API integration.

  • Familiarity with internationalisation (i18n) frameworks for multi-language, multi-market web applications.

Differentiators (What Sets You Apart)

  • Experience in fintech or banking web applications, including secure and compliant interfaces with SCA/2FA, PSD2, and RBAC

  • Proven ability to build and translate mobile-first products into responsive web experiences

  • Practical use of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality

  • Experience launching and localising web products across multiple European markets, including currency, regulatory, and language requirements

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

회사 소개

Bjak은 ASEAN 지역 사람들에게 저렴하고 지속 가능한 금융 서비스에 대한 접근을 제공하는 데 집중하고 있습니다. 본사는 말레이시아에 있으며, Bjak은 동남아시아 최대의 보험 포털입니다. 주요 플랫폼인 Bjak.com은 수백만 명의 사람들이 최고의 가성비와 보장 범위를 갖춘 보험 상품을 찾을 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다.

Custom API, 트레이딩 시스템, 데이터 사이언스 등 다양한 기술에 투자함으로써, 기존에는 접근이 어려웠거나 이해하기 힘들었던 금융 서비스를 보다 쉽게 사용할 수 있도록 만들고 있습니다. Bjak은 말레이시아 내 사업 확장을 이어가며, 이 여정에 함께할 역동적인 인재를 찾고 있습니다. 우리의 비전을 공유하고 Bjak의 다음 성공 챕터에 기여하고 싶은 분들의 많은 지원을 기다립니다.

주요 업무

  • NodeJS를 사용하여 고품질의 백엔드 시스템을 개발하고, 코딩 베스트 프랙티스를 준수

  • ReactJS 및 NextJS를 사용하여 고품질의 프론트엔드 애플리케이션 개발

  • 운영 환경의 안정성을 확보하고, 중요한 문제를 신속하게 해결하여 비즈니스 영향을 최소화

  • 크로스펑셔널 팀의 변경 요청을 효율적으로 처리하여 협업 지원

  • 동료의 코드 리뷰를 통해 코드 품질과 일관성을 유지

자격 요건

  • MongoDB, MySQL 등 데이터베이스 관리 경험

  • Selenium, Cypress, Puppeteer 등 자동화 도구에 대한 이해

  • 스스로 문제를 해결하고, 프로그래밍에 대한 열정을 갖춘 분

우대 사항

  • 관련 프로젝트 포트폴리오 보유 시 우대

  • GCP 또는 AWS 클라우드 서비스 및 Infrastructure as Code 실무 경험

  • UI/UX 디자인 경험

  • 테스트 주도 개발(TDD), 행동 주도 개발(BDD)에 대한 이해

  • Pug, Slim 등 웹 템플릿 언어 경험

  • 커리어 성장: 학습과 성장 기회를 제공하는 체계적인 개발 계획

Bonus Points

  • Experience with web templating languages such as Pug or Slim.

Benefits:

About the role

You will be a senior contributor to our frontend product experience, working across our product suite, including our self-custodial wallet interfaces, account abstraction user flows, and a growing set of web and mobile decentralized applications (dApps). As a senior frontend engineer on the team, you will help shape frontend architecture, deliver complex user-facing features, and embed performance, reliability, and usability best practices into every release.

You will work closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to take features from concept to production, while contributing to improving code quality, system design, and team workflows.

Key responsibilities

Frontend architecture & technical contributions: Contribute to the evolution of frontend system design, patterns, and best practices.

Application development: Design, build, and maintain complex, production-grade frontend applications using TypeScript and TanStack Start.

State management & data orchestration: Implement and maintain scalable client-side state using Zustand and TanStack Query to ensure predictable and performant data flows.

Project ownership: Own and deliver end-to-end frontend workstreams, including:

  • Core wallet and account abstraction UX flows
  • High-throughput, data-rich product interfaces
  • New web and mobile dApp surfaces

Testing & reliability: Contribute to and maintain Playwright-based end-to-end test suites to improve coverage and release confidence.

Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, and Backend teams to refine requirements and deliver high-quality outcomes.

Qualifications

Required experience

  • 2 ~ 4 years of experience as a frontend engineer
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript.
  • Experience with TanStack Start or comparable meta-frameworks (e.g., Next.js, Remix).
  • Solid expertise in modern React patterns, performance optimization, and frontend application design.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate development.
  • Background in web3, blockchain, or decentralized application development.
  • Experience in startup or scale-up environments.

Location and logistics

  • East Asia preferred (Tokyo, Singapore, HongKong)

Worth AI, a leader in the computer software industry, is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Infrastructure team with a singular mission: to make our systems faster, more reliable, and more resilient while making life dramatically easier for engineers shipping software.

This is a hands-on build role.
